title: The Great Oxidation was a prolonged transition
titleZh: 大氧化是持续发生的转变
summary: Sulfur-isotope and redox records point to a prolonged rise in oxygen, marked by the loss of mass-independent sulfur-isotope signals, widespread oxidized continental deposits and changes in carbon and sulfur cycles. U–Pb dates on baddeleyite bracket the onset at about 2,460–2,426 Ma. The records indicate episodes and different local ocean histories, not one instantaneous global threshold or trigger.
summaryZh: 硫同位素与氧化还原记录显示，大气含氧量经历了长期上升：非质量分馏硫同位素信号消失，氧化大陆沉积物广泛出现，碳、硫循环也发生变化。锆石矿物斑锆石的 U–Pb 年龄将起始时间约束在 2,460–2,426 Ma。不同记录呈现的是分阶段变化和各异的局地海洋历史，并非一个瞬时的全球阈值或单一触发因素。

evidenceItems.statement: Mass-independent sulfur isotope signal disappears
Oxidized continental deposits become widespread
Carbon and sulfur cycles reorganize
U–Pb baddeleyite ages bracket the onset at about 2,460–2,426 Ma

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results; Table 1; SI Tables S1 and S4–S5

uncertaintyItems.statement: Oxygenation was episodic rather than a single instant
Local oceans followed different redox histories

title: What dated Ediacaran fossils can tell us
titleZh: 定年后的埃迪卡拉化石能说明什么？
summary: Late Ediacaran marine rocks preserve large body fossils and trace fossils in repeated assemblages across several continents. Many organisms' biological affinities remain debated, and preservation shapes which forms enter the record. In Newfoundland's Avalon succession, zircon dating brackets the Gaskiers glaciation and places fossils above it by about 571 million years ago. That age applies to this regional assemblage; it does not date the origin of animals or a global first appearance.
summaryZh: 晚期埃迪卡拉纪海相岩层中保存了大型实体化石和遗迹化石，不同大陆可见反复出现的化石组合。许多生物的亲缘归属仍有争议，保存条件也会影响哪些形态进入化石记录。在纽芬兰的阿瓦隆地层序列中，锆石定年限定了加斯基尔斯冰期，并显示冰期之后约 5.71 亿年前已有化石。这一年代适用于该区域的化石组合，并不等于动物起源时间或全球首现时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Body and trace fossils
Repeated assemblages on multiple continents
Stratigraphic association with late Ediacaran environments
CA–ID–TIMS zircon ages place Avalon fossils above the Gaskiers glaciation by about 571 Ma

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Geologic setting; U–Pb geochronology; GSA Data Repository

uncertaintyItems.statement: Biological affinities of many forms remain disputed
Preservational windows strongly structure the record

title: What Cambrian fossils show about early animal life
titleZh: 寒武纪化石揭示的早期动物生活
summary: The Cambrian record brings together earlier lineage divergence with a later expansion in animal body plans, ecological interactions and mineralized skeletons. Exceptional fossil deposits, small shelly fossils and trace fossils each document part of this change.
summaryZh: 寒武纪记录呈现了较早的谱系分化，以及随后动物体制、生态互动和矿化骨骼的扩展。特异埋藏化石库、小壳化石与遗迹化石分别记录了这一变化的不同侧面。

evidenceItems.statement: Burgess Shale-type preservation
Small shelly fossils
Trace-fossil diversification

uncertaintyItems.statement: Molecular divergences often predate obvious body fossils
The apparent tempo depends on sampling and preservation

title: What changed during the Great Ordovician Biodiversification?
titleZh: 奥陶纪生物多样化期间发生了什么变化？
summary: Across the Ordovician, reviews document marine diversification in several dimensions: genus and family richness, reef and tiering structures, and broad geographic recurrence. Regional pulses were asynchronous, and measured richness depends partly on which rocks and collections are available. The evidence supports multi-clade taxonomic, ecological and biogeographic restructuring, not a single cause or one precise global rate.
summaryZh:
综述把奥陶纪海洋变化分成几个可比较的维度：属和科的丰富度上升、礁体与底栖层级结构扩展，以及多地重复出现的地理记录。多条类群的分类、生态和生物地理记录共同显示海洋生物群发生重组。

各地区的变化脉冲并不同步；可统计的丰富度也受现存岩层和采集资料影响。因此，这些综述支持多类群、多维度的多样化图景，却不能归结为单一原因或一个精确的全球速率。

evidenceItems.statement: Rising genus and family richness
Expansion of reef and tiering structures
Broad geographic recurrence

uncertaintyItems.statement: Regional pulses are asynchronous
Observed richness is sensitive to rock and collection availability

title: A molecular-clock estimate for the land-plant crown
titleZh: 陆生植物冠群的分子钟估计
summary: Using 37 fossil calibrations, a Bayesian relaxed clock places crown Embryophyta—the common ancestor of living land plants and its descendants—in a middle Cambrian–Early Ordovician interval, earlier than the estimated crown of Tracheophyta (vascular plants) in the Late Ordovician–Silurian. These divergence times depend on clock and calibration choices; they are model estimates, not direct fossil first appearances or dates for ecosystem expansion.
summaryZh: 一项使用 37 个化石校准的贝叶斯松弛分子钟分析，将胚胎植物冠群——现生陆生植物的最近共同祖先及其后代——估计在中寒武世至早奥陶世形成；维管植物冠群的估计则较晚，为晚奥陶世至志留纪。这些分化时间取决于分子钟和校准选择，是模型估计，不是化石首次出现的直接日期，也不代表生态系统扩展的时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Bayesian relaxed molecular clock using 37 fossil calibrations
Middle Cambrian–Early Ordovician crown-Embryophyta estimate

uncertaintyItems.statement: Divergence estimates are sensitive to clock models and fossil-calibration strategy
Modelled crown divergence is not a direct fossil first appearance or an ecosystem-expansion date

title: From fins to limbs and land: a mosaic of transitions
titleZh: 从鳍到肢、再到陆地：镶嵌式转变
summary: Across the 385–350 Ma display window, the review follows several anatomical changes rather than a single “fish to land” event. Fins, girdles, joints and digits appear in different combinations as researchers ask three separate questions: when did digit-bearing limbs arise, how did locomotion change, and when were vertebrates fully terrestrial? The chapter’s mosaic framing is a 2009 synthesis, not a new date for one event or a ladder of proven direct ancestors, and it predates later fossil discoveries.
summaryZh: 在本章展示的 3.85 亿至 3.5 亿年前窗口中，综述追踪的是一系列解剖变化，而非一次“鱼到陆地”的事件。鳍、带肢带、关节与趾以不同组合出现，研究者也分别追问三个问题：带趾肢体何时出现、运动方式怎样改变、脊椎动物何时完全陆生。这种“镶嵌式”框架来自 2009 年的综合研究，不是某一事件的新定年，也不是已证实的直系祖先阶梯；该综述发表后仍有新化石发现。

evidenceItems.statement: Fins, girdles, digits and joint mobility changed in different combinations across Devonian and Early Carboniferous forms
The synthesis treats digit-bearing limbs, walking and full terrestriality as distinguishable evolutionary questions

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Abstract; What Can We Learn from This Information?; Conclusions

uncertaintyItems.statement: This broad 385–350 Ma display is an editorial synthesis window, not a single dated event or a taxon range
Possession of digits does not by itself establish terrestrial ecology, a modern walking gait or direct ancestry

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Our Cast of Characters; What Can We Learn from This Information?

title: Zachełmie’s Eifelian footprints and the tetrapod question
titleZh: Zachełmie 的艾菲尔期足迹与四足动物问题
regions: Zachełmie Quarry, Holy Cross Mountains, Poland
summary: Bedding surfaces at Zachełmie preserve quadrupedal trackways and isolated prints with digit impressions from the Eifelian, a Middle Devonian interval. They indicate an unidentified limbed tetrapod trackmaker, but traces do not name its body taxon or make it a direct ancestor. The displayed 393.47–387.95 Ma span is the atlas’s stage window, not an error range for one footprint.
summaryZh: Zachełmie 的层面保存了艾菲尔期（中泥盆世的一个阶段）的四足行迹，以及带趾印的孤立足迹。它们指向一种身份未明的具肢四足动物造迹者，但遗迹不能确定其身体分类单元或直系祖先身份。图示的 393.47–387.95 Ma 是图谱采用的阶段时间窗，不是某一枚足印的测年误差范围。

evidenceItems.statement: Quadrupedal trackways, isolated footprints and digit impressions occur on securely dated early Middle Devonian bedding surfaces

uncertaintyItems.statement: A footprint records a trace-making appendage and gait, not the trackmaker's body taxonomy, complete anatomy or ancestor–descendant identity
The displayed 393.47–387.95 Ma interval is the atlas's current Eifelian stage window, not an analytical error bar on one footprint

title: Tiktaalik’s wrist belongs to a wider anatomical mosaic
titleZh: Tiktaalik 的腕关节属于更完整的体制镶嵌
regions: Fram Formation, southern Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada
summary:
Fram Formation material of Tiktaalik roseae combines scales, fin rays and fish-like jaws with a shortened skull roof, a mobile neck, a modified ear region, robust overlapping ribs and a functional wrist joint. The holotype and referred material together document a body plan in which aquatic fish features coexist with changes in the head and paired fins.

A functional wrist joint is an anatomical observation; what it meant for support or movement is an interpretation. The mosaic and depositional setting support hypotheses about shallow marginal habitats, but do not show habitual walking on land. Intermediate character combinations also do not make Tiktaalik a direct ancestor of later tetrapods.
summaryZh:
Fram 组的 Tiktaalik roseae 材料同时保存鳞片、鳍条和鱼样下颌，以及缩短的头顶、可动颈部、改变的耳区、相互覆盖的粗壮肋骨和具功能的腕关节。正模与归入材料共同记录了一种体制：水生鱼类特征与头部和成对鳍的变化并存。

腕关节的结构属于解剖观察；它对支撑或运动意味着什么则属于解释。体制组合和沉积环境支持对浅水边缘生境的假说，但不能证明它惯常在陆地行走。性状上的过渡组合也不能把 Tiktaalik 认定为后期四足动物的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: NUFV 108 and referred material preserve a shortened skull roof, mobile neck, modified ear region, robust overlapping ribs and fin-bearing paired appendages

uncertaintyItems.statement: The anatomical mosaic and depositional setting support hypotheses about shallow marginal habitats but do not show that Tiktaalik routinely walked on land

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Abstract; discussion of palaeoenvironment and functional interpretation

uncertaintyItems.statement: A phylogenetically intermediate combination does not identify Tiktaalik as a direct ancestor of later tetrapods

title: Tiktaalik's wrist-like joints inside a fin
titleZh: 胸鳍中的腕样关节
regions: Fram Formation, southern Ellesmere Island, Nunavut, Canada
summary: In *Tiktaalik roseae*, the pectoral fin's internal skeleton includes a humerus, radius and ulna, wrist-like joints and small distal radials, yet the fin still carries fin rays (lepidotrichia). These structures are directly observed in multiple specimens. Researchers infer from the joint geometry that the fin could transmit load, but that is a functional interpretation: no free digits or walking trace are preserved, so the fossil does not show that *Tiktaalik* walked on land.
summaryZh: 提塔利克鱼 *Tiktaalik roseae* 的胸鳍内骨骼含有肱骨、桡骨、尺骨、腕样关节和远端辐骨，同时仍保留鳍条（lepidotrichia）。这些结构在多件标本中直接可见。研究者从关节形状推测鳍可以传递负荷，但这是功能解释；标本没有保存自由手指或行走足迹，因此不能据此说 *Tiktaalik* 已在陆地行走。

evidenceItems.statement: The pectoral-fin endoskeleton includes a robust humerus, radius and ulna, wrist-like joints and distal radials while retaining lepidotrichial fin rays

uncertaintyItems.statement: Load transmission inferred from joint geometry is a functional interpretation; the appendage remains a fin and does not preserve free digits or a witnessed gait

title: Digits inside a fin?
titleZh: 鳍内出现了指状骨列？
summary: CT scans of the articulated Elpistostege specimen MHNM 06-2067 reveal branched carpals and two distal skeletal rows interpreted as digits or possible digits. Lepidotrichia, the fin rays, remain present, so the appendage is still a fin.
summaryZh: 对关节相连的 Elpistostege 标本 MHNM 06-2067 进行 CT 扫描，显示分支腕骨和两列被解释为指或候选指的远端骨列。鳍条仍然存在，因此这个附肢仍是鳍。

title.en: A fin with a complex internal skeleton
title.zh: 内部骨骼复杂的鳍

text.en: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 preserves an articulated body about 1.57 metres long. CT reconstruction of its pectoral fin shows four proximodistal radial rows, branched carpals and two distal rows interpreted as digits or putative digits. These are internal skeletal observations from one exceptionally complete specimen.
text.zh: 标本 MHNM 06-2067 保存了一具约 1.57 米长、关节相连的身体。胸鳍 CT 重建显示四列沿近端至远端排列的辐骨、分支腕骨，以及两列被解释为指或候选指的远端骨列。这些是来自一件异常完整标本的内部骨骼观察。

title.en: Why the appendage is still called a fin
title.zh: 为何这个附肢仍称为鳍

text.en: Lepidotrichia are the bony fin rays, and they remain in the appendage. Whether the distal rows are homologous to digits, and where Elpistostege lies relative to other tetrapods, are interpretations from anatomical comparison and phylogenetic analysis. The Frasnian interval shown for the formation is geological context, not a direct radiometric date on this specimen.
text.zh: 鳍条是鳍上的骨性支撑，标本中的鳍条仍然存在。远端骨列是否与四足动物的指同源，以及 Elpistostege 与其他四足动物的关系，都属于解剖比较和系统发育分析的解释。地层组显示的弗拉斯期区间只是地质背景，并非对这件标本的直接放射性定年。

evidenceItems.statement: Specimen MHNM 06-2067 preserves a 1.57-metre articulated body and a CT-resolved pectoral-fin skeleton with branched carpals and distal digit-like rows

uncertaintyItems.statement: Digit homology and the potential sister position to other tetrapods are analytical interpretations, and the appendage remains a fin with lepidotrichia

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Abstract; comparative anatomy and phylogenetic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed 382.31–372.15 Ma interval is the current Frasnian stage window for the formation context, not a direct radiometric date on MHNM 06-2067

title.en: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand
title.zh: Elpistostege and the origin of the vertebrate hand

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

readerSources.locator: pages: 549–554; figure: Figures 1–5; Extended Data Figures 1–2; figure: Figures 3–5; Abstract; comparative anatomy and phylogenetic analyses; Specimen and geological context

title: Eight digits in the Acanthostega forelimb
titleZh: Acanthostega 前肢的八个趾
summary: One described Acanthostega forelimb has eight digits. The same study reports seven in an Ichthyostega hindlimb and six in Tulerpeton, showing that five digits were not a universal primitive condition; those counts do not demonstrate that these animals walked on land.
summaryZh: 一件已描述的 Acanthostega 前肢标本有八个趾。同一研究报告 Ichthyostega 后肢有七趾、Tulerpeton 有六趾，说明五趾并非普遍固定的原始状态；这些趾数本身不能证明这些动物曾在陆地行走。

evidenceItems.statement: The described Acanthostega forelimb has eight digits; the same study reports seven in the Ichthyostega hindlimb and six in Tulerpeton

uncertaintyItems.statement: Eight digits diagnose the described limb material; they neither define a universal ancestral digit count nor demonstrate terrestrial walking

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Abstract; discussion of polydactyly and aquatic adaptation

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed 372.15–358.86 Ma interval is the current Famennian stage window, not a direct numerical date on each limb specimen

title: Could Ichthyostega use a walking gait?
titleZh: 鱼石螈能否采用典型步行步态？
summary: Micro-CT reconstructions of Ichthyostega’s shoulder and hip joints were compared with five living tetrapod analogues. The measured joint ranges lacked the limb long-axis rotations required for a typical lateral-sequence walk. This constrains possible movement but does not record actual gait; the result may reflect restricted early mobility or a specialization of Ichthyostega.
summaryZh: 研究用显微 CT 重建鱼石螈的肩关节与髋关节，并与五种现生四足动物作比较。测得的关节活动范围缺少典型侧序步态所需的肢体长轴旋转。这限制了可能动作，却没有记录实际步态；结果可能反映早期活动度受限，也可能是鱼石螈自身的特化。

evidenceItems.statement: Micro-CT-based reconstruction quantified shoulder and hip ranges of motion against five living tetrapod analogues

uncertaintyItems.statement: The result may represent an early restricted-mobility stage or a specialization unique to Ichthyostega; it is not a gait model for every early tetrapod
Joint range constrains feasible motions but does not directly observe behaviour, substrate use or every movement available to the living animal

title: Early amniote skulls mark two major branches
titleZh: 早期羊膜动物的头骨如何标出两大支系？
summary: What distinguishes the early synapsid and sauropsid branches? The cited analysis uses diagnostic skull openings to separate these lineages, while reproductive and skeletal changes are inferred from phylogeny and compared with Carboniferous body fossils. The earliest members are rare, several Paleozoic placements vary among analyses, and the exact divergence dates depend on tree calibration.
summaryZh: 早期合弓类与蜥形类支系如何区分？所引分析依据头骨上的诊断性开口区分两支；繁殖与骨骼变化则是从系统发育关系推断，并与石炭纪身体化石对照。最早期成员很少，若干古生代分类单元的位置会随分析改变，分化的确切年代也取决于系统树校准。

evidenceItems.statement: Diagnostic skull openings
Reproductive and skeletal adaptations inferred from phylogeny
Carboniferous body fossils

uncertaintyItems.statement: The earliest members are rare
Exact divergence dates depend on tree calibration

title: A crisis across the Permian–Triassic boundary
titleZh: 二叠纪—三叠纪界线附近的生物危机
summary: The Permian–Triassic boundary interval records the most severe known Phanerozoic extinction, with major losses and ecosystem change on land and at sea. High-resolution work at Meishan constrains the sequence in that section; it cannot make every regional collapse synchronous or reduce the crisis to one cause.
summaryZh: 二叠纪—三叠纪界线附近记录了已知显生宙最严重的生物灭绝，陆地和海洋生态系统都发生重大损失与变化。梅山剖面的高分辨率研究约束了当地事件顺序；它不能证明所有地区同时崩溃，也不能把危机归结为单一原因。

evidenceItems.statement: Abrupt fossil range terminations
Carbon-isotope excursion
Volcanic and warming proxies
Dated Meishan ash beds bound the main extinction interval to about 60 ± 48 kyr

uncertaintyItems.statement: Kill mechanisms interacted across ocean and land
Regional ecological collapse and recovery were asynchronous

title: Triassic ecosystems recovered along different paths
titleZh: 三叠纪生态系统沿着不同路径恢复
summary: After the end-Permian extinction, recovery unfolded unevenly across food webs, marine reefs and pelagic communities, and reptile groups. The sources gathered here describe different regions, ecological measures, and stages; some Early Triassic communities also faced renewed environmental stress. “Recovery” therefore does not name one synchronous event with a single duration or global trajectory.
summaryZh: 二叠纪末大灭绝后，食物网、海洋礁体与远洋群落、以及不同爬行动物类群沿着不均一的路径恢复。这里关联的研究涉及不同地区、生态指标和阶段；部分早三叠世群落还遭遇了新的环境压力。因此，“恢复”不是一个具有统一持续时间和全球轨迹的同步事件。

evidenceItems.statement: Changing food-web structure
New reptile radiations
Recovery of reef and pelagic systems

uncertaintyItems.statement: Recovery duration differs by metric and region
Repeated Early Triassic environmental stress delayed some communities

title: When major flowering-plant lineages diversified
titleZh: 主要被子植物谱系的分化时间估计
summary: A metacalibrated molecular time tree estimates Early Cretaceous diversification for the major crown lineages magnoliids, monocots and eudicots. These are fossil-calibrated model estimates, not dates for each lineage’s first fossil or proof that flowering plants already dominated ecosystems.
summaryZh: 一项多重校准的分子时间树估计，木兰类、单子叶类和真双子叶类等主要冠群谱系在早白垩世分化。这些是经化石校准的模型估计，不是各谱系化石首现的日期，也不能证明当时被子植物已占据生态优势。

evidenceItems.statement: Metacalibrated crown-lineage estimates from 137 fossil calibrations

uncertaintyItems.statement: Estimated ages depend on fossil calibrations and molecular-clock models

title: The K–Pg impact and the abrupt fossil turnover
titleZh: K–Pg 撞击与界线处的化石骤变
summary: Iridium-rich boundary clay and impact ejecta link the K–Pg crisis to an extraterrestrial impact, with Chicxulub identified as the source crater. High-precision 40Ar/39Ar dates place the boundary at 66.043 ± 0.043 Ma and resolve impact and extinction as synchronous within about 32,000 years. That event-level link does not mean every species vanished at once: Deccan volcanism contributed background stress, and survival and recovery varied among regions and groups.
summaryZh: 富铱界线黏土和撞击喷出物将白垩纪—古近纪危机与地外撞击联系起来，希克苏鲁伯被确定为源撞击坑。高精度 40Ar/39Ar 测年将界线定在 66.043 ± 0.043 Ma，并显示撞击与界线灭绝在约 32,000 年内同步。这种事件尺度的联系不表示每个物种都在同一时刻消失：德干火山活动构成背景环境压力，不同地区和类群的存活与恢复模式也不相同。

evidenceItems.statement: Iridium-rich boundary layer
Chicxulub crater
Abrupt fossil turnover
High-precision 40Ar/39Ar ages resolve impact and boundary extinction as synchronous within about 32 kyr

uncertaintyItems.statement: Deccan volcanism contributed background environmental stress
Survival and recovery patterns varied among regions and clades

title: The PETM: warming and biological responses
titleZh: 古新世—始新世极热事件中的增温与生物响应
summary: During the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum (PETM), a rapid negative carbon-isotope excursion coincided with warming, deep-sea benthic extinctions and poleward shifts in organism ranges. These records establish a close timing relationship; the carbon source and release pace remain debated, and estimated onset and recovery durations depend on the resolution of each archive.
summaryZh: 古新世—始新世极热事件期间，快速的碳同位素负偏与升温、深海底栖生物灭绝及生物分布向高纬移动同时出现。这些记录确立了密切的时间关系；碳源和释放速率仍有争论，而起始与恢复所需时间取决于各地层记录的分辨率。

evidenceItems.statement: Negative carbon-isotope excursion
Deep-sea benthic extinction
Poleward biogeographic shifts

uncertaintyItems.statement: Carbon sources and release pacing remain debated
Onset and recovery durations depend on archive resolution

title: Early perissodactyls spread across northern continents
titleZh: 早期奇蹄类在北方大陆间扩散
summary: An analysis of 71 terminals and 102 anatomical characters traces the earliest sampled perissodactyls to the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum, followed by records across northern continents and varied dental and locomotor forms. The pattern supports rapid dispersal, but sparse sampling and alternative stem placements leave the order’s place of origin unresolved; a first sampled fossil is not an origin date.
summaryZh: 一项包含 71 个末端类群和 102 项解剖特征的分析，将最早采样到的奇蹄类记录追溯到古新世—始新世极热事件，之后该类群出现在北方大陆并呈现多样的牙齿和运动形态。这一模式支持快速扩散，但取样稀疏、干群位置又随分析而变，故奇蹄类的起源地仍未解决；最早采样化石不等于起源日期。

evidenceItems.statement: Rapid early Eocene occurrence expansion
Diverse dental and locomotor morphologies
Intercontinental first appearances

uncertaintyItems.statement: The precise ancestral group and relationships of early branches remain debated
First appearances reflect sampling as well as evolution

title: Climate and mammal records across the Eocene–Oligocene transition
titleZh: 始新世—渐新世转型中的气候与哺乳动物记录
summary: Near the beginning of the Oligocene, Pacific marine oxygen-isotope records show ice growth in steps. In the Hampshire Basin, the mammal record instead captures regional turnover, a depositional gap of about 350,000 years and the later appearance of Asian immigrants. Together they show climate and faunal change, but not a single simple chain of cause: immigration, climate and habitat shifts differed by region, and one ecological group did not simply replace another.
summaryZh:
渐新世开始前后，太平洋海洋氧同位素记录显示冰量分阶段增长；汉普郡盆地的哺乳动物化石则记录了区域性更替、一段约 35 万年的沉积缺失，以及后来出现的亚洲移入类群。两处记录分别呈现气候与动物群变化，可以并读，却不能拼成一条简单的单因果链。

移入、气候和栖地变化在不同地区的作用并不相同；一个生态类群也没有简单地逐一取代另一个。盆地中的沉积间断意味着当地化石序列并非连续记录。

evidenceItems.statement: Marine oxygen-isotope shift
Antarctic ice-volume proxies
European Grande Coupure turnover

uncertaintyItems.statement: Immigration, climate and habitat change contributed differently by region
Ecological replacement was not a simple one-to-one competition

title: Tooth enamel tracks a regional C4 expansion
titleZh: 牙釉质记录了不同步的 C4 扩张
summary: Carbon-isotope ratios in fossil tooth enamel from Asia, Africa, North America and South America record a widespread rise in C4-plant biomass between about 8 and 6 Ma, with earlier increases at lower latitudes. C4 plants use a distinct carbon-fixation pathway; enamel values act as a proxy for the diets of sampled animals and their local habitats. The signal is not a direct map of vegetation cover: it does not identify which C4 plants supplied the biomass or by itself demonstrate open grassland, dental adaptation or faunal turnover.
summaryZh: 亚洲、非洲、北美洲和南美洲的化石牙釉质碳同位素记录显示，约 800 万至 600 万年前，C4 植物生物量普遍增加，低纬度地区出现得更早。C4 植物采用一种不同的固碳途径；牙釉质同位素反映的是所取样动物的食物及其局部栖息环境。这个信号不是植被覆盖图：它不能识别具体由哪些 C4 植物贡献生物量，也不能单独证明开阔草原形成、牙齿适应或动物群更替。

evidenceItems.statement: Fossil tooth-enamel δ13C records from four continents

uncertaintyItems.statement: The increase occurred earlier at lower latitudes and was not globally synchronous
Isotope-inferred C4 biomass is not equivalent to open-grassland dominance
Tooth-enamel δ13C is an animal-diet and local-habitat proxy; it cannot identify which C4 plant lineages supplied the biomass or assume diet is proportional to vegetation cover

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Methods and interpretation of enamel carbon isotopes

title: Late Quaternary megafaunal losses varied by region
titleZh: 晚第四纪巨型动物灭绝的区域差异
summary: The cited global comparison links the severity of late-Quaternary megafaunal losses more strongly to human expansion than to climate, while finding weaker climate effects concentrated in some regions, especially Eurasia. The picture is assembled from dated last appearances, archaeological associations and palaeoenvironmental records, which do not have equal coverage everywhere. Last-appearance dates can precede true extinction when fossil sampling is sparse. The result is a comparative pattern, not a single cause or a globally synchronous event.
summaryZh: 所引全球比较发现，晚第四纪巨型动物灭绝的严重程度与人类扩张关联更强；气候效应较弱，并集中于部分地区，尤其是欧亚大陆。研究综合了放射性定年得到的最晚出现记录、考古关联和古环境档案，但各地区资料覆盖并不相同。化石采样稀疏时，最晚出现年代可能早于真正灭绝时间。这是一种区域比较格局，不代表单一成因或全球同步的灭绝事件。

evidenceItems.statement: Radiometric last-appearance records
Archaeological association
Paleoenvironmental archives

uncertaintyItems.statement: Relative effects of human pressure and climate vary by continent
Last-appearance dates underestimate true extinction when sampling is sparse

title: Dapingian spores record plants on emerged land
titleZh: 大坪期孢子留下的早期陆地植物证据
summary: A palynological sample of fossil spores from one biostratigraphically controlled horizon of Argentina’s Zanjón Formation contains five cryptospore genera. The study reports both single spores (monads) and groups of four (tetrads), either naked or enclosed in envelopes, and dates the assemblage to about 473–471 Ma. This supports the presence of embryophytes on emerged land. The spores do not identify a crown-bryophyte lineage or pinpoint where and when land plants originated.
summaryZh: 阿根廷西北部 Zanjón 组一个具有生物地层年代约束的层位，出土了含五个隐孢子属的样品。研究记录了单个孢子（单体）和四个成组的孢子（四分体），有些裸露、有些包在外壁中，并将组合定年为约 473–471 Ma。它支持当时露出陆地上已有胚胎植物，但不能把这些孢子归为苔藓植物冠群，也不能据此确定陆生植物起源的地点或时刻。

evidenceItems.statement: Naked and envelope-enclosed monads and tetrads from one biostratigraphically controlled horizon

uncertaintyItems.statement: Cryptospores do not identify a crown bryophyte lineage or the exact place and time of embryophyte origin

title: Twelve Ordovician fragments preserve spore masses
titleZh: 十二块奥陶纪碎片留下了什么植物繁殖证据？
clades: Early land plants; liverwort affinity tentative
summary: Twelve fragments from the Ghaba-1 core in northern Oman preserve permanent spore tetrads or dyads, with some showing a presumed sporangial covering. The source calls the deposits Caradoc; the atlas therefore keeps a broad Sandbian–Katian display interval rather than converting that legacy regional stage into a precise date. Layered spore walls suggest liverwort affinity, but missing elaters and unresolved early-plant relationships prevent a crown-group identification.
summaryZh: 阿曼北部 Ghaba-1 岩芯的十二块碎片保存了永久四分体或二分体孢子团，部分还带有推定的孢子囊覆盖层。原研究把沉积物称为 Caradoc；图谱因此保留宽泛的桑比期—凯迪期显示区间，不把旧区域阶换算成貌似精确的日期。层状孢壁提示可能接近地钱类，但因缺少弹丝且早期陆生植物亲缘未定，不能将其确定为冠群成员。

evidenceItems.statement: Twelve fragments contain permanent tetrads or dyads, and some retain presumed sporangial covering

uncertaintyItems.statement: Caradoc is a legacy regional unit, so the Sandbian–Katian display window is deliberately broad
Lamellate spore walls suggest liverwort affinity, but missing elaters and unresolved early-land-plant topology prevent a crown assignment

title: Three axis types in an early lycophyte
titleZh: 早期石松类植物的三种轴
summary: Two serial anatomical datasets from the roughly 407-million-year-old Asteroxylon mackiei separate leafy shoots, root-bearing axes and rooting axes. The rooting axes begin at unequal branch points; this reconstruction describes one extinct species, not all lycophytes.
summaryZh: 对约 4.07 亿年前 Asteroxylon mackiei 的两套连续解剖数据，区分了具叶枝条、承根轴和生根轴。生根轴起自不等二歧分枝点；这一重建只描述一个已灭绝物种，不能推广到全部石松类。

evidenceItems.statement: Independent serial-section and peel reconstructions recover leafy shoot, root-bearing and rooting axes

uncertaintyItems.statement: The reconstructed developmental mechanism belongs to Asteroxylon and is not asserted for all Lycophyta

title: A Devonian liverwort body fossil
titleZh: 一件泥盆纪地钱植物体化石
regions: Catskill Delta succession, eastern New York
summary: Givetian strata in eastern New York preserve Metzgeriothallus sharonae thalli with a central costa and branching, plus an associated sporophyte capsule. The material is a Middle Devonian liverwort record, not a date for the origin of crown Marchantiophyta.
summaryZh: 纽约州东部吉维特期地层保存了具有中肋和分叉结构的 Metzgeriothallus sharonae 叶状体，以及一枚伴生孢子体蒴。这是中泥盆世地钱植物体记录，不是地钱门冠群的起源年代。

title.en: What the shale lenses preserve
title.zh: 页岩透镜体保存的结构

text.en: Polarized-light study describes bifurcating thalli with a medial costa—a thicker central strand—and an associated sporophyte capsule. A gametophyte is the life-cycle stage that produces gametes; the sporophyte produces spores. The parts are associated in the fossil record, but the study does not show an anatomically connected whole plant.
text.zh: 偏振光研究描述了带中肋（较厚中央轴）的分叉叶状体，以及伴生的孢子体蒴。配子体是产生配子的世代，孢子体则产生孢子。化石记录显示这些部分伴生，但研究没有证明它们连接成一株解剖完整的植物。

title.en: An occurrence, not an origin date
title.zh: 出现记录，不是起源年代

text.en: The Givetian specimens from eastern New York provide a Middle Devonian body-fossil record assigned to Metzgeriothallus sharonae. They do not date the crown divergence of Marchantiophyta or prove that liverworts were absent from older rocks. The described morphology diagnoses this material and should not be generalized to every liverwort lineage.
text.zh: 纽约州东部吉维特期标本提供了归入 Metzgeriothallus sharonae 的中泥盆世植物体化石记录。它们不能给地钱门冠群分化定年，也不能证明更老岩层中不存在地钱类。所描述形态用于鉴定这批材料，不应推广到所有地钱支系。

evidenceItems.statement: Polarized-light study reveals bifurcating thalli with a medial costa and an associated sporophyte capsule

uncertaintyItems.statement: A Givetian occurrence cannot date crown Marchantiophyta or prove absence from older rocks
The fossil morphology is not generalized to all living or extinct liverwort lineages

title.en: Earth's oldest liverworts—Metzgeriothallus sharonae sp. nov. from the Middle Devonian (Givetian) of eastern New York, USA
title.zh: Earth's oldest liverworts—Metzgeriothallus sharonae sp. nov. from the Middle Devonian (Givetian) of eastern New York, USA

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

readerSources.locator: pages: 154–162; figure: Plate I, figures 1–4; Plate II

title: A tree of living gymnosperms
titleZh: 现生裸子植物的系统树
summary: A nuclear phylogenomic study sampled all 13 living gymnosperm families and up to 1,308 loci. It recovered cycads plus Ginkgo as sister to the other living gymnosperms, and Gnetales as sister to Pinaceae; gene-tree conflict and subset analyses keep this a hypothesis about living lineages.
summaryZh: 一项核基因系统基因组研究取样了全部 13 个现生裸子植物科，最多分析 1,308 个基因位点。研究将苏铁类与银杏组成其余现生裸子植物的姐妹群，并将买麻藤目置于松科的姐妹位置；基因树冲突和子集分析说明这仍是关于现生支系的假说。

title.en: The sampled living-family backbone
title.zh: 取样的现生科骨架

text.en: Phylogenomics compares many genes to infer relationships. In this study, nuclear loci sampled all 13 living gymnosperm families, with analyses using up to 1,308 loci. The recovered topology places cycads and Ginkgo together as sister to the remaining living gymnosperms, and Gnetales as sister to Pinaceae.
text.zh: 系统基因组学通过比较大量基因推断亲缘关系。本研究的核基因位点涵盖全部 13 个现生裸子植物科，部分分析使用多达 1,308 个位点。恢复的拓扑将苏铁类与银杏组合为其余现生裸子植物的姐妹群，并把买麻藤目置于松科的姐妹位置。

title.en: A hypothesis about living plants
title.zh: 关于现生植物的假说

text.en: The study also reports conflict among gene trees and alternative placements in subsets of the data. The Gnepine arrangement is therefore a published topology supported by a large sample, not permanent consensus. Its tree concerns sampled living lineages; it does not supply fossil ranges or relationships among extinct seed plants.
text.zh: 研究也报告了基因树之间的冲突，以及不同数据子集中的替代位置。因此，Gnepine 排列是由大规模取样支持的已发表拓扑，而非永久共识。该树讨论的是所取样的现生支系，不提供化石延限，也不说明已灭绝种子植物之间的关系。

evidenceItems.statement: All 13 living gymnosperm families sampled across up to 1,308 nuclear loci

uncertaintyItems.statement: Gene-tree conflict and alternative subset results keep the Gnepine placement a published hypothesis rather than permanent consensus
The topology concerns sampled living lineages and supplies neither fossil ranges nor an extinct-seed-plant tree

title.en: Phylogenomics resolves the deep phylogeny of seed plants and indicates partial convergent or homoplastic evolution between Gnetales and angiosperms
title.zh: Phylogenomics resolves the deep phylogeny of seed plants and indicates partial convergent or homoplastic evolution between Gnetales and angiosperms

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

readerSources.locator: figure: Figures 1–2; figure: Figure 2; Evaluation of conflicts; Discussion; Taxon sampling and phylogenetic scope

title: A recent radiation estimate for living cycads
titleZh: 现生苏铁近期辐射的模型估计
summary: A 2011 fossil-calibrated molecular model placed much of the diversity among sampled living cycads within roughly the previous 12 million years. Later studies that add fossil evidence recover older deep branches and weaken a single, globally synchronous radiation. The estimate concerns sampled living species; it does not date the origin of Cycadales or its first fossil appearance.
summaryZh: 2011 年一项化石校准的分子模型把取样现生苏铁的大部分多样化置于约此前 1200 万年内。纳入化石的后续研究恢复出更古老的深层分支，也削弱了全球同步辐射的简单叙事。这个估计针对取样的现生物种；它没有给出苏铁目的起源或化石首现年代。

evidenceItems.statement: Fossil-calibrated timetrees of sampled living cycad species and genera

uncertaintyItems.statement: Later fossil, tectonic and total-evidence treatments recover older deep nodes and weaken a simple globally synchronous radiation
The 12 Ma window concerns sampled living radiations, not Cycadales origin or fossil first appearance

title: How old is the crown of living Cycadaceae?
titleZh: 现生苏铁科冠群有多古老？
regions: Global Cycas plastome sample with Palawan calibration
summary: A whole-plastome analysis combined fossil and tectonic calibrations to estimate the crown age of living Cycadaceae—the group descending from the most recent common ancestor of living members. Under different tree priors, the reported mean ages are 69.31 Ma and 42.88 Ma. The estimates vary with the model and calibration scheme; neither is a directly observed fossil first appearance, and the result concerns Cycadaceae rather than all cycads.
summaryZh:
研究把全质体基因组树与化石、板块构造校准结合起来，估算现生苏铁科的冠群年龄。“冠群”指现生成员最近共同祖先及其后代。采用不同树先验时，论文报告的平均年龄分别为 69.31 Ma 和 42.88 Ma；它们是模型估计，不是直接观察到的化石首现。

结果会随树先验和校准方案改变，讨论对象是苏铁科，而不是全部苏铁目。两个数值不能脱离各自的模型设定，被读成一段已经由化石连续记录的年代。

evidenceItems.statement: Whole-plastome phylogeny evaluated under alternative fossil, tectonic and tree-prior schemes

uncertaintyItems.statement: Calibration scheme and tree prior substantially change the estimate, with underconstrained alternatives spanning much wider ages
The result concerns the crown of living Cycadaceae, not all Cycadales and not a directly observed fossil first appearance

title: Fossils reshape a model of cycad range change
titleZh: 化石改写苏铁纬度分布变化模型
summary: A total-evidence biogeographic model infers broad cycad ranges across Cretaceous–Palaeogene latitudes, followed by contraction toward today’s tropical–subtropical distribution. Adding fossils changes estimates of when losses occurred, so the result is model-dependent rather than a direct map of every past population.
summaryZh: 一项整合多类证据的生物地理模型推断，苏铁在白垩纪至古近纪曾分布于较宽的纬度范围，随后收缩到现今的热带至亚热带分布。加入化石会改变对消失时间的估计，因此这一结果依赖模型，并非每个过去种群的直接地图。

evidenceItems.statement: 321 living species, 60 fossil leaf species and time-stratified process-based biogeography

uncertaintyItems.statement: The broad 66–11.63 Ma display window summarizes a modelled transition and is not one dated extinction pulse
Fossil omissions, uncertain placements and model assumptions can alter dates, ancestral areas and inferred local extirpation counts

title: Ginkgo-like wood from the Tiaojishan Formation
titleZh: 天义山组的银杏样木材
summary: The isolated wood PB22285 from the 153–165 Ma Tiaojishan Formation of western Liaoning was named Ginkgoxylon liaoningense from its wood-anatomical characters. It is a dated Ginkgo-like wood record, not a whole plant, a first appearance of Ginkgophyta or a secure match to any particular co-occurring leaf species.
summaryZh: 辽西天义山组（153–165 Ma）的孤立木材标本 PB22285，依据木材解剖特征被命名为 Ginkgoxylon liaoningense。它是一条有年代约束的银杏样木材记录，并非完整植株、银杏门首现证据，也无法可靠匹配到某一共存叶化石种。

evidenceItems.statement: Specimen PB22285, Tiaojishan stratigraphy and wood anatomy illustrated in transverse, tangential and radial section

uncertaintyItems.statement: The isolated wood cannot be safely linked to any particular co-occurring Ginkgo foliage species
A 153–165 Ma specimen does not establish the first appearance of Ginkgophyta or continuous survival of Ginkgo biloba from the Jurassic

title: A hemispheric pattern in living-conifer time trees
titleZh: 现生针叶树时间树中的半球差异
regions: Northern and Southern Hemisphere living-species sample
summary: A fossil-calibrated time tree sampling 489 living conifer species gives a combined median extant-node age of 8.7 Ma for predominantly Southern Hemisphere lineages, including Araucariaceae, versus 5.2 Ma for sampled Northern Hemisphere Pinaceae and Cupressoideae. These are modelled ages of living-lineage nodes, not fossil ranges or family-origin dates.
summaryZh: 一棵经化石校准、取样 489 个现生针叶树物种的时间树显示：以南半球为主、包括南洋杉科在内的谱系，其现生节点合并中位年龄为 8.7 Ma；取样的北半球松科与柏亚科为 5.2 Ma。这些是现生谱系节点的模型年代，不是化石延限或科的起源时间。

evidenceItems.statement: 489 living conifer species and 16 fossil calibrations yield combined medians of 8.7 versus 5.2 Ma

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed endpoints are comparative median node ages, not the duration of one radiation event or the origin of Araucariaceae
Absolute ages may be biased young, Gnetales were excluded and the proposed climate mechanism remains interpretive

title: How fossil calibrations change the angiosperm clock
titleZh: 化石校准如何改变被子植物冠群年代估计
summary: A 2026 molecular-clock analysis combined 25,685 non-pollen fossil occurrences with 110 calibrations for a tree of 644 species and 83 genes. Its preferred hard-bound run estimated crown Angiospermae at 152.99–151.46 Ma; soft-bound and skew-T treatments gave 172.53–158.45 Ma and 261.26–212.30 Ma. These are calibration-dependent divergence estimates, not observed Jurassic flowers or fossil first appearances.
summaryZh: 一项 2026 年分子钟分析将 25,685 条非花粉化石记录用于 110 个校准，并以 83 个基因构建包含 644 个物种的系统树。作者偏好的硬边界分析估计被子植物冠群为 152.99–151.46 Ma；软边界和偏斜 T 分布处理分别得到 172.53–158.45 Ma 与 261.26–212.30 Ma。这些是依赖校准方案的分化时间估计，不是已观察到的侏罗纪花朵或化石首次出现。

evidenceItems.statement: 25,685 fossil occurrences informed 110 calibrations on a 644-species, 83-gene phylogeny

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed 152.99–151.46 Ma interval is the authors' preferred hard-bound strategy; soft-bound and skew-T strategies yielded 172.53–158.45 Ma and 261.26–212.30 Ma
The result is a calibration-dependent crown model, not a directly observed Jurassic flower or fossil first appearance

title: Montsechia and evidence for a submerged habit
titleZh: Montsechia 的沉水生活证据
regions: El Montsec and Las Hoyas, Spain
summary: More than 1,000 Barremian specimens of *Montsechia vidalii* preserve flexible leafy axes and closed, single-seeded fruits. Their thin cuticle, rare stomata, freshwater-limestone setting and morphology support a submerged freshwater habit. A proposed position near *Ceratophyllum* remains a morphology-based hypothesis, and this extinct plant alone cannot establish the ecology of the angiosperm ancestor. The paper reported deposits at about 130–125 Ma; the event's current Barremian boundaries use a different age scale.
summaryZh: 巴列姆期一千余件 *Montsechia vidalii* 标本保存了柔性带叶枝轴和闭合单籽果实。薄角质层、稀少气孔、淡水石灰岩沉积背景及形态特征共同支持其沉水淡水生活的解释。它与 *Ceratophyllum* 的近缘位置仍是基于形态的假说；单凭这一灭绝植物也无法确定被子植物祖先的生态。论文将沉积年代报告为约 130–125 Ma；事件展示所用的现行巴列姆期界线来自不同的年代标尺。

evidenceItems.statement: More than 1,000 specimens with flexible axes, thin cuticles, rare stomata and closed single-seeded fruits

uncertaintyItems.statement: A morphology-based position near Ceratophyllum is a hypothesis and does not show that the angiosperm ancestor was aquatic
Current Barremian boundaries are used for display; the paper reported the deposits as approximately 130–125 Ma

title: Cratolirion preserved from roots to reproductive organs
titleZh: 从根到生殖器官：Cratolirion 的整株保存
summary: A Cratolirion bognerianum fossil from Brazil’s Crato Formation, about 115 Ma, preserves roots, narrow parallel-veined leaves, vascular anatomy and three-part reproductive organs in one plant. The combined anatomy supports a crown-monocot placement; it does not date the origin of monocots or establish membership in a living lily family.
summaryZh: 巴西克拉托组约 115 Ma 的 Cratolirion bognerianum 化石，在同一植株中保存根、狭长平行脉叶、维管解剖和三基数生殖器官。整体解剖支持其属于单子叶植物冠群；这并不等于测定单子叶植物起源，也不能把它归入现生百合科。

evidenceItems.statement: Root system, narrow parallel-veined leaves, vascular anatomy and trimerous reproductive organs preserved in one plant

uncertaintyItems.statement: Cratolirion is a fossil crown monocot, not proof of the first monocot or an assignment to a living lily family

title: A whole-plant fossil and the limits of Leefructus
titleZh: Leefructus 全株化石与分类边界
regions: Lower Yixian Formation, western Liaoning, China
summary: Leefructus mirus from a 125.8–122.6 Ma bed in the Lower Yixian Formation preserves deeply trilobate leaves and an axillary reproductive axis ending in five long, narrow, partly united carpels. The linked leaves and reproductive structure support an Early Cretaceous eudicot assignment. Ranunculaceae was proposed from morphology, but that family affinity remains provisional; one locality does not establish the global first appearance of eudicots.
summaryZh:
早白垩世义县组一层、年代为 125.8–122.6 Ma 的地层中发现了 Leefructus mirus。化石把深裂成三叶的叶片与叶腋生殖轴保存在同一植物结构中；轴端有五枚狭长、部分合生的心皮。叶和生殖结构共同支持将它归入早白垩世真双子叶植物。

研究者依据形态提出毛茛科亲缘关系，但这一科级归属仍属暂定解释。单一地点的一种植物化石也不能确定真双子叶植物的全球首现时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype and reconstruction link diagnostic leaves to an axillary reproductive axis with five long, narrow carpels

uncertaintyItems.statement: Ranunculaceae affinity was suggested from morphology; it is not an uncontested family assignment or the global first appearance of eudicots

title: Grass phytoliths trace a Great Plains C3–C4 shift
titleZh: 植硅体记录大平原 C3–C4 禾草变化
regions: Central Great Plains, Nebraska and Kansas, United States
summary: Fourteen selected palaeosol assemblages from Nebraska and Kansas record an increase in chloridoid-type and other potentially C4 PACMAD grass short cells between 8 and 5.5 Ma. By about 5.5 Ma, these forms made up roughly 50–60% of the grass component in the sampled mixed C3–C4 habitats; the signal is regional, and these morphologies do not all diagnose C4 photosynthesis.
summaryZh: 内布拉斯加州和堪萨斯州 14 个精选古土壤植硅体组合记录了 8–5.5 Ma 间虎尾草亚科型及其他可能属于 C4 的 PACMAD 禾草短细胞增加。到约 5.5 Ma，这些形态约占所采样 C3–C4 混合生境禾草组分的 50–60%；这是区域性信号，而且这些形态并非都能诊断 C4 光合途径。

evidenceItems.statement: By about 5.5 Ma, chloridoid and other potentially C4 PACMAD grass short cells reached roughly 50–60% of the grass component

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 50–60% estimate is within the grass component, not total vegetation, and PACMAD-type morphologies are not all diagnostic of C4 photosynthesis
Fourteen selected assemblages from the central Great Plains do not establish a synchronous continental or global transition

title: Qianodus tooth whorls from the late Aeronian
titleZh: 晚埃隆期的黔齿鱼牙旋
summary: Twenty-three isolated tooth whorls of Qianodus duplicis, including holotype IVPP V26641, come from the late Aeronian Ozarkodina guizhouensis biozone of the Rongxi Formation, about 439 Ma. Their teeth were added in offset rows from the tongue side, preserving a close-up record of jawed-vertebrate dentition. The whorls support a stem-chondrichthyan occurrence, but no articulated body or jaw is known; scales and spines found nearby cannot be assigned to Qianodus. This is not a crown-shark body, the origin of jaws, or a global first-appearance date.
summaryZh: 包括正模 IVPP V26641 在内的 23 个 Qianodus duplicis 孤立牙旋，来自融溪组晚埃隆期 Ozarkodina guizhouensis 牙形石带，约 4.39 亿年前。牙齿从舌侧以错列方式添加，留下了有颌脊椎动物齿列的局部记录。这些牙旋支持软骨鱼干群出现的解释，但目前没有关节连接的躯体或颌；同层发现的鳞片和棘刺也无法归到 Qianodus。它们不是冠群鲨类完整身体、有颌类起源证据或全球首现年代。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V26641 and referred tooth whorls preserve non-shedding teeth added lingually in offset rows

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; tooth-whorl development and histology

evidenceItems.statement: The Rongxi Formation occurrence lies in the Ozarkodina guizhouensis conodont biozone, late Aeronian, at approximately 439 Ma

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Supplementary Information: Geological setting and biostratigraphy

uncertaintyItems.statement: No articulated body or jaw is known, and co-occurring scales and spines cannot be assigned to or excluded from Qianodus
The specimen-level occurrence supports early direct gnathostome dental evidence, not the origin or global FAD of jaws, Chondrichthyes or crown sharks

title: Fanjingshania’s dermoskeleton and shoulder remodelling
titleZh: Fanjingshania 的皮骨骼与肩部重塑
summary: Fanjingshania is known from holotype IVPP V27433.1 and more than a thousand isolated elements, in a record dated to about 439 Ma. Tomography of six referred shoulder elements documents cyclical resorption of bone and dentine. The remains do not form an articulated skeleton or include associated teeth.
summaryZh: Fanjingshania 的记录包括正模 IVPP V27433.1 和一千多件分离骨骼，年代约为 4.39 亿年前。对六件归入该属的肩部骨骼进行断层扫描，显示骨和牙本质发生周期性吸收。这些遗骸并非关节连接的完整骨架，也没有伴生牙齿。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V27433.1 is a pinnal shoulder plate portion fused to a pectoral fin-spine fragment, with more than one thousand isolated referred elements

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology: Holotype, referred material, locality and horizon

evidenceItems.statement: Specimens IVPP V27433.8–12 and V27434.2 reveal five growth centres and cyclical resorption and remodelling of bone and dentine in the spine–plate complex

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: structure and development; Discussion: dermal skeletal remodelling

uncertaintyItems.statement: The material is disarticulated and no assignable dentition is known, so the full-body reconstruction remains comparative rather than specimen-complete
Fanjingshania is treated as a stem chondrichthyan and cannot be synonymized with Qianodus or presented as a crown shark from co-occurrence alone

title: Xiushanosteus: an articulated fish with a mosaic skull roof
titleZh: 秀山鱼：关节相连的小型鱼与镶嵌式颅顶
regions: Huixingshao Formation, Yongdong, Xiushan, Chongqing, China
summary: The Huixingshao Formation yielded holotype IVPP V300001 and 20 referred specimens preserving an articulated fish about 30 mm long, dated to roughly 436 Ma in the middle-to-late Telychian. Its skull roof brings together features otherwise found across placoderm grades, including paired bones arranged in a pattern approaching osteichthyans. The study treats placoderms as an evolutionary grade, and early jawed-vertebrate relationships remain unsettled; this fossil does not identify a direct ancestor or set a global first appearance.
summaryZh:
重庆灰砂岩组发现的模式标本 IVPP V300001 和 20 件归入标本，保存了约 30 毫米长、仍有关节连接的鱼体。它们来自惠兴绍组，年代约为 4.36 亿年前的特列奇期中晚期。头甲骨片的排列呈现一种镶嵌：若干特征分散见于不同级别的盾皮鱼，而成对骨片的排列接近硬骨鱼的模式。

这项研究把盾皮鱼视为演化级群，而非一个由单一共同祖先定义的自然类群；早期有颌脊椎动物之间的关系仍未厘清。因此，化石提供的是具体标本的形态组合，不是某个现生类群的直接祖先，也不能据此确定全球首现时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V300001 and referred specimens IVPP V300002–V300021 preserve articulated or near-complete bodies from the middle-to-late Telychian Huixingshao Formation

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology: material, locality and horizon

evidenceItems.statement: The skull roof combines character states otherwise distributed among major placoderm grades and approaches the osteichthyan pattern in the arrangement of paired bones

uncertaintyItems.statement: Placoderms form an evolutionary grade in the study and early stem-gnathostome relationships remain weakly resolved, so Xiushanosteus is not presented as a direct ancestor
Its abundance within one Lagerstätte is not evidence of global ecological dominance or a global FAD for placoderms or jawed vertebrates

title: Shenacanthus pairs shark-like traits with heavy armour
titleZh: Shenacanthus 将软骨鱼样特征与大型甲胄并置
regions: Huixingshao Formation, Yongdong, Xiushan, Chongqing, China
summary:
The near-complete holotype IVPP V300000 from China’s roughly 436-million-year-old Huixingshao Formation combines minute scales, a chondrichthyan-like rear branchial region and large thoracic armour plates. Its body plan places familiar fish features beside a substantial armoured covering, a combination documented in one specimen.

Only this specimen is known, and it preserves no teeth. Maximum-parsimony and Bayesian analyses differ over its precise position within the chondrichthyan total group. The mosaic is not a crown-shark diagnosis and does not establish the global first appearance of Chondrichthyes.
summaryZh:
中国约 4.36 亿年前回星哨组的近完整正模 IVPP V300000，将微小鳞片、软骨鱼样后鳃区和大型胸部甲板组合在一起。一件标本所记录的体制把熟悉的鱼类结构与厚重甲胄并置。

目前只发现这一件标本，而且没有保存牙齿。最大简约法和贝叶斯分析对它在软骨鱼总群中的精确位置并不一致。这种结构组合不是冠群鲨类的诊断，也不能确立软骨鱼纲的全球首现。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V300000 preserves a near-complete body with minute scales, no facial dermal bones, a chondrichthyan-like posterior branchial region and macromeric thoracic armour

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology and description of Shenacanthus

uncertaintyItems.statement: Only one specimen is known and no teeth are preserved; maximum-parsimony and Bayesian analyses differ in the details of its position within the chondrichthyan total group
The mosaic body plan is not a crown-shark diagnosis and does not establish the global first appearance of Chondrichthyes

title: A mosaic anatomy in one Devonian shark relative
titleZh: 一种泥盆纪软骨鱼近亲的镶嵌式解剖
regions: Lower Plattenkalk, Unterthal, Bergisch Gladbach, Germany
summary: The single specimen UMZC 2000.32, from the Lower Plattenkalk at about 385 million years old, preserves parts of the skull, jaws, gill skeleton, pectoral girdle, cartilage, scales and teeth. CT imaging and histology reveal a mixture of features associated with placoderms, bony fishes and chondrichthyans; a phylogenetic analysis places Gladbachus on the chondrichthyan stem. The fossil is dorsoventrally compressed and its tail is missing, so total length and feeding interpretations remain reconstructions. One stem species does not establish the anatomy or ancestry of crown sharks.
summaryZh: 约 3.85 亿年前下板状灰岩中的唯一标本 UMZC 2000.32 保存了部分头骨、颌、鳃骨架、胸带、软骨、鳞片和牙齿。CT 成像与组织学显示，它兼有与盾皮鱼、硬骨鱼和软骨鱼相关的特征；系统发育分析将格拉德巴赫鱼置于软骨鱼干群。化石受到背腹压扁且缺失尾部，因此全长和摄食方式仍属复原。一个干群物种不能确定冠群鲨类的解剖或祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: UMZC 2000.32 preserves portions of the neurocranium, jaws, hyoid and gill arches, pectoral girdle, cartilage, scales and teeth in the Upper Givetian Lower Plattenkalk

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Material and methods: Specimens; Results: specimen description

evidenceItems.statement: The study's phylogenetic analysis recovers Gladbachus on the chondrichthyan stem despite its anatomically incongruent character combination

uncertaintyItems.statement: The caudal region is missing and the fossil is dorsoventrally compressed, so total body length and suspension-feeding ecology are reconstructions rather than direct observations

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen condition; anatomical reconstruction; Discussion of feeding

uncertaintyItems.statement: The event documents one stem chondrichthyan and cannot date the crown group, a shark-like body-plan origin or a global first appearance

title: A Devonian lamprey mouth preserved in Priscomyzon
titleZh: Priscomyzon 保存的泥盆纪七鳃鳗口部
regions: Waterloo Farm, Witpoort Formation, Eastern Cape, South Africa
summary: The 4.2 cm holotype AM5750 of Priscomyzon riniensis, from Famennian strata dated to about 360 Ma, preserves a large oral disc, fourteen circumoral teeth and a branchial basket. It documents a Devonian member of the lamprey total group, but does not establish a crown-group first appearance, parasitic feeding, migration or an ammocoete lifecycle.
summaryZh: Priscomyzon riniensis 正模 AM5750 长 4.2 厘米，出自约 360 Ma 的法门期地层，保存大型口盘、14 枚口周齿和鳃篮。它记录了泥盆纪七鳃鳗总群成员，但不能确立冠群七鳃鳗的首现时间，也未直接证明寄生摄食、洄游或沙隐幼体生命周期。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype AM5750 preserves a large oral disc with fourteen circumoral teeth and a well-defined branchial basket in a 4.2 cm body
The specimen comes from the Famennian Witpoort Formation at Waterloo Farm, approximately 360 Ma on the source's numerical framing

uncertaintyItems.statement: A single fossil does not preserve an ammocoete stage, metamorphosis, parasitism or migration and therefore cannot establish a modern lamprey lifecycle
The occurrence is treated as total-group lamprey evidence, not a directly dated crown-Petromyzontida origin or global FAD

title: A Carboniferous fossil at the hagfish stem
titleZh: 石炭纪化石提供盲鳗干群线索
regions: Francis Creek Shale, former Pit 11, Illinois, United States
summary: Two Moscovian Francis Creek Shale fossils—holotype FMNH PF15373 (73.3 mm) and paratype FMNH PF8472 (62.5 mm)—preserve body outlines and soft-tissue traces combining cyclostome features with hagfish specializations. They support a stem or possible total-group hagfish interpretation, not crown Myxini. The material does not establish deep-water habitat, slime production or modern hagfish ecology, and some structures remain equivocal.
summaryZh: 莫斯科期 Francis Creek 页岩中的两件化石——正模 FMNH PF15373（73.3 毫米）和副模 FMNH PF8472（62.5 毫米）——保存身体轮廓与软组织痕迹，兼具圆口类特征和盲鳗特化。它们支持将 Myxinikela 置于盲鳗干群或可能的总群，而不是盲鳗冠群内部。材料不能证明深水栖息、黏液产生或现代盲鳗式生态，部分结构鉴定也仍有歧义。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype FMNH PF15373 and paratype FMNH PF8472 preserve a body outline and soft-tissue traces combining general cyclostome characters with hagfish specializations
The specimens measure 73.3 and 62.5 mm and come from the Moscovian Francis Creek Shale at the former Pit 11 locality

uncertaintyItems.statement: The two specimens preserve differently and the paratype does not contain definitive cartilage, so several anatomical identifications remain equivocal
Myxinikela is a stem or putative total-group hagfish, not a crown Myxini datum; the fossils do not establish deep-sea habitat, slime production or crown-hagfish timing

title: Cheirolepis: what CT scans reveal about an early ray-finned fish
titleZh: CT 扫描揭示了 Cheirolepis 的哪些内骨骼？
regions: Achanarras Limestone, Tynet Burn and Gamrie, Scotland
summary: CT scans of named Cheirolepis trailli specimens from the late Eifelian Achanarras Limestone show parts of the braincase, jaw suspension, pectoral-fin skeleton, and scales. The sample combines early ray-finned-fish traits with other character states. The often displayed 390.4–388.1 Ma range is a numerical conversion of a biostratigraphic assignment on an older timescale, not a direct date on these specimens or a global first appearance for ray-finned fishes.
summaryZh: 来自艾菲尔期晚期 Achanarras 石灰岩的 Cheirolepis trailli 具名标本，经 CT 扫描显露出脑颅、悬颌结构、胸鳍内骨骼和鳞片等部位，呈现早期辐鳍鱼特征与其他性状并存的组合。常见的 390.4–388.1 Ma 数值，是按较早时间标尺将生物地层归属换算为年代，并非对这些标本直接测年，也不代表辐鳍鱼的全球首现。

evidenceItems.statement: NMS.1877.30.5/NHMUK P.62908 preserves the braincase, while NMS.1956.19 preserves the hyomandibula and both pectoral endoskeletal girdles; additional parasphenoid material comes from NHMUK P.4051a/b, MCZ 6039, NHMUK P.66863 and NMS.1892.8.60.

The scanned material shows an imperforate propterygium, an imperforate hyomandibular shaft and peg-and-socket scale articulation alongside character states shared with later ray-finned fishes and osteichthyan outgroups.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Neurocranium; Hyomandibula; Pectoral fin endoskeleton; Body scales

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 390.4–388.1 Ma values are the study's numerical translation of a late Eifelian biostratigraphic assignment using the 2012 timescale, not a direct radiometric date on either specimen.
These specimens do not establish the global first appearance of Actinopterygii, a direct ancestor of living ray-finned fishes or absence of an older unsampled lineage.

title: Fukangichthys shifts a fish-tree calibration
titleZh: Fukangichthys 改变了鱼类系统树的年代校准
regions: Kelamayi Formation, Xinjiang, China; comparative CT sample
summary: CT scans of two *Fukangichthys* fossils, compared with a living ropefish, informed a 2017 analysis that placed Scanilepiformes—including *Fukangichthys*—on the stem leading to bichirs (Polypteridae). This moved the study's minimum fossil calibration for the actinopterygian crown about 45 million years younger. A minimum calibration is a lower age bound, not the group's origin time. The placement depends on sampled fossils and anatomical characters, and differs from a 2014 analysis that placed *Fukangichthys* within Neopterygii. The displayed 247.0–241.464 Ma interval is the current Anisian stage range used for navigation, not a direct date on these specimens.
summaryZh: 研究者对两件 *Fukangichthys* 化石进行 CT 扫描，并与现生多鳍鱼作比较。2017 年的分析据此将包含 *Fukangichthys* 的 Scanilepiformes 放在通往多鳍鱼科（Polypteridae）的干群上；这一位置使研究中辐鳍鱼冠群的化石最小校准向年轻方向移动约 4500 万年。最小校准给出的是年代下限，不是类群的起源时间。该位置取决于取样化石和解剖性状，也不同于 2014 年把 *Fukangichthys* 放入新鳍鱼类的分析。页面显示的 247.0–241.464 Ma 是用于导航的现行安尼期范围，并非这两件标本的直接定年。

evidenceItems.statement: Analyses of Fukangichthys specimens IVPP V4096.6 and IVPP V4096.13, compared with ropefish BMNH 2016.9.22.3, recovered scanilepiforms as stem polypterids and shifted the minimum calibration for crown Actinopterygii about 45 million years younger.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The displayed 247.0–241.464 Ma envelope is the current Anisian stage translation for navigation; it is not a direct date on IVPP V4096.6 or IVPP V4096.13 and does not equal the crown-actinopterygian origin time.

The placement is topology- and character-sampling-sensitive; the 2014 anatomical revision recovered Fukangichthys within Neopterygii, so that earlier result is historical context rather than interchangeable support for the 2017 placement.

title: Genomes place gar and bowfin together
titleZh: 基因组证据如何支持现生全骨鱼类？
regions: Extant comparative genome and transcriptome sample
summary: A matrix of 243 one-to-one proteins from 25 vertebrates, bowfin transcriptomes, and conserved gene order support living gars plus bowfin as Holostei, sister to teleosts. The spotted-gar genome represents a lineage that split before the teleost genome duplication. This is evidence from sampled living genomes, not a fossil date or evidence that gars have remained morphologically unchanged; it also does not show that genome duplication alone caused teleost diversity.
summaryZh: 覆盖 25 种脊椎动物的 243 个单拷贝蛋白矩阵、弓鳍鱼转录组和保守基因排列共同支持现生雀鳝与弓鳍鱼组成全骨鱼类，并与真骨鱼互为姐妹群。斑点雀鳝基因组代表在真骨鱼基因组复制之前分出的谱系。这是现生基因组取样提供的证据，不是化石年代或形态停滞的证明，也不能说明基因组复制单独造成了真骨鱼的多样性。

evidenceItems.statement: A 25-vertebrate phylogenomic matrix of 243 one-to-one proteins (97,794 aligned amino acids), together with bowfin transcriptome data and conserved synteny, supported Holostei and placed gar divergence before the teleost genome duplication.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Genome assembly and annotation; Gar informs vertebrate genome evolution

uncertaintyItems.statement: This is present-day genomic evidence derived from one 90× spotted-gar assembly plus comparative transcriptomes and genomes, not a fossil date, proof of morphological stasis or a complete sample of living holostean variation.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Genome assembly and annotation; Online Methods

uncertaintyItems.statement: Using gar as an outgroup to the teleost genome duplication does not show that duplication alone caused teleost species richness.

title: When did the teleost genome duplicate?
titleZh: 真骨鱼的全基因组复制发生在何时？
summary: Models fitted to 30 pairs of duplicated teleost genes estimate the 3R whole-genome duplication at 286.18–267.20 million years ago. The same study places the crown group of living teleost lineages at 254.36–234.16 million years ago, so its model puts 3R earlier than that interval. These are posterior age estimates, not fossil dates or a single observed instant; delayed rediploidization means different duplicate genes can retain signals of the event on different timescales. The study does not treat the duplication alone as a cause of later teleost diversity.
summaryZh: 研究者用 30 对真骨鱼复制基因拟合模型，将 3R 全基因组复制估计为距今 286.18–267.20 百万年；同一研究把现生真骨鱼冠群估计为 254.36–234.16 百万年前，因此模型结果将 3R 置于该区间之前。这些是后验年代估计，不是化石定年或被直接观察到的瞬时事件。“延迟再二倍化”意味着不同复制基因可能在不同时间尺度上保留该事件的信号；研究也没有把这次复制单独视为后来真骨鱼多样性的成因。

evidenceItems.statement: Independent-locus and gene-birth models applied to 30 ohnologue pairs yielded a 286.18–267.20 Ma 95% highest-posterior-density interval for 3R; the same study estimated crown Teleostei at 254.36–234.16 Ma.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: The age of Ts3R; Discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The interval is a molecular-model posterior, not a fossil occurrence or an instantaneous cytological observation; different duplicates can resolve after prolonged rediploidization, rearrangement and gene loss.
The authors found 3R predating their crown-teleost interval by 12.84–52.02 million years and did not treat the duplication as a sufficient deterministic cause of later teleost diversity.

title: Three fishes widen the Anisian teleosteomorph record
titleZh: 三种鱼扩展了安尼期真骨形类记录
summary: Three named small-bodied fishes from one Middle Triassic locality document anatomical and ecological differences among stem teleosteomorphs. They broaden the diversity known from that place and time; a single locality cannot establish the group’s first appearance worldwide.
summaryZh: 三种具名小型鱼类来自一个中三叠世地点，显示干群真骨形类在解剖和生态上的差异。它们扩展了该地点和时期已知的多样性；单一地点不能确定这一类群在全球最早出现的时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Pseudopholidoctenus (holotype MB.f.18641; paratypes MB.f.19904–19906), Barschichthys (holotype MB.f.19907; MB.f.19908–19909) and Ruedersdorfia (holotype MB.f.19910) preserve distinct character combinations at one approximately 244 Ma locality.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The source assigns these fishes to the stem of Teleosteomorpha/Pan-Teleostei; they are not a global fossil first appearance of crown Teleostei.

The current Anisian stage envelope is broader than the paper's approximate 244 Ma locality age; one quarry cannot establish synchronous global radiation, and small adult size alone does not prove developmental miniaturization.

title: A developmental mosaic in the neopterygian tail fin
titleZh: 新鳍鱼尾鳍的发育镶嵌
regions: Extant comparative developmental and anatomical sample
summary: Adult anatomy and developmental series in sticklebacks, zebrafish, gar, bowfin, paddlefish and bichir reveal a hypural–diastema complex: a gap among the tail-fin bones that support fin rays. Early fin rays also contribute to external symmetry. Because the complex occurs in gars as well as teleosts, it is not an unconditional teleost synapomorphy. Descent with losses, parallel origins and latent parallelism remain alternatives; soft tissues in the complex are rarely visible in fossils.
summaryZh:
研究比较了三刺鱼、斑马鱼、雀鳝、弓鳍鱼、匙吻鲟和多鳍鱼的成体及发育序列，描述出一种下尾骨—间隙复合结构：支撑鳍条的下尾骨之间存在间隙。早期形成的尾鳍鳍条也参与了外部对称轮廓的建立。

由于雀鳝和真骨鱼都具有这一结构，不能把完整复合结构无条件地当作真骨鱼的共有衍征。共同继承后多次丢失、平行起源和潜在平行性仍是不同解释；研究倾向潜在平行性。复合结构中的软组织很少能在化石中保存，因此仅凭骨骼间隙无法完整判断其发育状态。

evidenceItems.statement: Adults and developmental series of stickleback, zebrafish, spotted gar, bowfin, paddlefish and bichir show a gar–teleost hypural-diastema complex and that the earliest caudal lepidotrichia contribute to external fin symmetry.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Presence in gars prevents treating the complete complex as an unconditional teleost synapomorphy; descent with repeated loss, parallel origin and latent homology remain alternative explanations, with the paper favouring latent parallelism.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Discussion: homology by descent and latent homology hypotheses

uncertaintyItems.statement: The complex includes connective tissue and vasculature that fossils seldom preserve, so skeletal gaps alone cannot fully score the living developmental complex.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Definition of the hypural diastema complex; fossil comparison

title: Genome structure tests a deep teleost split
titleZh: 基因组结构检验真骨鱼的一处分支
summary: The study compared seven newly sequenced elopomorph genomes with 18 public genomes. It analysed 955 single-copy gene trees alongside 3,041 chromosome-adjacency markers; the sequence and chromosome-structure approaches supported Elopomorpha plus Osteoglossomorpha as a sister branch to Clupeocephala. This is a topology for sampled living lineages, not a complete species tree. The proposed ancestral chromosome fusion is reconstructed from modern genomes, and the study found no single unambiguous morphological character diagnosing the group.
summaryZh: 研究把 7 个新测序的海鲢总目基因组与 18 个公开基因组比较，分析了 955 棵单拷贝基因树和 3,041 个染色体邻接标记。序列与染色体结构两种方法都支持海鲢总目和骨舌鱼总目构成一支，并与鲱头鱼类互为姐妹群。这只是所取样现生谱系的拓扑，不是完整物种树。推测的祖先染色体融合是从现代基因组重建出来的；研究没有找到唯一且无歧义的形态特征来诊断该支系。

evidenceItems.statement: Seven new elopomorph genomes plus 18 public genomes were analysed with 955 single-copy gene trees and 3,041 adjacency markers; sequence and chromosome-rearrangement methods converged on Elopomorpha plus Osteoglossomorpha.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The result is a topology for the sampled extant lineages, not a complete species-level teleost tree; the paper found no exclusive unambiguous morphological character for the proposed clade.
The inferred ancestral chromosome fusion is reconstructed from extant genome structure and is not a directly observed ancient event or a fossil first appearance.

title: One fossil, a mix of frog-like and salamander-like traits
titleZh: 一件化石兼有似蛙与似蝾螈性状
regions: Clear Fork Group, Baylor County, Texas, USA
summary: The only known specimen of *Gerobatrachus hottoni*, holotype USNM 489135, combines frog-like and salamander-like characters. In the original character analysis, it fell on the batrachian stem: outside the crown group of frogs and salamanders, but closer to them than more distant branches. That placement rests on one specimen and a character matrix, so it is neither proof of a direct ancestor nor a global first appearance. The displayed Kungurian interval follows the current timescale; the paper reported an Early Permian Leonardian age, not a direct radiometric date on the fossil.
summaryZh: 已知唯一的 *Gerobatrachus hottoni* 标本（正模 USNM 489135）兼有似蛙和似蝾螈的性状。在原始性状分析中，它落在蛙螈类干群：位于蛙和蝾螈的冠群之外，但比更远的支系更接近它们。这个位置依据单件标本和一套性状矩阵，不能证明它是直接祖先，也不是全球首现记录。页面显示的昆古尔期范围采用现行地质年代标尺；论文报告的是早二叠世伦纳德阶，并非对化石本身进行的放射性定年。

evidenceItems.statement: USNM 489135 is the sole holotype from USNM locality 40971, Don’s Dump Fish Quarry.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The Kungurian display interval uses the current chart; the source reports Early Permian Leonardian, not a direct radiometric specimen age.

title: A micro-CT view of Triadobatrachus
titleZh: 微型 CT 下的 Triadobatrachus
regions: Middle Sakamena equivalent beds near Betsiaka, Madagascar
summary: Micro-CT imaging of the unique split-nodule holotype MNHN.F.MAE.126 reveals fifteen presacral vertebrae, caudal vertebrae and possible mentomeckelian elements. This anatomy records an early frog-lineage mosaic before crown Anura; it does not demonstrate specialized jumping.
summaryZh: 对唯一的分裂结核正模 MNHN.F.MAE.126 进行微型 CT 成像，显示十五枚荐前椎、尾椎以及可能的麦氏软骨。该解剖组合记录了冠群无尾目出现之前的蛙类谱系早期形态，但不能证明其具有特化跳跃能力。

evidenceItems.statement: MNHN.F.MAE.126 is the unique part-and-counterpart holotype with caudal vertebrae and fifteen presacrals.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Material; anatomy; trunk evolution; calibration review

uncertaintyItems.statement: The Late Induan–early Olenekian provenance is historical and imprecise; neither crown Anura nor specialized jumping is directly established.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Material; anatomy; trunk evolution; calibration review

title: Funcusvermis in a Norian bonebed
titleZh: 诺利期骨床中的 Funcusvermis
regions: Thunderstorm Ridge, upper Blue Mesa Member, Chinle Formation, Arizona, USA
summary: At least 76 individuals are represented by isolated, three-dimensionally preserved jaws, vertebrae and femora from a U–Pb-bracketed Norian bonebed in Arizona. The fossils support a caecilian total-group occurrence outside crown Gymnophiona; they do not form one articulated animal, and this locality is not a global first-appearance date.
summaryZh: 亚利桑那州一处经 U–Pb 年龄约束的诺利阶骨层中，至少 76 个个体由分散保存且具三维结构的颌骨、椎骨和股骨代表。这些化石支持蚓螈总群的出现记录，但位置在现生蚓螈冠群之外；它们不是一具关节相连的完整动物，也不构成全球首次出现日期。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype PEFO 43891 and named paratypes/referred elements include jaws, vertebrae and femora.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; locality and geochronology; phylogeny

uncertaintyItems.statement: The assemblage is not one articulated animal; published analyses place it outside crown Gymnophiona and the locality is not a global FAD.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; locality and geochronology; phylogeny

title: Six Beiyanerpeton specimens from the Oxfordian
titleZh: 牛津期 Beiyanerpeton 的六件标本
regions: Tiaojishan Formation, Hengdaozi, western Liaoning, China
summary: Six articulated Beiyanerpeton specimens document a salamandroid occurrence in the Oxfordian. Preserved larval structures were interpreted as neoteny, the persistence of juvenile features into later development; that conclusion is inferred from the fossils rather than observed life history.
summaryZh: 六件关节连接的 Beiyanerpeton 标本记录了牛津期的有尾类化石。其幼体结构被解释为幼态延续，即幼年特征保留到后续发育阶段；这一结论来自化石推断，而不是对其生活史的直接观察。

evidenceItems.statement: PKUP V0601 is the holotype; PKUP V0602–V0606 are referred specimens.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 157 ± 3 Ma U–Pb date comes from overlying trachyandesite, and both neoteny and placement remain interpretations.

title: Ymboirana: a provisional Oligocene caecilian assignment
titleZh: Ymboirana 的渐新世蚓螈归属仍属暂定
regions: Tremembé Formation near Tremembé, São Paulo, Brazil
summary: The part-and-counterpart holotype DGM 1462-R preserves a skull, mandibles, the atlas (first neck vertebra) and 66 trunk vertebrae. CT-informed comparisons support assigning the roughly 25-million-year-old fossil to Typhlonectidae, a living aquatic caecilian family, but the skeleton is damaged and no unambiguous family-level synapomorphy was identified. Formal phylogenetic testing remains pending. The proposed aquatic affinity is a classification hypothesis, not preserved behaviour.
summaryZh: 正模 DGM 1462-R 由正反两面标本组成，保存了头骨、上下颌、寰椎（第一节颈椎）和 66 节躯干椎骨。结合 CT 扫描进行的比较支持把这件约 2500 万年前的化石暂归入现生水栖蚓螈科，但标本有破损，也没有找到无歧义的科级共有衍征；正式系统发育检验仍待完成。所谓水栖亲缘是分类假说，不是化石直接保存的行为。

evidenceItems.statement: DGM 1462-R is the part-and-counterpart holotype preserving skull, mandibles, atlas and 66 trunk vertebrae.

uncertaintyItems.statement: No unambiguous typhlonectid synapomorphy was identified and formal phylogenetic testing remains pending; aquatic behaviour is not preserved.

title: A draft genome for the living frog Xenopus tropicalis
titleZh: 现生热带爪蟾的草图基因组提供了什么？
regions: Laboratory genome dataset; Nigerian inbred line
summary: A seventh-generation inbred female Xenopus tropicalis yielded about 7.6-fold shotgun coverage and a 1.51-Gbp draft assembly, accession AAMC00000000. The sequence became a genomic reference for comparisons among living vertebrates. It represents one laboratory animal and an incomplete assembly, not an amphibian ancestor, a date for the group’s origin, or every amphibian genome.
summaryZh: 一只第七代近交雌性热带爪蟾提供了约 7.6 倍的鸟枪法测序覆盖，组装得到 1.51 Gbp 的草图基因组，登录号为 AAMC00000000。该序列可作为现生脊椎动物比较研究的基因组参考。它代表一只实验动物和一份未完成的组装，不是两栖类祖先、类群起源年代，也不代表所有两栖动物基因组。

evidenceItems.statement: A seventh-generation inbred female yielded about 7.6-fold shotgun coverage, 1.51 Gbp of scaffolds and assembly accession AAMC00000000.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The genome is not a direct record of amphibian ancestors, divergence time, every amphibian genome or universal phenotype.

title: Thyroid-receptor knockouts separate tail and hindlimb effects
titleZh: 甲状腺激素受体敲除区分尾部与后肢效应
summary: In Xenopus tropicalis, knockout experiments separated the effects of two thyroid-hormone receptor subtypes. Loss of TRβ delayed tail regression and extracellular-matrix degradation; loss of TRα advanced hindlimb development while the tail followed a largely normal trajectory. Histology and expression assays linked these outcomes to different organs and processes. They are results from this experimental species and design, not a rule for every amphibian or tissue and not an explanation of metamorphosis’s evolutionary origin.
summaryZh: 在 Xenopus tropicalis 中，敲除实验区分了两种甲状腺激素受体亚型的作用。TRβ 缺失会延缓尾部退化和细胞外基质降解；TRα 缺失则使后肢提前发育，而尾部变化大体正常。组织学和基因表达检测分别追踪了这些器官与过程。结论适用于这项实验所用的物种和设计，不能推广到所有两栖动物或组织，也不解释变态的演化起源。

evidenceItems.statement: TRβ knockouts retained healthy notochord five days after stage 62 and showed reduced matrix-degrading expression; TRα knockouts developed hindlimbs precociously.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Effects differ by receptor and organ and cannot be generalized to every amphibian species, tissue or evolutionary origin.

title: A time tree for 7,238 living amphibian species
titleZh: 7,238 种现生两栖动物的时间树
summary: A set of 10,000 model trees represents 7,238 living amphibian species, but the 15-gene matrix includes molecular data for only 4,061; other species are placed softly within taxonomic constraints. The trees compare estimated relationships and times, while unsampled placements and model dates depend on taxonomy and analysis. Their nodes are not fossils or direct observations of species origins.
summaryZh: 这组 10,000 棵模型树覆盖 7,238 个现生两栖动物物种，但 15 基因矩阵只为其中 4,061 种提供分子数据；其余物种依照分类约束作软性放置。时间树可比较估计的亲缘关系与年代，但未取样类群的位置和模型时间仍依赖分类与分析设定。树上的节点不是化石，也不是物种起源的直接观测。

evidenceItems.statement: The 15-gene matrix contains 4,061 amphibian species; remaining species were softly placed within taxonomic constraints.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Model nodes are not fossils or observed origins, and the 2014 taxonomy does not replace current COL26.8 naming coverage.

title: Echinerpeton’s unusually tall neural spine
titleZh: Echinerpeton 的超长神经棘标本
regions: Sydney Mines Formation, Florence, Nova Scotia, Canada
summary: ROM VP 83326 was referred to Echinerpeton intermedium after comparison with paratype RM 10057 and casts and photographs of the type series. Its preserved neural spine is at least 7 cm tall and about 2.3 mm wide. The 308.5–305.5 Ma interval is the approximate age envelope of the Sydney Mines Formation, not a direct date on this specimen. With the centrum and most of the skeleton absent, body proportions and proposed display, recognition or thermoregulatory functions remain hypotheses; this specimen does not identify a direct mammalian ancestor.
summaryZh:
ROM VP 83326 为什么被归入 Echinerpeton intermedium？研究者将它与副模标本 RM 10057，以及模式系列的铸型和照片直接比较。保留下来的神经棘至少高 7 厘米、宽约 2.3 毫米；但标本没有保存椎体和大部分骨骼，完整体形与神经棘相对身体的比例只能复原。

论文给出的 308.5–305.5 Ma 是悉尼矿组的大致年代范围，不是对这件标本的直接测年。展示、识别或体温调节等功能只是待检验的解释；单凭这件不完整标本，无法确定“帆”的功能，也不能把它认作哺乳动物的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: ROM VP 83326 was referred to Echinerpeton intermedium after direct comparison with paratype RM 10057 and type-series casts and photographs; its preserved spine is at least 7 cm tall and about 2.3 mm wide.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 308.5–305.5 Ma display interval is the paper's approximate Sydney Mines Formation envelope, not a direct radiometric date on ROM VP 83326 or a global Synapsida first appearance.

Because the centrum and most of the skeleton are absent, the reconstructed spine-to-centrum ratio and proposed display, recognition or thermoregulatory roles are estimates and hypotheses, not observed function or evidence of a direct mammalian ancestor.

title: Raranimus at the base of one sampled therapsid tree
titleZh: Raranimus 在一项兽孔类分析中处于什么位置？
regions: Dashankou locality, Xidagou Formation, Gansu, China
summary: The holotype IVPP V15424 is a slightly crushed snout about 100 mm long. In a published matrix of 71 morphological characters, four shortest trees placed Raranimus just outside the other sampled therapsids. That is a result of one taxon-and-character sample, not direct ancestry. The displayed 274.4–264.28 Ma envelope is a broad stage-based translation; the source reports no reliable radiometric date for the Dashankou sequence.
summaryZh: 正模 IVPP V15424 是一段略受压扁、约 100 毫米长的吻部。在一项包含 71 个形态性状的已发表矩阵中，四棵最短树都把 Raranimus 放在其余已取样兽孔类之外。这个结果取决于该次类群与性状取样，并非直接祖先关系。显示的 274.4–264.28 Ma 是宽泛的阶级换算区间；原研究指出大山口层序没有可靠的放射性年龄。

evidenceItems.statement: IVPP V15424 is a roughly 100 mm partial, slightly crushed snout with a combination of cranial and dental characters; four shortest PAUP trees from the published 71-character matrix placed Raranimus immediately outside the remaining sampled Therapsida.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The recovered sister position belongs to one morphology matrix and its taxon-character sampling; it is not direct observation of ancestry, and the paper's Laurasian-origin interpretation remains a biogeographic hypothesis.

The 274.4–264.28 Ma display envelope is a broad current Middle Permian stage translation; the source explicitly reports no reliable radiometric dates for the Dashankou sequence, so it cannot establish a precise therapsid first appearance.

title: Haramiyavia and a matrix-defined mammal boundary
titleZh: Haramiyavia 与矩阵分析界定的哺乳动物边界
regions: Tait Bjerg Beds, Fleming Fjord Formation, East Greenland
summary: What places Haramiyavia on one side or the other of the mammal crown? CT scans of mandibles MCZ7/95A–B and maxilla MCZ10/G95, together with a three-dimensional reconstruction of tooth wear, informed the revised MorphoBank Project 2292 character matrix. In that analysis, Late Triassic haramiyids fell outside crown Mammalia. A postdentary trough supports an interpretation involving the jaw and middle ear, but the auditory bones are not preserved in articulation; both the placement and the ear inference remain tied to anatomy and scoring.
summaryZh: 什么证据把 Haramiyavia 放在哺乳动物冠群边界的一侧？研究对下颌 MCZ7/95A–B 和上颌 MCZ10/G95 进行 CT 扫描，并以三维方式复原牙齿磨耗，随后用于修订 MorphoBank 2292 性状矩阵。在该分析中，晚三叠世贼兽类位于哺乳动物冠群之外。齿骨后沟支持下颌与中耳相连的解释，但听小骨并未关节连接地保存；系统位置和耳部解释都仍受解剖观察与性状编码所限。

evidenceItems.statement: CT scans and three-dimensional occlusal reconstruction of mandibles MCZ7/95A–B and maxilla MCZ10/G95 documented the dentary condyle, postdentary trough and tooth-wear geometry used in the study's MorphoBank Project 2292 character matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results; Materials and Methods; SI Materials and Methods

uncertaintyItems.statement: The postdentary trough supports a mandibular-middle-ear interpretation, but the auditory ossicles are not preserved in articulation; the event therefore separates observed jaw anatomy from an ear-function inference.

Placement outside crown Mammalia is a result of the published matrix and rescoring, not an intrinsic label carried by the fossil or a universal calibration; competing haramiyidan placements require explicit alternative analyses.

title: The mammalian jaw joint did not follow one ladder
titleZh: 哺乳动物颌关节演化并非单一路径
regions: Riograndia Assemblage Zone, Candelária Sequence, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil
summary: Micro-CT scans of 26 specimens found a dentary–squamosal contact in Riograndia but not Brasilodon. This distribution supports repeated, independent acquisition rather than a simple one-way ladder of jaw-joint transformation; the contact alone is not a complete jaw joint or proof of crown-mammal status.
summaryZh: 对 26 件标本的显微 CT 扫描在 Riograndia 中发现齿骨—鳞骨接触，在 Brasilodon 中则未发现。这种分布支持相关结构曾多次独立出现，而非沿单一阶梯逐步转变；仅有接触并不等于完整颌关节，也不能证明属于冠群哺乳动物。

evidenceItems.statement: μCT reconstructions of Riograndia specimens MPDC-1B1, UFRGS-PV-596-T, UFRGS-PV-833-T and UFRGS-PV-1319-T show dentary–squamosal contact, whereas the nine-specimen Brasilodon sample, including UFRGS-PV-929-T, -1030-T and -1043-T, lacks that articulation.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cranial anatomy of Brasilodon; Cranial anatomy of Riograndia; Evolution of the mammalian jaw joint
Dataset record; segmented models, videos and phylogenetic matrices

uncertaintyItems.statement: Contact in Riograndia does not have the full condyle–glenoid morphology of the mammaliaform joint and does not confer crown-mammal membership; proposed bracing or synovial function remains an anatomical inference.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cranial anatomy of Riograndia; Evolution of the mammalian jaw joint
