uncertaintyItems.statement: 225.42 ± 0.37 Ma is reported as a maximum depositional age for the fossil-bearing assemblage, not a direct date on any skull; the displayed younger boundary is a broad Norian navigation limit and not a fossil LAD.

title: Two mammaliaform fossils trace a jaw–ear shift
titleZh: 两件哺乳形类化石呈现颌与耳的变化
regions: Lufeng Formation, Yunnan, and Daohugou Beds, Inner Mongolia, China
summary: The Dianoconodon holotype (IVPP V4257) and a Feredocodon paratype (IMMNH-PV01925) preserve jaw-joint and postdentary bones used to compare load-bearing before the middle ear became fully detached from the jaw. Reduced loading is an anatomical inference, not a measurement of bite force or hearing. Their combined 201.4–161.5 Ma range spans separate fossils and formations, not a continuous lineage.
summaryZh: Dianoconodon 正模 IVPP V4257 与 Feredocodon 副模 IMMNH-PV01925 保存了颌关节及齿骨后方的骨骼，可比较中耳完全脱离下颌之前的承力变化。承力减弱是依据解剖结构作出的推断，并非咬合力或听力的直接测量。两者合并标示的 201.4–161.5 Ma 区间跨越不同化石与地层，不代表连续谱系。

evidenceItems.statement: Dianoconodon holotype IVPP V4257 and Feredocodon paratype IMMNH-PV01925 preserve articular, quadrate, dentary and postdentary anatomy used in MorphoBank Project 5075 and the archived phylogenetic analyses to compare jaw–ear configurations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cranial morphology; Jaw joint and middle ear; Methods

uncertaintyItems.statement: Reduced load-bearing and improved auditory suitability are inferred from morphology and finite comparative anatomy rather than directly measured hearing or bite forces in the fossils.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Jaw joint and middle ear; Discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 201.4–161.5 Ma event range is a composite envelope spanning two fossils from separate formations and times; it is not one population, a continuous sequence, a direct ancestor–descendant pair or a crown-Mammalia origin interval.

title: A middle-ear connection that still ran to the lower jaw
titleZh: 中耳骨仍与下颌相连的化石证据
summary: The near-complete Liaoconodon hui holotype IVPP V16051 preserves an unusual connection between the middle ear and lower jaw. Its ectotympanic and malleus bones are no longer in direct contact with the dentary, yet ossified Meckel's cartilage still links them. This is an observation from one articulated fossil; a proposed stabilizing role for the connection is a functional hypothesis. It does not make Liaoconodon a universal step in mammal evolution or a direct ancestor of living mammals.
summaryZh: 近完整的 Liaoconodon hui 正模标本 IVPP V16051 保存了一种特殊的中耳—下颌连接：外鼓骨和锤骨已不再直接接触齿骨，却仍由骨化的麦氏软骨相连。这是单件关节相连化石中的观察；连接可能有稳定作用只是功能假说。它不意味着 Liaoconodon 是哺乳动物演化的普遍阶段或现生哺乳动物的直接祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The near-complete articulated holotype IVPP V16051 preserves the ectotympanic and malleus without direct dentary attachment but connected to the dentary through an ossified Meckel's cartilage.

uncertaintyItems.statement: A proposed stabilizing role for the ossified Meckelian cartilage is a functional hypothesis from one fossil configuration; it does not make Liaoconodon a universal stage or a direct ancestor of living mammals.
The Aptian display envelope is a navigation translation of the formation-level Early Cretaceous occurrence, not a direct date on IVPP V16051 or evidence that all mammalian middle ears detached then.

title: Living experiments on Meckel’s cartilage
titleZh: 现生实验如何检验麦氏软骨降解
regions: Laboratory mouse and gray short-tailed opossum developmental series
summary: Experiments in c-Fos mutant mice and in the opossum Monodelphis domestica inhibited clast cells, which resorb cartilage and bone. Meckel’s cartilage then persisted or ossified, and a jaw–ear connection remained. These are developmental perturbations in living mammals: they identify a role for clast cells but do not show that the same cellular mechanism produced any particular fossil condition or operates identically across Mammalia.
summaryZh:
在 c-Fos 突变小鼠中，以及在有袋类 Monodelphis domestica 中药理抑制 clast 细胞后，麦克尔软骨持续存在或发生骨化，颌与耳之间的连接也保留下来。clast 细胞参与吸收软骨和骨组织；这些实验显示它们在现生哺乳动物发育中有作用。

实验是对现生动物发育过程的干预，并没有直接观察任何化石中的细胞机制。它不能证明同一机制造成了某一件古代颌耳结构，也不能据此断言所有哺乳动物都以完全相同的方式发育。

evidenceItems.statement: c-Fos mutant mice retained and ossified Meckel's cartilage, while pharmacological inhibition of clast cells in Monodelphis domestica likewise delayed cartilage breakdown and produced a persistent jaw–ear connection phenotype.

uncertaintyItems.statement: These are present-day developmental perturbations in two living mammals: phenotype similarity does not mean ontogeny literally repeats the fossil record or prove that the same cellular mechanism produced any particular fossil jaw–ear condition.
The study identifies a role for clast cells but notes additional remodelling mechanisms and unresolved recruitment signals, so the mechanism is not treated as complete or universal across Mammalia.

title: Cartorhynchus: a mosaic preserved in one skeleton
titleZh: Cartorhynchus 正模保存的结构组合
regions: Upper member of the Nanlinghu Formation, Chaohu, Anhui, China
summary: The articulated holotype AGM I-1 is about 40 centimetres long. It combines a short snout and robust trunk with large flippers and thick cortical bone in the ribs and limbs. Those are observations from one specimen; amphibious habits and suction feeding are interpretations drawn from anatomy and comparison. A published corrigendum corrected character descriptions and tree statistics while retaining the reported topology. The fossil is not shown to be a direct ancestor or a global first appearance.
summaryZh: 关节相连的正模 AGM I-1 全长约 40 厘米，兼有短吻、粗壮躯干、大鳍肢，以及肋骨和肢骨较厚的皮质骨。这些是单件标本保存的结构；两栖生活和吸食方式则是依据解剖与比较提出的解释。后续勘误修正了性状描述和系统树统计量，但保留原报告的拓扑。现有材料没有证明它是其他类群的直系祖先或全球最早记录。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype AGM I-1 preserves an articulated approximately 40-centimetre skeleton with a short rostrum, robust trunk, large flippers and thick cortical bone in the ribs and limbs.

uncertaintyItems.statement: A partly terrestrial lifestyle and suction feeding are anatomical and phylogenetic inferences, not behaviours directly observed in the fossil.

The published corrigendum corrected character descriptions and tree statistics without changing the reported topology; the specimen is not demonstrated to be a direct ancestor or a global first occurrence.

title: Chaohusaurus: pregnancy preserved in a fossil
titleZh: 巢湖鱼龙如何留下妊娠的直接记录？
regions: Majiashan Quarry, Chaohu, Anhui, China; Procolumbites Zone
summary: The Early Triassic specimen AGM I-1 preserves a maternal skeleton, two embryos inside the body, and a neonate beside the pelvis. One embryo lies head-first near the pelvic region. This association directly records pregnancy in Chaohusaurus; the proposed birth orientation and the idea that live birth began on land are interpretations of position and evolutionary context, not observations in the fossil.
summaryZh: 早三叠世标本 AGM I-1 保存了母体骨架、体内两个胚胎，以及骨盆旁的一个新生个体。其中一个胚胎头部朝向骨盆区域。这种组合直接记录了巢湖鱼龙的妊娠；头先娩出以及胎生起源于陆地，仍是依据位置和演化背景提出的解释，而非化石直接显示的过程。

evidenceItems.statement: AGM I-1 contains a maternal skeleton, two embryos within the body and a neonate adjacent to the pelvis; one embryo is positioned head-first in the pelvic region.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Maternal specimen AGM I-1; Embryonic identification

uncertaintyItems.statement: Head-first delivery and a terrestrial origin of viviparity are comparative interpretations of orientation and topology rather than behaviours or ancestral states directly observed in AGM I-1.

title: Skin, blubber-like tissue and pigment in one ichthyosaur
titleZh: 一件鱼龙化石保存的皮肤、脂肪样组织与色素
summary: Microscopy, spectroscopy and molecular analysis of Toarcian specimen MH 432 from Holzmaden identify scaleless skin with epidermal and dermal layers, a subcutaneous adipose layer interpreted as blubber, and melanophores (pigment cells) containing eumelanin, a dark pigment. The pigment pattern has been used to propose countershading, but its appearance and any effects on body temperature or metabolism are interpretations based on living analogues, not directly measured physiology. MH 432 documents one ichthyosaur, not every member of the group.
summaryZh: 研究者用显微、光谱和分子分析检查霍尔茨马登的托阿尔期标本 MH 432，识别出无鳞皮肤的表皮和真皮、被解释为脂肪层的皮下组织，以及含有真黑素（一种深色素）的色素细胞。色素分布被用来提出反荫蔽（背侧较深、腹侧较浅）的解释；其具体体色以及对体温或代谢的影响，仍是依据现生类比作出的推断，并非直接测得的生理。MH 432 只记录了一件鱼龙标本，不能代表整个类群。

evidenceItems.statement: MH 432 preserves scaleless skin with epidermal and dermal layers, a subcutaneous adipose layer interpreted as blubber, and eumelanin-bearing melanophores.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Countershading, thermoregulation and metabolic implications are interpretations built from tissue distribution and living analogues; they are not directly observed physiology or universal conditions for all ichthyosaurs.

title: What Rhaeticosaurus bone tissue can tell us
titleZh: Rhaeticosaurus 的骨组织能告诉我们什么？
regions: Exter Formation, Bonenburg, North Rhine-Westphalia, Germany
summary: The articulated Rhaetian holotype LWL-MFN P 64047 preserves plesiosaur anatomy; sampled humeral and femoral sections show rapidly deposited, highly vascularized bone tissue. Its basal pliosaurid placement comes from phylogenetic analysis. Growth rate and metabolism are inferred from histology rather than measured in the animal, so direct observations and interpretations remain distinct.
summaryZh: 瑞替期关节相连的正模 LWL-MFN P 64047 保存蛇颈龙类解剖；取样的肱骨与股骨切片显示快速沉积、高度血管化的骨组织。它在上龙科基部的位置来自系统发育分析。生长速率和代谢是根据组织学推断，并非对动物的直接测量，因此观察与解释需要区分。

evidenceItems.statement: LWL-MFN P 64047 preserves a partial articulated skeleton from Rhaetian strata; humeral and femoral sections record rapidly deposited, highly vascularized bone tissue.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Recovery near the base of Pliosauridae is topology-dependent, and fast growth or elevated metabolism are histological interpretations rather than directly measured physiology.

title: A fetus inside Polycotylus
titleZh: Polycotylus 体内的胎儿
summary: Adult Polycotylus specimen LACM 129639 preserves a large fetus of the same taxon. This direct association supports live birth in this Late Cretaceous plesiosaur; one specimen cannot establish care after birth or the full range of reproductive behavior.
summaryZh: Polycotylus 成年个体标本 LACM 129639 保存了一具大型同类胎儿。这种直接关联支持这类晚白垩世蛇颈龙为胎生；单件标本不能说明出生后的照护行为，也不能代表其全部繁殖方式。

evidenceItems.statement: LACM 129639 preserves an adult Polycotylus latipinnus with a single articulated fetus inside the body cavity; shared diagnostic characters support conspecific identification.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–3; Supporting Online Material Figure S1
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Description; Identification of the embryonic individual

uncertaintyItems.statement: A K-selected strategy, sociality and parental care are life-history inferences from offspring size and living analogues, not behaviours preserved in this specimen.

title: What four flippers do in a water channel
titleZh: 四片鳍肢在水槽中如何产生推力？
summary:
In a recirculating water channel, researchers moved rigid models of paired fore- and hind flippers through prescribed strokes. They measured thrust, torque and efficiency while varying the timing between the flipper pairs. Some phase offsets let vortices shed by one pair interact with the other pair and improved measured performance.

The experiment tests whether those hydrodynamic effects are physically plausible. Its reconstructed flippers and controlled motions do not reproduce a living plesiosaur, and the results do not establish one universal stroke for every taxon, speed or manoeuvre. The measurements constrain a swimming model; they are not observations of an extinct animal’s gait.
summaryZh:
研究者在循环水槽中让刚性复原的前、后鳍模型按预设轨迹运动，并改变两对鳍肢之间的动作时差，同时测量推力、力矩和效率。部分相位差使一对鳍产生的涡流与另一对相互作用，从而提高了模型测得的性能。

实验检验这些水动力效应是否可行。复原鳍肢和受控运动并不等同于活体蛇颈龙，因此结果不能确定所有类群、速度和机动情况下都采用同一种划水方式。这些测量约束了游泳力学模型，并非灭绝动物泳姿的直接观察。

evidenceItems.statement: Water-channel trials of paired fore- and hind-flipper models found that certain phase offsets increased hind-flipper thrust and whole-system efficiency through vortex interaction.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Methods; Results: effect of phase on thrust and efficiency

uncertaintyItems.statement: The apparatus used reconstructed rigid flippers and prescribed kinematics; its measured performance does not prove one universal stroke for every plesiosaur taxon, speed or manoeuvre.

title: Feather-like structures in Tupandactylus
titleZh: Tupandactylus 的羽毛状结构
summary: Five slabs of Tupandactylus specimen MCT.R.1884 preserve part of a skull and crest with simple filaments and branched feather-like structures. Melanosomes occur in sampled skin and filaments, but exact colors and signaling roles are not directly preserved.
summaryZh: Tupandactylus 标本 MCT.R.1884 分存于五块石板，保存了部分头骨和头冠，以及单丝状结构和分枝的羽毛状结构。取样的皮肤与丝状结构中发现黑素体，但具体颜色和信号功能并未直接保存。

title.en: Structures preserved with the crest
title.zh: 与头冠一同保存的结构

text.en: MCT.R.1884 includes a partial skull and cranial crest distributed across five slabs. The study describes both unbranched monofilaments and branched, feather-like structures. It also reports different melanosome geometries in skin and filament samples—microscopic evidence from this specimen, not a whole-body color record.
text.zh: MCT.R.1884 包含一部分头骨和头冠，分存在五块石板上。研究描述了不分枝的单丝状结构，以及分枝的羽毛状结构；皮肤和丝状结构样本中的黑素体几何形态也有所不同。这是来自该标本的显微证据，并非全身颜色记录。

title.en: What pigment evidence can establish
title.zh: 色素证据能说明什么

text.en: Melanosome geometry was compared across the sampled tissues, but it does not directly reveal an exact visible color or prove a signaling function. The proposed evolutionary implications for feather-like coverings depend on anatomical homology and phylogenetic interpretation; this one pterosaur does not show that every pterosaur had the same covering.
text.zh: 研究比较了取样组织中的黑素体形态，但它不能直接还原肉眼所见的准确颜色，也不能证明信号功能。羽毛状覆盖物的演化含义取决于同源性和系统发育解释；这一只翼龙不能证明所有翼龙都具有相同覆盖物。

evidenceItems.statement: MCT.R.1884, preserved across five slabs, includes a partial skull and crest with monofilaments, branched feather-like structures and melanosomes in skin and filament samples.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen description; Feather morphology; Melanosome geometry

uncertaintyItems.statement: Colour signalling and the ancestral state of feathers are evolutionary interpretations; the study does not directly recover exact colours or establish that every pterosaur bore the same structures.

title.en: Pterosaur melanosomes support signalling functions for early feathers
title.zh: Pterosaur melanosomes support signalling functions for early feathers

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

title: Hamipterus eggs record one place across several layers
titleZh: 哈密翼龙卵记录一个地点的多个层位
regions: Shengjinkou Formation, Turpan-Hami Basin, Xinjiang, China
summary:
At the Shengjinkou Formation in Xinjiang, one sandstone block measuring 3.28 square metres exposes 215 Hamipterus eggs; the study estimates that roughly 300 may occur in the block. Across the broader sample, 16 eggs contain embryonic bones, and egg-bearing deposits occur at at least four stratigraphic levels.

Repeated layers and embryos make this a rare record of pterosaur reproduction, but the fossils do not directly show why the eggs accumulated there. Storm transport, colonial nesting and site fidelity are interpretations. Claims about hatchling flight or parental care also depend on assumptions about embryonic development and ossification.
summaryZh:
新疆胜金口组的一块 3.28 平方米砂岩岩块暴露出 215 枚哈密翼龙卵；研究估计岩块中可能约有 300 枚。更广泛的样本中，16 枚卵含有胚胎骨骼，而且含卵沉积至少出现在四个地层层位。

多个层位和胚胎遗骸使这里成为少见的翼龙繁殖记录，但化石没有直接显示卵为何聚集于此。风暴搬运、群体营巢和地点忠诚都是埋藏学或行为解释；对幼体飞行能力和亲代照料的判断，也取决于胚胎发育阶段及骨化程度等假设。

evidenceItems.statement: A 3.28-square-metre sandstone block exposes 215 Hamipterus eggs, possibly about 300 in the block, and the broader sample includes 16 eggs with embryonic bones across at least four stratigraphic levels.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Egg accumulation; Embryonic remains; Geological context

uncertaintyItems.statement: Storm transport, colonial nesting and site fidelity are taphonomic or behavioural interpretations; hatchling flightlessness and parental care depend on embryonic stage and ossification assumptions and are not treated here as direct observations.

title: Could giant pterosaurs fly and launch quadrupedally?
titleZh: 巨型翼龙能否飞行并以四足方式起飞？
summary: Calculations using reconstructed mass, wing shape, bone strength and launch kinematics find powered flight and a four-limbed launch mechanically feasible for the sampled giant-pterosaur reconstructions. This tests whether model inputs can work together; it does not observe launch or directly measure extinct animals’ mass, muscle power or movement. Feasibility in these reconstructions is not a universal account of pterosaur behaviour.
summaryZh: 研究将复原体重、翼形、骨骼强度和起飞运动学输入模型，结果显示所取样的巨型翼龙复原在力学上能够动力飞行并以四肢起飞。这检验的是模型输入能否相互成立，并未直接观察起飞，也没有测出灭绝动物的体重、肌肉力量或动作。特定复原的可行性不能概括所有翼龙的行为。

evidenceItems.statement: Model calculations using reconstructed mass, wing planform, bone strength and non-avian launch kinematics found powered flight and quadrupedal launch mechanically feasible for the sampled giant pterosaur reconstructions.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Flap-gliding analysis; Flight performance; Launch mechanisms

uncertaintyItems.statement: The result is a biomechanical feasibility argument, not an observed launch, a universal gait for all pterosaurs or a direct measurement of extinct body mass and muscle power.

title: Indohyus: skulls, dense bones and isotopes
titleZh: 印多霍斯兽：头骨、致密骨与同位素
regions: Sindkhatudi bone bed, Upper Subathu Group, Kalakot, Jammu and Kashmir, India
summary: Separate Indohyus skulls preserve a cetacean-like involucrum, while other limb bones and a multi-tooth isotope sample add independent evidence. Together they support aquatic wading and a raoellid sister placement to Cetacea in the cited analysis, not membership in crown whales or direct ancestry.
summaryZh: 不同的印多霍斯兽头骨保存了鲸类样的耳泡骨，其他肢骨与多颗牙齿的同位素样本则提供独立证据。所引分析据此支持水中涉行和劳氏兽科作为鲸类姐妹群，但不支持其属于鲸类冠群或为直系祖先。

title.en: Several records, not one skeleton
title.zh: 多项记录，而非一具完整骨架

text.en: Skulls RR 207 and RR 208 preserve the involucrum, a thickened bone around the middle ear. Separate specimens RR 157 and RR 42 supply dense long-bone sections, and stable-isotope measurements come from several teeth. These observations converge, but the material is a disarticulated bone-bed sample rather than one associated skeleton.
text.zh: 头骨 RR 207 和 RR 208 保存了耳泡骨，即中耳周围增厚的骨。另一些标本 RR 157 和 RR 42 提供了致密长骨切片，稳定同位素测量则来自多颗牙齿。这些观察彼此收敛，但材料来自解体骨床，而不是一具关联骨架。

title.en: From anatomy to a way of life
title.zh: 从解剖证据到生活方式

text.en: Bone density, tooth isotopes and skull anatomy support the cited study’s interpretation of aquatic wading. Its phylogenetic analysis places Raoellidae as sister to Cetacea. Both are inferences from sampled evidence: Indohyus is not a crown cetacean, and neither the matrix nor the anatomy demonstrates that it directly became a whale.
text.zh: 骨密度、牙齿同位素和头骨解剖支持所引研究提出的水中涉行解释。其系统发育分析将劳氏兽科置于鲸类的姐妹位置。这些都是根据取样证据作出的推断：印多霍斯兽不是鲸类冠群成员，矩阵和解剖都没有证明它直接演变成鲸。

evidenceItems.statement: Skulls RR 207 and RR 208 preserve the cetacean-like involucrum; RR 157 and RR 42 provide dense long-bone sections, and a multi-tooth stable-isotope sample differs from terrestrial artiodactyl comparators.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Osteology; Bone histology; Stable-isotope analysis; Phylogeny

uncertaintyItems.statement: The material is a disarticulated bone-bed sample, not one associated skeleton; aquatic wading and sister-group position are inferences, and Indohyus is neither crown Cetacea nor demonstrated to be a direct ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen descriptions; Phylogenetic and ecological discussion

title.en: Whales originated from aquatic artiodactyls in the Eocene epoch of India
title.zh: Whales originated from aquatic artiodactyls in the Eocene epoch of India

scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

title: Pakicetus: a terrestrial skeleton assembled from one locality
titleZh: 巴基鲸：由同一地点材料组合的陆生骨架
regions: H-GSP Locality 62, Ganda Kas, Kala Chitta Hills, Punjab, Pakistan
summary: The published Pakicetus reconstruction combines skull H-GSP 96231 with separately catalogued vertebrae and limb bones from one locality, including humerus H-GSP 92042 and calcaneum H-GSP 96420. Their weight-bearing anatomy supports terrestrial locomotion, while the skull retains diagnostic early-cetacean anatomy. This is a locality composite, not one associated skeleton or a direct ancestor; the cited 2001 morphological tree also did not recover Hippopotamidae as the immediate cetacean sister group.
summaryZh:
已发表的 Pakicetus 重建把头骨 H-GSP 96231 与同一地点分别编目的椎骨和四肢骨组合起来，其中包括肱骨 H-GSP 92042 和跟骨 H-GSP 96420。能负重的骨骼结构支持陆地运动解释；头骨则保留了早期鲸类的诊断性解剖特征。

这是一个地点组合，不是一具关节连接的完整骨架，也没有确立 Pakicetus 是后续鲸类的直系祖先。被引用的 2001 年形态树也没有恢复河马科为鲸类最近的姐妹群；该树结果不能替代其他独立证据。

evidenceItems.statement: Skull H-GSP 96231 and separately catalogued vertebrae and limb elements, including humerus H-GSP 92042 and calcaneum H-GSP 96420, form the published Pakicetus reconstruction and support terrestrial locomotion.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Postcranial osteology; Skeleton reconstruction; Hearing and locomotion discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The reconstruction combines multiple individuals and the 2001 morphological tree did not recover Hippopotamidae as the immediate cetacean sister group; neither result overrides later independent retroposon topology.

title: Ambulocetus: limbs between water and land
titleZh: 陆行鲸的肢体留下了怎样的运动线索？
regions: Kuldana Formation, Kala Chitta Hills, Punjab, Pakistan
summary: The partial holotype H-GSP 18507 from Pakistan’s Kuldana Formation preserves a skull, vertebrae, and substantial fore- and hind-limb material. Their combination supports models of amphibious movement: otter-like up-and-down swimming and sea-lion-like movement on land. These are functional interpretations from bones and living comparisons, not observed behavior; this individual is not a direct whale ancestor.
summaryZh: 来自巴基斯坦 Kuldana 组的正模 H-GSP 18507 保存了部分头骨、脊柱以及相当多的前后肢材料。它们组合出的解剖特征支持水獭式上下摆动游泳、类似海狮的陆地移动等两栖运动模型；这些是依据骨骼和现生类比作出的功能解释，并非化石直接保存的行为，这件标本也不是鲸类的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype H-GSP 18507 preserves a partial skull, vertebral column and substantial fore- and hind-limb material from the Kuldana Formation, directly documenting an amphibious anatomical mosaic.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Otter-like dorsoventral swimming and sea-lion-like movement on land are functional models derived from anatomy and living analogues, not observed behaviour; the holotype is not a direct ancestor.

title: Peregocetus and a South Pacific fossil
titleZh: 秘鲁出土的游走鲸化石
regions: Lowest Yumaque Member, Paracas Formation, Playa Media Luna, Pisco Basin, Peru
summary: The Peruvian holotype MUSM 3580 places Peregocetus pacificus in the record at 42.6 Ma. Its limbs combine weight-bearing features with aquatic adaptations, while its gait and route of dispersal remain reconstructions.
summaryZh: 秘鲁正模 MUSM 3580 将 Peregocetus pacificus 的出现记录定位在约 4,260 万年前。它的肢骨兼有承重特征与水生适应；运动方式和扩散路线仍属于复原解释。

title.en: A substantial skeleton in one holotype
title.zh: 一件正模保存了较完整的身体线索

text.en: MUSM 3580 preserves the mandibles and most major regions behind the skull. Two fused sacral vertebrae, a distinct femoral head and hoof-like tips on the toes support the interpretation that the animal could bear weight, alongside features associated with life in water. The specimen comes from the Yumaque Member of Peru’s Pisco Basin.
text.zh: MUSM 3580 保存了下颌和头骨之后身体的大部分主要区域。两枚融合的荐椎、清楚的股骨头和蹄状趾端，支持它能够承重的解释；同时，标本也有与水生生活相关的特征。化石来自秘鲁皮斯科盆地的 Yumaque 段。

title.en: Anatomy is not a recorded journey
title.zh: 骨骼不能记录迁徙路线

text.en: Walking and swimming are functional interpretations of the skeleton. The paper favors dispersal westward across the South Atlantic, but an eastward route remains possible; neither route is traced by the fossil itself. Protocetidae is treated as paraphyletic in the study, and the presence of a tail fluke is unresolved.
text.zh: 游走和游泳是根据骨骼作出的功能解释。论文倾向于认为它曾向西越过南大西洋扩散，但也保留向东路线的可能；化石本身没有记录任何一条旅程。研究将原鲸科视为并系群，尾鳍是否存在也未能确定。

evidenceItems.statement: MUSM 3580 preserves mandibles and most major postcranial regions; two fused sacrals, a defined femoral head and hoof-like distal phalanges support weight-bearing capability alongside aquatic adaptations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Locality and horizon; Diagnosis; Postcranial description; STAR Methods

uncertaintyItems.statement: The paper calls Protocetidae paraphyletic; walking, swimming and the favoured westward South Atlantic route are reconstructions, while an eastward route and the presence of a tail fluke remain unresolved.

title.en: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans
title.zh: An amphibious whale from the middle Eocene of Peru reveals early South Pacific dispersal of quadrupedal cetaceans

scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

title: Basilosaurus hind limbs: small bones, separate records
titleZh: 龙王鲸的微小后肢留下了什么
regions: Birket Qarun Formation, Wadi Al Hitan, Fayum, Egypt
summary: Egyptian Basilosaurus material preserves a pelvis with articulated hind-limb and foot bones. A separate named specimen, male UM 93231, provides a femur whose compact-bone microstructure was measured. These records establish that the hind limbs were present and tiny; they do not indicate weight-bearing or terrestrial travel. A proposed role as a guide during mating, and claims about effects on whole-body swimming, remain functional interpretations rather than observed behaviour.
summaryZh: 埃及出土的龙王鲸材料保存了骨盆以及彼此相连的后肢和足部骨骼。另一件具名标本——雄性 UM 93231——提供了经过测量的股骨致密骨微结构。这些记录能说明后肢存在且很小，却不支持承重或在陆地行走。后肢可能在交配时起导引作用，以及它对全身游泳方式的影响，仍是功能解释，不是化石直接保存的行为。

evidenceItems.statement: The original Egyptian material preserves an innominate and articulated limb-and-foot elements; separately, male specimen UM 93231 contributes an explicitly catalogued femur with measured compact bone microstructure.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Pelvis, hind limb and foot description; Functional discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The small limb was not weight-bearing and does not imply terrestrial locomotion; its proposed use as a copulatory guide and organism-wide swimming consequences are functional interpretations, not directly observed behaviour.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Discussion of basilosaurid bone microstructure and locomotion

title: Aegicetus: anatomy behind a tail-propulsion model
titleZh: Aegicetus：尾部推进模型的骨骼依据
regions: Lower Gehannam Formation, WH-203, Wadi Al Hitan, Fayum, Egypt
summary:
At WH-203 in Egypt’s Lower Gehannam Formation, holotype CGM 60584 preserves a long rear trunk, unfused sacral vertebrae, no defined iliac auricular surface and shortened limbs. Referred specimen CGM 60583 adds an associated femur and tibia. Together, these bones anchor a model of changing propulsion in early whales.

The shift toward movement driven by the body’s middle and tail is inferred from anatomy, not observed swimming. No tail fluke is preserved, and the paper reports conflicting microfossil and sequence-stratigraphic placements near the Bartonian–Priabonian boundary.
summaryZh:
埃及瓦迪希坦的 WH-203 地点位于下 Gehannam 组。正模 CGM 60584 保存较长的后躯干、未愈合的骶椎、未形成明确耳状面的髂骨，以及缩短的四肢；归入材料 CGM 60583 还提供一根关联股骨和胫骨。这些骨骼共同支撑了鲸类推进方式发生变化的模型。

由躯干中段和尾部驱动游动，是依据解剖结构作出的推断，并非观察到的泳姿；标本也没有保存尾鳍。论文还报告，微体古生物和层序地层证据在巴尔顿期—普里阿邦期界线附近存在冲突。

evidenceItems.statement: CGM 60584 preserves a partial skull and much associated postcranium with a 7:15:4:4:9+ vertebral formula, unfused sacrals, no defined iliac auricular surface and shortened limbs; CGM 60583 adds an associated femur and tibia.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Geological setting and age; Holotype and referred specimen; Description; Locomotion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The paper reports conflicting micropalaeontological and sequence-stratigraphic placement around the Bartonian–Priabonian boundary; mid-body-and-tail undulation is inferred and a tail fluke is considered doubtful, not preserved.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Geological setting and age; Swimming-mode discussion

title: Retroposon evidence for a whale–hippo sister relationship
titleZh: 反转座子证据支持鲸类与河马互为姐妹群
regions: Comparative genomes of sampled living cetartiodactyls
summary: Retroposons are DNA insertions whose shared presence can mark common ancestry. In sampled living cetartiodactyls, the study isolated ten additional loci, characterized sixteen independent insertion events and analysed twenty informative events; four loci support a whale–hippo clade. This is a topology test across living genomes: it supports Hippopotamidae as the extant sister group of Cetacea, but does not date their split, place every fossil cetartiodactyl, or identify a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 反转座子是插入基因组的重复 DNA 片段，共同出现可标记共同祖源。研究在取样的现生鲸偶蹄类中另分离出 10 个位点，描述了 16 次独立插入事件，并在联合矩阵中分析 20 个信息性事件；其中 4 个位点支持鲸类—河马支系。这项现生基因组拓扑检验支持河马科是鲸类现生姐妹群，但不能测定两者分化时间、放置所有化石鲸偶蹄类或指出直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The study isolated 10 additional loci, characterized 16 independent retropositional events and analysed 20 informative events in the combined matrix; four loci support a whale–hippo clade.

uncertaintyItems.statement: This is a topology test on sampled living genomes, not a fossil occurrence, a direct observation of an ancestor, a divergence-time estimate or a Catalogue of Life naming authority.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxon sampling; Character matrix; Phylogenetic conclusions

title: How a molecular matrix rebuilt the living-whale tree
titleZh: 分子矩阵如何重建现生鲸类关系？
regions: 87 living cetacean species sampled in the 2009 analysis
summary: The 2009 study assembled a 42,335-character molecular matrix for 87 of the 89 cetacean species recognized in its own sampling framework. It combined nuclear and mitochondrial data with transposon evidence to estimate relationships among living whales and dolphins, then used relaxed molecular clocks to model divergence times. These are results for that historical sample, taxonomic framework and calibration set—not coverage of every species recognized today or direct dates from fossils.
summaryZh: 2009 年的研究为当时取样框架认可的 89 种鲸类中的 87 种构建了含 42,335 个字符的分子矩阵，结合核基因、线粒体数据和转座子证据，估计现生鲸类的亲缘关系，并用松弛分子钟模型推算分化时间。这些结果受当年的样本、分类框架与校准集限制；它们不代表今天认可的全部物种，也不是直接从化石测出的年代。

evidenceItems.statement: The authors merged 37 new RAG1 and PRM1 sequences with 45 nuclear loci, mitochondrial genomes and transposons to sample 87 of 89 cetacean species recognized in their 2009 framework.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Data assembly; Phylogenetic analyses; Divergence estimation

uncertaintyItems.statement: The topology and ages are outputs of a 2009 sample, partition scheme, calibration set and relaxed-clock models; they do not sequence every species accepted by COL26.8 or convert model nodes into fossil observations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxon sampling; Model selection; Calibration and divergence discussion

title: Eunotosaurus ribs test a model of shell assembly
titleZh: Eunotosaurus 的肋骨如何检验龟壳形成模型
regions: Beaufort Group, Karoo Basin, South Africa
summary: Two specimens preserve different parts of the proposed sequence. A section through dorsal rib NHM PV R 4949 shows successive bone deposition extending from the primordial rib; SAM K 1133 preserves an articulated shoulder girdle with the scapula in front of the dorsal ribs. These observations inform models of how the turtle shell developed. Placing Eunotosaurus on the turtle stem and treating its ribs as homologous with shell components are analytical interpretations, not evidence that these individuals were direct ancestors.
summaryZh: 两件标本保存了不同结构：背肋切片 NHM PV R 4949 显示骨组织从原始肋骨逐步沉积；SAM K 1133 则保存关节相连的肩带，肩胛骨位于背肋前方。这些观察为龟壳形成过程的模型提供材料。把 Eunotosaurus 放在龟类干群、并将其肋骨解释为龟壳组成部分的同源结构，属于分析结论，并不说明这些个体是直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: NHM PV R 4949 preserves a sectioned dorsal rib with successive bone deposition extending from the primordial rib, and SAM K 1133 preserves a complete articulated shoulder girdle with the scapula positioned rostral to the dorsal ribs.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The paper's recovery of Eunotosaurus on the turtle stem and its expanded sequence of shell-character acquisition are phylogenetic and homology models, not proof that sampled individuals were direct ancestors or that the same developmental process occurred unchanged in later turtles.

title: Pappochelys preserves broadened ribs and paired gastralia
titleZh: Pappochelys 保存宽肋与成对腹肋
summary: At Vellberg, Pappochelys fossils preserve parts of a body plan that can be compared with the turtle shell: SMNS 91356 includes cranial and postcranial material, while SMNS 91360 preserves paired robust gastralia—belly ribs—with trunk-rib fragments. The ribs are broadened and the skull has a diapsid pattern, but the sample has neither a fused plastron nor a complete carapace. Proposed gastral fusion and the taxon’s position among sampled stem turtles depend on homology and matrix interpretation; Pappochelys is not a proven step in a direct line from Eunotosaurus to Odontochelys.
summaryZh: 费尔贝格的 Pappochelys 化石保存了可与龟壳演化作比较的身体结构：SMNS 91356 含头骨和身体骨骼，SMNS 91360 则保存成对粗壮腹膜肋及躯干肋骨碎片。肋骨已加宽，头骨仍呈双颞窝型式，但样本没有融合的腹甲，也没有完整背甲。关于腹膜肋逐渐融合的解释，以及它在已取样龟类干群中的位置，都取决于同源判断和矩阵分析；Pappochelys 不是从 Eunotosaurus 到 Odontochelys 的已证实直系过渡阶段。

evidenceItems.statement: SMNS 91356 preserves cranial and postcranial elements, and SMNS 91360 preserves paired robust gastralia with trunk-rib fragments; the sample lacks a fused plastron and complete carapace.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Serial fusion of gastralia into part of the plastron and the position of Pappochelys between sampled stem turtles are homology and matrix results; the specimens do not form a literal ancestor–descendant stage between Eunotosaurus and Odontochelys.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Phylogenetic analysis; Early evolution of the turtle body plan

title: Odontochelys and the parts of an early shell
titleZh: Odontochelys 与早期龟类甲壳的构件
summary: Three specimens of *Odontochelys semitestacea* from China's Guanling Formation preserve a developed plastron (the belly-side shell), expanded ribs and neural plates along the backbone, but no complete carapace (the back-side shell) or overlying osteoderms (bony plates in the skin). This mix led to a proposed plastron-first shell sequence; the fossils show what was preserved, not the order in which the shell developed. Its position near the base of the sampled turtle tree and a marginal-marine habitat are also interpretations, not proof of direct ancestry or a global first appearance.
summaryZh: 中国关岭组的三件 *Odontochelys semitestacea* 标本保存了发育完整的腹甲（腹侧壳）、扩展肋骨和沿脊柱排列的神经板，却没有完整背甲，也没有覆盖其上的皮内骨板。这种腹背构件的差异启发了“腹甲先于背甲形成”的假说；化石直接显示的是保存状态，不能单独证明发育顺序。它在取样龟类树中的基部位置及边缘海生境同样属于解释，并不证明它是直接祖先或全球首现。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V 15639, paratype IVPP V 13240 and referred specimen IVPP V 15653 preserve a fully developed plastron, expanded ribs and neural plates but no complete dorsal carapace or overlying osteoderms.

uncertaintyItems.statement: A plastron-first shell sequence, basal placement relative to sampled turtles and marginal-marine ecology are interpretations of comparative anatomy, matrix topology and deposits; none demonstrates direct ancestry, a universal developmental sequence or a global first appearance.

title: Caribemys gives turtles a minimum, not a birth date
titleZh: Caribemys 给出龟类冠群下限，而非起源日期
regions: Jagua Formation, Cuba; Bayesian relaxed-clock model
summary:
Holotype MNHNCu P-3209 of Caribemys oxfordiensis comes from Cuba’s Oxfordian Jagua Formation. The cited calibration study treated it as a pleurodire within crown Testudines and used the fossil to set a 155.6-million-year hard minimum: under that calibration scheme, the crown must be at least this old.

The same analysis estimated a much older crown age, with a 194.90–231.41 Ma posterior interval and a 212.33 Ma mean. Those are outputs of a relaxed-clock model under chosen topology, molecular data and priors—not dates measured from the fossil. The authors did not resolve whether the turtle crown originated in the Triassic or Jurassic.
summaryZh:
Caribemys oxfordiensis 正模 MNHNCu P-3209 出自古巴 Jagua 组牛津期地层。所引校准研究把它作为龟类冠群中的侧颈龟类，并用这件化石设定 1.556 亿年前的硬最小年龄：在该校准方案下，龟类冠群至少已有这么古老。

同一分析还估计了更早的冠群年龄：后验区间为 1.949 亿至 2.3141 亿年前，均值为 2.1233 亿年前。这些数值来自采用特定拓扑、分子数据和先验条件的宽松分子钟模型，并非对化石本身的测年。作者没有解决龟类冠群究竟起源于三叠纪还是侏罗纪。

evidenceItems.statement: MNHNCu P-3209, the holotype of Caribemys oxfordiensis from the Oxfordian Jagua Formation, was treated as a total-group pleurodire inside crown Testudines and used to set a 155.6 Ma hard minimum for Node 1.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 194.90–231.41 Ma posterior interval and 212.33 Ma mean are relaxed-clock outputs under stated priors and topology, not dates measured from MNHNCu P-3209; the analysis explicitly could not resolve whether the turtle crown originated in the Triassic or Jurassic.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Materials and Methods; Age of the crown Testudines; Conclusions

title: Taytalura’s three-dimensional skull and its uncertain branch
titleZh: Taytalura 的三维头骨与待定的支系位置
regions: Ischigualasto Formation, San Juan Province, Argentina
summary: Micro-CT reveals cranial characters in the three-dimensionally preserved holotype PVSJ 698. Across the cited analyses it is recovered as an early-diverging stem lepidosauromorph outside crown Lepidosauria. The placement was tested under multiple settings, but remains a phylogenetic result from one skull; it does not identify Taytalura as a direct ancestor or establish whole-body anatomy.
summaryZh: 显微 CT 揭示三维保存正模 PVSJ 698 的头骨性状。在所引分析中，它被恢复为早分化的鳞龙形类干群成员，位于冠群鳞龙类之外。研究在多种设置下检验了这一位置，但它仍是基于一件头骨得到的系统发育结果；这不等于认定 Taytalura 是直系祖先，也不能据此复原全身解剖。

evidenceItems.statement: PVSJ 698 is a three-dimensionally preserved skull documented by micro-CT; the paper reports a mixture of early diapsid and lepidosaur-like cranial character states and tests it under multiple data partitions and optimality criteria.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The earliest-evolving sampled lepidosauromorph placement and inferred ancestral skull architecture are topology-dependent reconstructions; a single skull is not a direct ancestor, a whole-body record or a global biogeographic range.

title: Megachirella in a combined-data squamate analysis
titleZh: Megachirella 进入有鳞类联合数据分析
regions: Dont Formation, Dolomites, northern Italy; combined-data phylogenetic model
summary: The only known Megachirella skeleton, holotype PZO 628, was scanned with high-resolution micro-CT and its segmented anatomy added to a combined fossil, living-taxon, morphological and molecular analysis. That matrix recovered Megachirella on the squamate stem. The result is a placement within one sampled analysis of a single, compressed specimen; its clock-model divergence estimates are not fossil observations, a date for crown Squamata, or evidence that this animal was a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 唯一已知的 Megachirella 骨骼正模 PZO 628 经高分辨率微型 CT 扫描，分割出的解剖结构被加入结合化石、现生类群、形态与分子数据的分析。该矩阵将 Megachirella 恢复在有鳞类干群。这个位置来自单件受压扁标本的一项取样分析；时钟模型给出的分化估计不是化石直接记录、不是有鳞类冠群的定年，也不能证明该动物是直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype and only specimen PZO 628 was scanned by high-resolution micro-CT, and its segmented skull and skeleton were scored in a combined fossil, living-taxon, morphological and molecular dataset.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Stem-squamate placement and pre-Permian–Triassic divergence estimates are outputs of sampled characters, molecular partitions, clock models and priors; the fossil itself does not date the squamate crown or establish a direct ancestor.

title: Bellairsia: a Jurassic skeleton seen in fine detail
titleZh: 同步辐射如何揭示侏罗纪有鳞类的骨骼组合？
regions: Kilmaluag Formation, Isle of Skye, Scotland
summary: Synchrotron scans of NMS G.2022.1.1 from Skye resolve most of a Middle Jurassic skeleton, including squamate-like ankle and skull features alongside more retained skeletal states. The study’s matrices place Bellairsia on the squamate stem, but that position depends on character coding and analytical constraints. Proposed skull mobility is an interpretation; the fossil does not directly date the crown group or represent an ancestor of living geckos.
summaryZh: 来自斯凯岛中侏罗世地层的 NMS G.2022.1.1 经同步辐射扫描后，显露出近乎完整的骨骼：踝部与悬器等特征近似有鳞类，同时保留其他骨骼状态。研究矩阵把 Bellairsia 放在有鳞类干群，但位置取决于性状编码和分析约束；颅骨运动能力也是解释。该化石不能直接给有鳞类冠群定年，也不是现生壁虎的祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: NMS G.2022.1.1 was imaged at ESRF beamline ID19 and preserves most of the skeleton; the documented mosaic includes a fused astragalus–calcaneum and squamate-like suspensorial traits alongside notochordal vertebrae with presacral intercentra and a pterygoid–vomer contact.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Stem-squamate placement is recovered by Bayesian matrices, including analyses constrained by a molecular backbone; proposed cranial kinesis is functional interpretation, and the specimen neither dates the crown directly nor represents an ancestor of living geckos.

title: Cryptovaranoides: competing placements from the same fossils
titleZh: Cryptovaranoides：同一批化石对应的竞争性位置
regions: Slickstones Quarry fissure fill, Gloucestershire, England; competing morphology matrices
summary: The same fossils have supported two different positions for Cryptovaranoides: the 2022 description and 2024 response place holotype NHMUK PV R36822 within crown Squamata, while competing analyses place the taxon outside it. The disagreement turns on what some bones are, whether isolated elements belong to this animal, and how anatomical characters are scored. Until those points converge, this fossil is not a secure first appearance of crown squamates or a fixed clock calibration.
summaryZh: 同一批化石让 Cryptovaranoides 出现了两种不同位置：2022 年的描述和 2024 年的回应把正模 NHMUK PV R36822 放在有鳞类冠群内，竞争性分析则将该类群置于冠群之外。分歧涉及部分骨骼究竟是什么、散离骨骼是否属于这只动物，以及解剖性状如何编码。在这些问题尚未收敛前，它不是可靠的有鳞类冠群首现记录，也不适合作为固定的分子时钟校准点。

evidenceItems.statement: NHMUK PV R36822 is a partially articulated skeleton in a multi-individual block; the 2022 description and 2024 response identify a suite of squamate characters and recover crown placement in their matrices.

The 2023 and 2025 reanalyses dispute several anatomical identities and referrals and recover Cryptovaranoides outside Squamata, as an archosauromorph or an unresolved neodiapsid under tested matrices.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Revised diagnosis; Character scoring; Phylogenetic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Because element identity, referral of isolated bones and matrix scorings remain actively disputed, this package assigns contested confidence and does not use Cryptovaranoides as a crown-Squamata FAD, clock calibration or proof of Triassic diversification of living lineages.

title: Effigia: similar outlines do not mean close kinship
titleZh: 艾菲鳄的骨架与趋同外形
regions: 'Siltstone member', Chinle Group, Ghost Ranch, New Mexico, USA
summary: The nearly complete specimen AMNH FR 30587 preserves an edentulous skull and much of a gracile skeleton. In the published character analysis, Effigia falls within Suchia, a group on the crocodile-line archosaur branch, rather than among theropod dinosaurs. Its resemblance to ornithomimid theropods is treated as convergence: similar form evolved in separate lineages. The fossil does not directly measure gait or diet, and the resemblance does not establish identical ecology or ancestry.
summaryZh: 近完整标本 AMNH FR 30587 保存了无齿头骨和大部分纤细骨架。论文的性状分析将艾菲鳄置于伪鳄类——鳄鱼支主龙类的一支——而非兽脚类恐龙。它与似鸟龙类兽脚类外形相似，被解释为趋同：不同支系分别演化出相近形态。化石没有直接测出步态或食性；外形相似也不能证明它们有相同生态或祖先关系。

evidenceItems.statement: AMNH FR 30587 preserves the skull and much of the postcranium; the reported matrix places Effigia among suchians rather than theropod dinosaurs.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Convergence is a comparative and phylogenetic interpretation; the specimen does not directly measure gait, diet or ecological equivalence and is not a crocodylomorph ancestor.

title: Carnufex: a partial skeleton in a Triassic predator assemblage
titleZh: Carnufex：三叠纪捕食者组合中的部分骨骼
regions: Pekin Formation, Deep River Basin, North Carolina, USA
summary: Carnufex is represented by the partial, skeletally immature holotype NCSM 21558 from the Carnian Pekin Formation, including cranial, vertebral and forelimb bones. Scaling from the skull and femur, together with the animals found in the same assemblage, supports interpreting it as a large-bodied, top-tier predator. Those are estimates from an incomplete young individual and its fossil community: the specimen does not preserve a meal, establish how often it hunted, make Carnufex a direct ancestor, or mark the crocodylomorphs’ global first appearance.
summaryZh: Carnufex 由卡诺期佩金组的未成熟正模 NCSM 21558 代表，保存部分头骨、椎骨和前肢骨。研究根据头骨与股骨尺度，并结合共同埋藏的动物组合，将它解释为体型较大、处于较高营养级的捕食者。这些判断来自一件不完整的幼体和它的化石群落：标本没有保存猎物，不能说明捕食频率；它也不是已证实的直系祖先，更不能代表鳄形类在全球的首次出现。

evidenceItems.statement: NCSM 21558 includes cranial, vertebral and forelimb material; estimated skull and femur dimensions place the immature individual among large-bodied members of its assemblage.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Body size and trophic tier are proxy-based, the individual is incomplete and immature, and the topology does not establish Carnufex as a direct ancestor or universal earliest crocodylomorph.

title: A consolidated skull in Junggarsuchus
titleZh: Junggarsuchus 的颅骨融合特征
regions: Lower Shishugou Formation, Wucaiwan, Xinjiang, China
summary: An articulated anterior skeleton of Middle Jurassic Junggarsuchus preserves a consolidated skull together with a gracile body. The combination occurs in one animal, while its functional meaning and place among crocodylomorphs remain interpretations; the specimen does not identify a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 中侏罗世 Junggarsuchus 的一具关节连接前部骨骼，同时保存了融合程度较高的颅骨和纤细的身体。这些特征确实共存于同一动物，但其功能意义及在鳄形类中的位置仍属解释；这件标本没有证明直接祖先关系。

evidenceItems.statement: IVPP V14010 includes a nearly complete skull, mandible and articulated anterior postcranium; the authors document reduced cranial kinesis and character combinations near the crocodylian skull condition.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and locality; Description; Phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: Skull mechanics and terrestrial locomotion are functional interpretations, while its phylogenetic position is matrix-dependent and does not identify a direct ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and locality; Description; Phylogenetic analysis

title: A tip-dated test of crown-crocodylian relationships
titleZh: 尖端定年模型检验冠群鳄类关系
summary: How can a long fossil record be reconciled with a comparatively recent molecular split among living crocodilians? The preferred tip-dated analysis combines 25 living and 92 extinct taxa, 278 anatomical characters and 9,284 molecular base pairs. It groups Gavialis with Tomistoma and places the sampled thoracosaurs outside the living crown. Morphology-only, parsimony and undated analyses differ, so the topology and divergence times are outputs of this model’s taxon sample, character weights, clock assumptions and priors—not observed dates or ancestor relationships.
summaryZh: 漫长的化石记录如何与现生鳄类较近的分化时间相容？首选的尖端定年分析结合 25 个现生和 92 个已灭绝分类单元、278 个解剖性状及 9,284 个分子碱基，将恒河鳄与马来鳄归为一支，并把取样的胸甲鳄置于现生冠群之外。形态单独分析、简约法和不定年的分析给出不同结果，因此拓扑与分化时间是该模型的分类取样、性状权重、时钟假设和先验共同产生的结果，并非直接观察的年代或祖先关系。

evidenceItems.statement: The preferred tip-dated analysis combines 25 living and 92 extinct taxa, 278 morphological characters and 9284 molecular base pairs and recovers a Gavialis–Tomistoma clade.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Morphological, molecular and stratigraphic data; Bayesian tip dating; Discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: Morphology-only, parsimony and undated analyses differ; inferred divergence times and thoracosaur placement depend on model, priors, weights and sampled characters.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Morphological, molecular and stratigraphic data; Bayesian tip dating; Discussion

title: The Thermopolis Archaeopteryx skeleton
titleZh: 瑟莫波利斯始祖鸟骨架
summary: The nearly complete Thermopolis skeleton, later catalogued WDC CSG 100, preserves a hyperextendible second toe, a tetraradiate palatine and a hallux unlike a fully reversed perching toe. This combination adds anatomical detail to Archaeopteryx’s theropod affinity. Joint posture, perching ability and phylogenetic placement remain interpretations; one skeleton is neither a direct ancestor nor proof of a unique first bird.
summaryZh:
近乎完整的 Thermopolis 始祖鸟骨架后来编目为 WDC CSG 100。它保存了可过度伸展的第二趾、四射状腭骨，以及并非完全向后反转的栖枝型大趾。这些结构细节为始祖鸟的兽脚类亲缘关系提供了形态背景。

关节姿势、栖枝能力和系统位置仍需解释；它们不是骨骼本身直接展示的行为。一个骨架也不能证明始祖鸟是某个后代类群的直系祖先，或唯一的“第一种鸟”。

evidenceItems.statement: The specimen preserves a hyperextendible second pedal digit, tetraradiate palatine and foot anatomy inconsistent with a fully reversed hallux.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Joint posture, perching capacity and phylogenetic placement are interpretations; one Archaeopteryx specimen is not a direct ancestor or an exclusive global first bird.

title: What melanosomes reveal about Anchiornis plumage
titleZh: 黑素体留下了近鸟龙羽色的哪些线索？
summary: In the feathered dinosaur Anchiornis, specimen BMNHC PH828 preserves melanosomes—microscopic pigment-related structures—in its feathers. Comparing their shapes and distributions with measurements from living birds supports a reconstruction with grey, dark, white and rufous regions. The colours are statistical inferences rather than directly visible fossil colours, and preservation and reference samples limit the result; the reconstructed tail pattern came from a different Anchiornis specimen.
summaryZh: 近鸟龙标本 BMNHC PH828 的羽毛中保存着黑素体——与色素有关的微观结构。研究者把它们的形状和分布与现生鸟类羽毛的测量结果比较，据此统计复原出灰、深、白和红褐色区域。化石并未直接显示这些颜色；保存状况和参照样本会限制推断，而且复原中的尾部图案取自另一件近鸟龙标本。

evidenceItems.statement: BMNHC PH828 preserves feather-associated melanosome morphologies whose measured distributions were compared with living-feather reference samples.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Melanosome sampling; Discriminant analyses; Plumage reconstruction

uncertaintyItems.statement: Colour is statistically inferred rather than directly seen, preservation and training data constrain assignments, and the reconstructed tail comes from another Anchiornis specimen.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Melanosome sampling; Discriminant analyses; Plumage reconstruction

title: Microraptor’s holotype preserves feathers on four limbs
titleZh: 小盗龙正模的羽毛分布说明了什么？
summary: The Microraptor holotype IVPP V13352 preserves long, asymmetrical pennaceous feathers along both forelimbs and hindlimbs, as well as the tail. Their attachment documents a four-winged anatomical arrangement. The fossil does not record a flight path or establish how the feathers worked aerodynamically, and this individual is not a demonstrated direct ancestor of birds.
summaryZh: 小盗龙正模 IVPP V13352 在前肢、后肢和尾部保存了长而不对称的正羽，直接记录了四翼型的身体构型。化石并未留下飞行轨迹，也不能单凭羽毛位置确定其空气动力学作用；这件个体也不是已证实的鸟类直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: IVPP V13352 shows asymmetric pennaceous feathers associated with the forelimbs, hindlimbs and tail, defining the reported four-winged body plan.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The fossil does not record a flight trajectory; aerodynamic roles and topology require functional comparison and character analysis, and it is not a direct bird ancestor.

title: What wind-tunnel tests say about Microraptor’s glide
titleZh: 风洞试验如何检验小盗龙的滑翔？
summary: A scaled physical model based on published Microraptor proportions was tested with different wing and hindlimb configurations. Measured forces showed stable gliding with high lift and drag, while performance changed little among tested hindlimb arrangements. This is evidence about model aerodynamics, not direct observation of posture, launch or flight path; reconstructed geometry and feather shape remain assumptions.
summaryZh: 研究者依据已发表的小盗龙比例制作缩比实体模型，并测试不同的翼与后肢构型。力的测量显示，模型在升力和阻力都较高时能够稳定滑翔；不同后肢排列之间的表现差异不大。这是模型空气动力学证据，并非直接观察小盗龙的姿势、起飞或飞行路线；复原几何与羽毛形状仍是模型假设。

evidenceItems.statement: A scaled model based on published Microraptor proportions was tested across configurations; measured force coefficients supported stable gliding at high lift coefficients and high drag.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Model geometry, scale, pelvic reconstruction and feather shape are assumptions; the experiment demonstrates aerodynamic feasibility rather than an extinct animal’s actual posture, launch or flight path.

title: Asteriornis near the crown of the bird tree
titleZh: 阿斯忒里鸟在现代鸟类树上的位置
summary: The holotype NHMM 2013 008 preserves a three-dimensionally intact skull imaged by CT, with associated postcranial bones from a tightly constrained Maastrichtian horizon in Belgium. Parsimony places Asteriornis beside crown Galloanserae, while tip-dated Bayesian analysis puts it on the galliform stem. These competing results make the fossil a test of early bird relationships, not proof of the globally oldest modern bird.
summaryZh: 正模 NHMM 2013 008 保存了经 CT 成像、三维结构完整的头骨，以及来自比利时年代约束严格的马斯特里赫特阶层位的伴生颅后骨骼。简约法将 Asteriornis 放在冠群鸡雁类的姐妹群位置，而尖端定年贝叶斯分析则把它置于鸡形类干群。两种结果使这件化石成为检验早期鸟类关系的材料，却不能证明它是全球最早的现代鸟类。

evidenceItems.statement: NHMM 2013 008 includes a three-dimensionally preserved skull imaged by CT plus associated postcrania from a tightly constrained Maastrichtian horizon.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Parsimony places Asteriornis as sister to crown Galloanserae, whereas tip-dated Bayesian analysis places it on the galliform stem; neither proves a globally oldest modern bird.

title: Testing the early branching of living birds
titleZh: 检验现生鸟类的早期分支
summary: Jarvis and colleagues analyzed whole genomes from 48 species representing the bird orders recognized at the time to test Neoaves’ rapid early branching. The result is a topology for a sample of living birds; it is not a complete species-level tree or a fossil chronology.
summaryZh: Jarvis 等人分析了当时所承认鸟类目中 48 个物种的全基因组，以检验新鸟类早期快速分支的关系。研究结果描述的是一组现生鸟类的系统关系；它不是完整的物种级系统树，也不是化石年代序列。

evidenceItems.statement: The study compares whole-genome and reduced datasets for 48 species and reports major clades including Passerea and Columbea across multiple analyses.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Genome-scale datasets; Species-tree analyses; Incomplete lineage sorting

uncertaintyItems.statement: Some deep branches vary with data type and method because incomplete lineage sorting and convergence complicate inference; 48 representatives do not constitute a complete living-species tree.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Genome-scale datasets; Species-tree analyses; Incomplete lineage sorting

title: Molecular clocks and modern-bird divergence times
titleZh: 分子钟估算现代鸟类分化时间
summary: Bayesian analyses of clock-like exons and broader RAG sampling estimate a modern-bird common ancestor near 95 Ma and rapid diversification around the K–Pg boundary. The dates and reconstructed geographic histories are model outputs that depend on topology, fossil calibrations and priors.
summaryZh: 对时钟性外显子及更广 RAG 基因取样进行贝叶斯分析，估算现代鸟共同祖先约出现于 9500 万年前，并在白垩纪—古近纪（K–Pg）边界附近快速分化。年代与地理历史重建都是模型结果，取决于系统树拓扑、化石校准和先验设定。

evidenceItems.statement: The clock-like exon dataset samples 48 species and the RAG dataset samples 230 species across all orders; calibrated Bayesian analyses infer a Cretaceous neornithine root and rapid boundary-era radiation.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Molecular datasets; Fossil calibrations; Divergence-time and biogeographic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Topology, clock model, calibration choice, priors and geographic coding condition the estimated dates; the result is not a directly dated ancestor or a universally fixed crown-bird origin time.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Molecular datasets; Fossil calibrations; Divergence-time and biogeographic analyses

title: Why primate crown ages shift between clock models
titleZh: 灵长目冠群年代为何随分子钟方案改变
summary:
A phylogenomic analysis of 372 primate species combined a dated tree with a relaxed molecular clock. Under its autocorrelated-clock model and calibration strategy A, the estimated interval for crown Primates is 79.2–70.0 million years ago. “Crown” here means the last common ancestor of living primates and all its descendants.

A different calibration strategy in the same study gives 71.4–63.9 Ma. These are posterior estimates, not fossil occurrences: clock choice, fossil priors and taxon sampling affect deep-node ages. The interval should therefore be read as a result of a specified model, not a date directly measured in a fossil.
summaryZh:
一项涵盖 372 个灵长类物种的系统发育基因组分析，结合定年树与宽松分子钟。在自相关分子钟模型和校准策略 A 下，灵长目冠群的估计区间为 7,920 万至 7,000 万年前。这里的“冠群”指现生灵长类最近共同祖先及其所有后代。

同一研究采用另一种校准策略，得到 7,140 万至 6,390 万年前的区间。这些是后验估计，并非化石出现记录：分子钟选择、化石先验和分类单元取样都会影响深层节点年代。因此，这个区间应理解为特定模型的结果，而不是对某件化石直接测得的日期。

evidenceItems.statement: The 372-species analysis under the autocorrelated clock and calibration strategy A yields 79.2–70.0 Ma for crown Primates and later intervals for major crown subclades.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: A Timeline of Primate Evolution; Effect of calibration strategy and relaxed-clock model

uncertaintyItems.statement: This is a model posterior, not a fossil occurrence: strategy B gives 71.4–63.9 Ma, and clock choice, fossil priors and taxon sampling materially change deep-node estimates.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: A Timeline of Primate Evolution; Effect of calibration strategy and relaxed-clock model

title: What can isolated ankle bones tell us about Purgatorius?
titleZh: 孤立踝骨能告诉我们什么？
regions: Garbani Channel fauna, Tullock Member, Fort Union Formation, Montana, USA
summary: In the late Puercan Garbani Channel sample from Montana, UCMP 197509 (a left astragalus) and UCMP 197517 (a right calcaneus) are isolated ankle bones. They preserve joint features associated with mobility and an inverted foot, compared quantitatively with dentally associated euarchontans—primates and close relatives. The cited analyses attributed these bones to *Purgatorius* and inferred tree-dwelling locomotion, but they are not connected to teeth or one skeleton. They do not establish membership in the crown group of living primates.
summaryZh: 蒙大拿州 Garbani Channel 的晚 Puercan 期样本中，UCMP 197509（左距骨）和 UCMP 197517（右跟骨）是彼此孤立的踝骨。它们保存了与踝部活动和足部内翻有关的关节特征；研究者还将其与牙齿关联明确的真灵长总目（灵长类及其近缘类群）作定量比较。所引分析据此把这些骨骼归入 *Purgatorius*，并推断其适于树栖运动，但标本没有与牙齿或同一骨架相连，也不能证明它属于现生灵长类冠群。

evidenceItems.statement: UCMP 197509 (left astragalus) and UCMP 197517 (right calcaneus), among the isolated tarsal sample, preserve mobile ankle and inverted-foot features quantified against dentally associated euarchontans.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–3; SI Appendix Figures S1–S5 and Tables S1–S3
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results and Materials and Methods: attribution regressions and three phylogenetic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: The tarsals are not associated with teeth or one skeleton; taxonomic attribution, arboreality and a primate-side placement are inferences, not crown-Primate membership, direct ancestry or a global FAD.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–3; SI Appendix Figures S1–S5 and Tables S1–S3
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results and Materials and Methods: attribution regressions and three phylogenetic analyses

title: Altiatlasius: teeth and an uncertain place
titleZh: 高阿特拉斯猴：少量牙齿与未定的位置
regions: Adrar Mgorn 1, Jbel Guersif Formation, Ouarzazate Basin, Morocco
summary: What can a handful of teeth tell us about early primate relationships? Altiatlasius is known from about ten isolated teeth from Adrar Mgorn 1, including holotype THR 141 (whose molar position is uncertain, ?M1 or M2) and lower molar THR 135. The Thanetian sample is real; its placement near or outside crown Primates is not settled. The teeth therefore do not establish a secure crown-primate or anthropoid position, let alone a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 一小批牙齿能告诉我们多少早期灵长类亲缘信息？Altiatlasius 目前由 Adrar Mgorn 1 的约十枚孤立牙齿代表，包括正模 THR 141（其臼齿位置尚不确定，可能是 ?M1 或 M2）和下臼齿 THR 135。赞尼特期的化石样本确实存在；它位于灵长目冠群附近还是之外，则仍未定。这些牙齿不能确立它属于冠群灵长类或人猿类，更不能证明它是直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The type series includes holotype THR 141 (?M1 or M2), lower molar THR 135 and other isolated premolar and molar material described from Adrar Mgorn 1.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic description and comparisons of the isolated dental hypodigm

uncertaintyItems.statement: Tooth locus and hypodigm membership are not uniform across later assessments; the original omomyid assignment is a hypothesis, not secure crown-Primate or crown-anthropoid evidence and not a directly dated occurrence.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic description and comparisons of the isolated dental hypodigm
Abstract and cladistic analysis recovering Altiatlasius within Toliapinidae

title: Teilhardina teeth across the PETM
titleZh: 古新世—始新世极热事件期间的 Teilhardina 牙齿序列
summary: Correlated sections record separate Teilhardina dental samples from Asia, Europe and North America across the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum. Their proposed order is a regional appearance sequence, not a single migrating population or an ancestor chain.
summaryZh: 经过对比的地层剖面记录了古新世—始新世极热事件期间来自亚洲、欧洲和北美的不同 Teilhardina 牙齿样本。提出的先后顺序是区域出现序列，不代表同一个种群迁徙或一条祖先链。

title.en: Different species, different sections
title.zh: 不同物种，来自不同剖面

text.en: The comparison includes T. asiatica specimen IVPP V12357, European T. belgica specimen IRSNB M64, and North American T. brandti material including USNM 493913 and USNM 493914. Figure 2 places these dental samples in correlated PETM sections; they are not parts of one animal or a single locality assemblage.
text.zh: 比较材料包括 T. asiatica 标本 IVPP V12357、欧洲的 T. belgica 标本 IRSNB M64，以及北美的 T. brandti 材料，其中有 USNM 493913 和 USNM 493914。图 2 将这些牙齿样本放进经过对比的极热事件地层剖面中；它们不是同一个体或同一地点的集合。

title.en: A sequence built from correlation
title.zh: 依靠地层对比建立的序列

text.en: The study proposes an Asia-to-Europe-to-North-America appearance order within a short earliest-Eocene interval. That order depends on dental species assignments and carbon-isotope correlation between sections. It does not identify one migrating population, a direct ancestor series or the origin date of crown Primates.
text.zh: 研究提出，在始新世早期的一个短时段内，亚洲、欧洲到北美依次出现相关材料。这个顺序取决于牙齿的物种鉴定，以及不同剖面之间的碳同位素对比；它没有识别同一迁徙种群、直接祖先序列或现生灵长类冠群的起源时间。

evidenceItems.statement: Figure 2 compares T. asiatica IVPP V12357, T. belgica IRSNB M64 and North American T. brandti material including USNM 493913 and USNM 493914 across correlated PETM sections.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: relative chronology and morphological sequence across PETM carbon-isotope records

uncertaintyItems.statement: The sequence depends on dental taxonomy and carbon-isotope correlation; it is not one migrating population, a direct ancestor series or the origination date of crown Primates.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: relative chronology and morphological sequence across PETM carbon-isotope records

title.en: Rapid Asia–Europe–North America geographic dispersal of earliest Eocene primate Teilhardina during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum
title.zh: Rapid Asia–Europe–North America geographic dispersal of earliest Eocene primate Teilhardina during the Paleocene–Eocene Thermal Maximum

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

title: A digit-two grooming-claw bone in Notharctus
titleZh: Notharctus 第二趾的理毛爪趾骨
regions: Grizzly Buttes, Bridger B, Bridger Formation, Wyoming, USA
summary: The semi-articulated Notharctus foot AMNH 143612/143640 lets researchers assign phalanx AMNH 143612-03 to digit two and compare its shape with grooming phalanges. The preserved association and anatomy support that comparison, while behaviour and broader anthropoid implications remain interpretations.
summaryZh: 半关节连接的 Notharctus 足部标本 AMNH 143612/143640，使研究者能够将趾骨 AMNH 143612-03 归于第二趾，并与理毛爪趾骨作形态比较。保存的关联关系和解剖结构支持这项比较；行为及其对更广泛人猿总科的意义仍属解释。

evidenceItems.statement: AMNH 143612 and rejoining block AMNH 143640 preserve the foot; associated mandible AMNH 143611 supports taxonomic attribution, and AMNH 143612-03 is the digit-two distal phalanx.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: fossil context, distal-phalanx comparisons and cladistic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: Grooming-claw function and tree effects are comparative and matrix-based; the specimen does not make Notharctus a crown anthropoid, direct ancestor or global first occurrence.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Results: fossil context, distal-phalanx comparisons and cladistic analysis

title: Darwinius: one skeleton on two slabs
titleZh: 正模的两块岩板记录了哪些身体细节？
summary: The plates PMO 214.214 and WDC-MG-210 are the counterpart halves of one juvenile Darwinius skeleton from Messel, dated in the cited account to about 47.5 million years ago. Together they preserve an unusually complete tail, hands, right foot, soft-tissue outline, and gut contents. The description also discloses preparation-made features on one plate; interpretations of sex, ecology, and evolutionary placement remain distinct from the preserved anatomy.
summaryZh: PMO 214.214 与 WDC-MG-210 是梅塞尔一具幼年 Darwinius 骨架的正、反模；所引研究将其年代记为约 4750 万年前。两块岩板合在一起保存了异常完整的尾部、手部、右脚、软组织轮廓和肠内容物。原描述还披露一块岩板上有制备造成的结构；性别、生态和演化位置的解释应与实际保存的骨骼分开。

evidenceItems.statement: PMO 214.214 (plate A) and WDC-MG-210 (plate B) are opposite slabs of the same articulated skeleton, with a complete tail, hands and right foot documented in Figure 1 and Table 1.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic paleontology, preservation disclosure, skeletal description and phylogenetic discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: Parts of plate B were fabricated during preparation and disclosed; sex, life history, ecology and haplorhine placement are interpretations, not direct observations or proof of crown-anthropoid ancestry.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic paleontology, preservation disclosure, skeletal description and phylogenetic discussion

title: Eosimias ankle bones and the anthropoid-stem test
titleZh: 曙猿类踝骨与类人猿干群位置
summary: Researchers compared isolated ankle bones—a talus and a heel bone—from Shanghuang and Yuanqu, China, in a matrix of anatomical characters. Some bones were attributed to *Eosimias*, but they are not associated with teeth, so that identification is indirect; the fissure-fill age is also broad. In the cited analysis, the preserved characters place *Eosimias* on the stem leading to anthropoids: outside the living anthropoid group, but closer to it than more distant branches. This is a result of that character matrix, not proof of crown membership or a global first appearance.
summaryZh: 研究者把中国商黄和垣曲出土的孤立踝部骨骼——距骨和跟骨——作为解剖性状，纳入形态分析矩阵。部分骨骼被归入 *Eosimias*，但它们没有与牙齿关联，因此鉴定并非直接；裂隙填充沉积物的年代范围也较宽。在所引分析中，保存下来的性状将 *Eosimias* 放在类人猿干群上：它位于现生类人猿群之外，但比更远的支系更接近该群。此结论取决于该性状矩阵，不能证明它属于冠群，也不能代表全球首现。

evidenceItems.statement: The sample includes Shanghuang talus IVPP V11855 and calcaneus IVPP V12313, plus Yuanqu right talus IVPP V11846 illustrated in Figure 1; measurements are tabulated in the supplement.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Tarsal description, attribution and PAUP consensus analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The tarsals are not dentally associated with Eosimias, the fissure-fill age is broad, and anthropoid status is a character-matrix inference rather than crown membership or a global FAD.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Tarsal description, attribution and PAUP consensus analysis

title: Saadanius and the catarrhine stem
titleZh: 萨达猴与狭鼻猴干群
regions: Middle Shumaysi Formation, Harrat Al Ujayfa, western Saudi Arabia
summary: The partial holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 preserves much of the face, palate and dentition, along with a tubular ectotympanic. Its age of 29–28 Ma is biochronological, and the published stem-catarrhine placement comes from a matrix of 36 characters and 19 taxa. The fossil documents a character combination within that analysis, not the catarrhine crown split’s direct date or a known ancestor.
summaryZh:
Saadanius 正模 SGS-UM 2009-002 保存了大部分面部、腭部和牙列，以及管状外鼓室骨。其 29–28 Ma 年代来自生物年代学；研究者则用包含 36 个性状、19 个类群的矩阵，将它恢复在猫猿类干群位置。

这一结论描述的是该分析中的性状组合与树上位置，并非猫猿类冠群分化的直接测年，也没有确认它是已知祖先。面部化石观察与小型形态矩阵给出的系统位置应分开理解。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype SGS-UM 2009-002 preserves much of the face, palate and dentition and a tubular ectotympanic, documented by photographs and micro-CT sections.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic description, geological setting and 36-character phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 29–28 Ma age is biochronological and the stem-catarrhine position follows a 36-character, 19-taxon matrix; it does not directly date the catarrhine crown split or identify an ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic description, geological setting and 36-character phylogenetic analysis

title: What can two Morotopithecus bones tell us about movement?
titleZh: 两件莫罗托古猿骨骼能说明怎样运动？
regions: Moroto I and Moroto II, Karamoja District, Uganda
summary: At Moroto in Uganda, MUZM 60 preserves part of the shoulder joint from Moroto I; MUZM 80 consists of six femoral fragments assigned to one individual from Moroto II. Researchers used these separate early Miocene specimens to infer a mixed tree-dwelling locomotor repertoire for *Morotopithecus*. They do not form a single skeleton: linking the bones to one genus relies on comparison across localities, while locomotion and relationship to the living-ape crown group remain interpretations. Neither specimen shows that *Morotopithecus* was a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 乌干达莫罗托地区的 MUZM 60 保存了来自 Moroto I 的肩关节一部分；MUZM 80 则由 Moroto II 出土、归为同一个体的六块股骨碎片组成。研究者用这两处地点的早中新世标本，推测 *Morotopithecus* 具有多种树栖运动方式。两者并非同一具骨架；把它们归入同一属依赖跨地点比较，运动方式和它与现生人猿总科冠群的关系也属于解释。两件标本都不能证明 *Morotopithecus* 是直接祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: MUZM 60 is a glenoid fragment from Moroto I; MUZM 80 comprises six right and left femoral fragments attributed to one individual from Moroto II and illustrated in Figures 2–5.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Discovery and geochronology; descriptions of MUZM 60 and MUZM 80; functional discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: The two specimens are not one skeleton, their attribution is locality-comparative, and vertical climbing, suspension and crown-hominoid affinity are functional or phylogenetic interpretations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Discovery and geochronology; descriptions of MUZM 60 and MUZM 80; functional discussion

title: Dmanisi Skull 5 and early Homo variation
titleZh: 德马尼西 5 号头骨与早期人属的变异
summary: Cranium D4500 and mandible D2600 belong to one adult from the roughly 1.8-million-year-old Dmanisi sample. CT imaging estimates its endocranial volume at 546 ± 5 cm³; the specimen adds to observed variation but does not by itself merge named Homo taxa into one lineage.
summaryZh: 颅骨 D4500 与下颌 D2600 属于德马尼西约 180 万年前样本中的同一成年个体。CT 成像估计其颅腔容量为 546 ± 5 cm³；该标本扩展了可观察到的变异，却不能单独把已命名的人属分类单元合并为一条谱系。

title.en: Two pieces, one associated skull
title.zh: 两块骨骼组成一具关联头骨

text.en: The study treats cranium D4500 and mandible D2600 as Skull 5, an unusually complete adult specimen from Layer B1y, Block 2 at Dmanisi. CT data give an endocranial-volume estimate of 546 ± 5 cm³. Figure 2 compares it with the other four Dmanisi crania, placing the specimen within a real but small local sample.
text.zh: 研究将颅骨 D4500 与下颌 D2600 作为 5 号头骨，认定为来自德马尼西 B1y 层、2 号区块的一具异常完整成年标本。CT 数据给出的颅腔容量估计为 546 ± 5 cm³。论文图 2 将其与其余四具德马尼西颅骨比较，说明它属于真实但数量有限的地方样本。

title.en: Variation does not settle species boundaries
title.zh: 变异本身不能裁定物种边界

text.en: Skull 5 expands the craniofacial variation documented among the Dmanisi individuals. The authors interpret that sample as compatible with a single evolving early-Homo lineage, but this is a taxonomic reading of a small fossil sample. One skull cannot establish a universally accepted ancestry claim or erase every distinction among named early Homo species.
text.zh: 5 号头骨扩大了德马尼西个体间已有记录的颅面变异范围。作者认为该样本与一条演化中的早期 Homo 谱系相容，但这仍是对小型化石样本的分类解释。一具头骨不能确立普遍接受的祖先关系，也不能抹去所有已命名早期 Homo 物种之间的区别。

evidenceItems.statement: Skull 5 combines D4500 and D2600, is illustrated in Figure 1 and has a CT-derived endocranial volume of 546 ± 5 cm³; Figure 2 compares all five Dmanisi crania.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cranium description, layer B1y context and geometric-morphometric variation analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The specimen directly documents one individual and sample variation; the paper’s single evolving early-Homo lineage is a taxonomic interpretation, not a universally accepted ancestry claim.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cranium description, layer B1y context and geometric-morphometric variation analysis

title.zh: A Complete Skull from Dmanisi, Georgia, and the Evolutionary Biology of Early Homo

title: From one Vindija bone fragment to a Neanderthal genome
titleZh: 从 Vindija 一块骨片到高覆盖度尼安德特人基因组
summary:
Vindija 33.19 was selected from nineteen cave-bone fragments screened for mitochondrial DNA. Researchers used 567 mg of the specimen for radiocarbon measurement OxA-32278, which returned an age greater than 45,500 years before present; a separate 41 mg extract with high hominin DNA content supplied the material for deep sequencing.

The sequencing produced a roughly 30-fold Neanderthal genome. Its approximately 52,000-year branch-shortening age, population splits and introgression proportions are genomic model estimates. They describe analyses of this individual’s genome, not direct dates for all Neanderthals or a definition of species boundaries.
summaryZh:
研究者从洞穴中 19 块经线粒体 DNA 筛查的骨片中选出 Vindija 33.19。取其中 567 毫克样本进行放射性碳测年，结果 OxA-32278 大于距今 45,500 年；另取 DNA 含量较高的 41 毫克提取物进行深度测序。

测序得到约 30 倍覆盖度的尼安德特人基因组。约 5.2 万年的分支缩短年代、种群分化和基因渗入比例均是基因组模型估计。它们描述的是对这一个体基因组的分析，不是所有尼安德特人的直接测年，也不定义物种边界。

evidenceItems.statement: Vindija 33.19 was one of 19 mtDNA-screened fragments; 567 mg produced date OxA-32278 (>45.5 ka BP), while 41 mg supplied the high-hominin-DNA extract used for deep sequencing.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Sample preparation, radiocarbon result, genome age and demographic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: The approximately 52 ka branch-shortening age, population splits and introgression proportions are model outputs; they do not directly date all Neanderthals or define species taxonomy.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Sample preparation, radiocarbon result, genome age and demographic analyses

title: Ust’-Ishim 1 DNA and a model of earlier admixture
titleZh: Ust’-Ishim 1 的 DNA 与更早混合事件模型
regions: Irtysh River near Ust’-Ishim, western Siberia, Russia
summary: Two direct dates place the Ust’-Ishim 1 femur at 46,880–43,210 calibrated years before present (95.4% probability); its genome contains long Neanderthal-derived segments. A recombination model uses segment lengths to estimate admixture 7,000–13,000 years before this individual lived. That interval does not identify a contact place, the number of events or the history of all modern-human dispersals.
summaryZh: 两次直接测年将 Ust’-Ishim 1 股骨定在距今 46,880–43,210 个校正年（95.4% 概率）；其基因组含有较长的尼安德特人来源片段。重组模型根据片段长度估计，基因交流发生在该个体生前 7,000–13,000 年。这个区间不能确定接触地点、事件次数，也不能代表所有现代人扩散史。

evidenceItems.statement: Ust’-Ishim 1 was dated twice (OxA-25516 and OxA-30190), giving 46,880–43,210 cal BP at 95.4% probability; its sequence data are deposited as ENA PRJEB6622.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–4; Extended Data Figures 1–9; Supplementary Information sections 1 and 14
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Direct dates, ENA accession and Neanderthal-ancestry tract analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: Segment length supports an admixture interval 7,000–13,000 years before this individual under the paper’s recombination model; it does not identify a contact place, exact event count or all modern-human dispersals.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–4; Extended Data Figures 1–9; Supplementary Information sections 1 and 14
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Direct dates, ENA accession and Neanderthal-ancestry tract analysis

title: Teeth and ankle bones from early Eocene Dormaal
titleZh: 始新世早期 Dormaal 的牙齿与踝骨
summary: At Dormaal in Belgium, early Eocene fossils dated here to 56–55.8 million years ago document teeth and ankle bones assigned to Dormaalocyon. The sample includes an extensive record of deciduous and permanent teeth, two named astragali and a calcaneum. These materials support a morphology-based placement among basal carnivoraforms, a broader group than living cats, dogs and their kin. That placement does not make Dormaalocyon a member of crown Carnivora, a direct ancestor or the first carnivoraform worldwide.
summaryZh: 比利时 Dormaal 的始新世早期化石（此处记录为距今 5,600 万至 5,580 万年）包含归入多马尔犬兽的牙齿和踝骨。样本几乎涵盖乳齿与恒齿，并包括两件具名距骨和一件跟骨。基于形态的分析把它置于食肉形类的基部位置；食肉形类的范围比现生猫、犬及其近缘类群更广。这个位置不表示多马尔犬兽属于食肉目冠群、是直接祖先或是全球最早的食肉形类。

evidenceItems.statement: IRSNB M2095–M2099 document reconstructed permanent dentition, while astragali IRSNB M2107–M2108 and calcaneum IRSNB M2109 document the tarsus.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; Tarsal bones; Phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: Dormaalocyon is recovered as a basal carnivoraform in the published character matrix; it is not demonstrated to be crown Carnivora, a direct ancestor or the global first carnivoramorphan.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; Tarsal bones; Phylogenetic analysis

title: What a 99-character matrix says about ‘Miacoidea’
titleZh: 99 个形态性状如何检验“细齿兽总科”
regions: Forty fossil and living carnivoramorphan terminals
summary: A matrix of 99 cranial and dental characters across 40 fossil and living carnivoramorphan terminals tests whether traditional “miacoids” lie outside crown Carnivora. Its preferred trees do not recover Miacidae and Viverravidae as simple stems to the two living carnivore branches.
summaryZh: 一套涵盖 40 个现生与化石食肉形类末端、含 99 项颅骨和牙齿性状的矩阵，检验传统“细齿兽”是否位于食肉目冠群之外。优选树没有把 Miacidae 和 Viverravidae 恢复为通向两支现生食肉类的简单干群。

title.en: From fossils to a branching pattern
title.zh: 从化石性状到分支图

text.en: The study scores cranial and dental features for 40 fossil and living terminals. A phylogenetic topology is a proposed branching arrangement inferred from those coded characters. In the preferred analyses, sampled Vulpavus, Uintacyon and Miacis-grade taxa fall outside crown Carnivora; the traditional “Miacidae” and Viverravidae do not form the simple successive stems once used to frame feliform and caniform history.
text.zh: 研究为 40 个现生与化石末端记录颅骨和牙齿性状。系统发育拓扑是根据这些编码性状推断出的分支排列。在优选分析中，取样的 Vulpavus、Uintacyon 和 Miacis 级类群位于食肉目冠群之外；传统“Miacidae”和 Viverravidae 并未组成通向猫型亚目、犬型亚目的简单连续干群。

title.en: A result that depends on the sample
title.zh: 结果受取样与编码影响

text.en: This is a morphology-based result for the terminals and characters in the matrix, not a directly observed ancestor ladder. Changing which taxa are included, how a character is scored, or the analytical assumptions can move nodes. The analysis therefore challenges a convenient classification scheme without fixing one permanent tree for every early carnivoramorphan.
text.zh: 这是针对矩阵所含类群与性状的形态分析结果，不是直接观察到的祖先阶梯。更换取样类群、调整性状编码或改变分析设定，都可能移动树上的节点。因此，这项分析挑战了一种便于叙述的分类方案，却没有为所有早期食肉形类确定唯一且永久的树。

evidenceItems.statement: The matrix samples 99 cranial and dental characters across 40 terminals and excludes traditional “Miacidae” and Viverravidae from crown Carnivora in the preferred trees.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Character descriptions; Phylogenetic analyses; Discussion of Miacoidea

uncertaintyItems.statement: This result rejects a convenient feliform–caniform ancestor ladder but remains a sampled morphology topology whose nodes can change with scoring, taxon sampling and analytical assumptions.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Character descriptions; Phylogenetic analyses; Discussion of Miacoidea
