title: Lycophocyon and the early caniform branch
titleZh: 狼形兽与早期犬型类分支
regions: Southern California, Uintan North American Land Mammal Age
summary: The cranium and teeth of holotype UCMP 85202, together with postcranial bones from associated specimens SDSNH 107446 and SDSNH 107447, provide the anatomical sample. A 30-terminal morphology analysis places Lycophocyon near the base of Caniformia, the dog-like branch of carnivorans. Its family assignment remains unsettled, and dietary scores are model-based comparisons rather than evidence of meals or observed hunting.
summaryZh: 正模 UCMP 85202 的头骨和牙齿，以及伴生标本 SDSNH 107446、SDSNH 107447 的颅后骨骼，构成研究中的解剖材料。对 30 个末端类群进行的形态分析将 Lycophocyon 放在犬型类基部；犬型类是食肉目中包括犬类的一支。其科级归属仍未解决，食性分值是模型比较结果，不是胃内容物或实际狩猎的证据。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype UCMP 85202 supplies the cranium and dentition; associated paratypes SDSNH 107446 and SDSNH 107447 add postcranial anatomy.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and paratypes; Phylogenetic analysis; Dietary habits

uncertaintyItems.statement: Basal-caniform placement is an analytical result and familial assignment remains indeterminate; dietary discriminant scores are comparative-model outputs, not stomach contents or observed hunting.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and paratypes; Phylogenetic analysis; Dietary habits

title: Six DNA regions test the living carnivoran tree
titleZh: 六个 DNA 区段检验现生食肉目关系树
regions: Living Carnivora tissue and sequence sample
summary: Researchers combined six nuclear and mitochondrial DNA regions—TR-i-I, TBG, IRBP, ND2, CYTB and 12S rRNA—from 76 living carnivoran species into a 6,243-base-pair analysis. The main tree strongly separated sampled Feliformia and Caniformia, the cat-like and dog-like branches. It describes the living species and models in this study; it does not establish fossil relationships, first appearances or divergence dates, and finer branching depends on the sample and analyses.
summaryZh: 研究者把 76 个现生食肉目物种的六个核基因与线粒体 DNA 区段——TR-i-I、TBG、IRBP、ND2、CYTB 和 12S rRNA——合并为 6,243 个碱基对的分析矩阵。主要结果清楚地区分了样本中的猫型亚目和犬型亚目。它呈现的是这项研究所取样的现生物种及其模型结果，不能据此确定化石关系、最早出现时间或分化年代；更细的分支关系也受样本和分析方法影响。

evidenceItems.statement: The concatenated matrix contains 6,243 base pairs from TR-i-I, TBG, IRBP, ND2, CYTB and 12S rRNA for 76 sampled species.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxonomic and gene sampling; Combined analyses; Nodal support

uncertaintyItems.statement: This is a 2005 sequence topology for sampled living taxa; it neither observes fossil anatomy nor fixes fossil first appearances, divergence dates or COL26.8 accepted names.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxonomic and gene sampling; Combined analyses; Nodal support

title: Why two Texas carnivorans left “Miacis”
titleZh: 两种得州食肉类为何离开“Miacis”
summary: Two Eocene carnivorans from Texas were once placed in the catch-all genus “Miacis.” The *Gustafsonia cognita* type skull (TMM 40209-200) was digitally reconstructed from CT scans, while renewed study of *Angelarctocyon australis* used its type specimen (TMM 41850-1) and referred jaw material. Revised anatomical scoring and sampled phylogenetic trees support assigning them to separate genera and place both near the base of Amphicyonidae, the extinct family known as beardogs. Those placements depend on the study’s sampled characters and taxa; they do not establish where beardogs originated or make either animal a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 两种得州始新世食肉类过去都被归入含义宽泛的“Miacis”。*Gustafsonia cognita* 的正模头骨（TMM 40209-200）经 CT 扫描后作了数字重建；对 *Angelarctocyon australis* 的重新研究则使用其正模（TMM 41850-1）和归入该种的颌骨材料。解剖特征重新编码并纳入取样系统树后，研究支持将两者分属不同属，并都置于熊犬科（Amphicyonidae，已灭绝的食肉类群）基部附近。这些位置取决于研究采用的特征和类群范围；它们不能确定熊犬类的地理起源，也不能证明这两种动物是后来的直接祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The holotype cranium of Gustafsonia cognita, TMM 40209-200, was CT-reconstructed; Angelarctocyon australis is represented by TMM 41850-1 and referred jaw material.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Revised systematics; Digital reconstruction; Phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The new genera and basal-amphicyonid positions follow revised scoring and sampled trees; they do not locate an exact geographic origin for beardogs or establish direct ancestry.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Revised systematics; Digital reconstruction; Phylogenetic analysis

title: Computer models test Magericyon jaw mechanics
titleZh: 计算机模型检验 Magericyon 的下颌力学
regions: Batallones-1 specimen and comparative digital models
summary: Finite-element models use the complete Magericyon holotype skull B-4071 alongside comparative carnivoran mandibles to simulate bites and external loading. Their calculated forces and stresses test feeding-mechanics hypotheses; they do not directly show how the animal handled prey.
summaryZh: 有限元模型以完整的 Magericyon 正模头骨 B-4071 和食肉目比较下颌为基础，模拟咬合与外部负载。计算出的力和应力可用于检验进食力学假说，但不能直接显示这种动物如何处理猎物。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype B-4071 is a complete young-adult skull; the 2026 analysis compares intrinsic canine, p4 and m1 bites and extrinsic pull-back and head-shaking loads, with meshes and scripts deposited on Zenodo.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype B-4071; Systematic palaeontology; Cranial and dental description
Muscle reconstruction; Intrinsic and extrinsic FEA; Bite-force normalization

uncertaintyItems.statement: Stress fields, relative bite forces and behavioural scenarios depend on segmentation, material properties, muscle reconstruction, constraints and normalization; they are experiments on models, not observed feeding.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Muscle reconstruction; Intrinsic and extrinsic FEA; Bite-force normalization

title: How a few teeth place Kretzoiarctos near pandas
titleZh: 少量牙齿如何把 Kretzoiarctos 置于熊猫支？
regions: Nombrevilla 2 and Abocador de Can Mata, Spain
summary:
Kretzoiarctos is represented by named dental material from Nombrevilla 2 and Abocador de Can Mata in Spain. The holotype, MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42, is a left fourth upper premolar; NV-2-40 is a right first molar, while IPS 46473 is a partial mandible with a broader tooth series.

A character matrix places the sample within Ailuropodinae, the panda subfamily, and dental comparisons suggest a herbivorous tendency. Those results do not show that Kretzoiarctos had the same ecology as the living giant panda, was its direct ancestor, or marks a secure centre of panda origins. The fossils are evidence for a sampled tooth pattern and a conditional placement.
summaryZh:
Kretzoiarctos 由西班牙 Nombrevilla 2 和 Abocador de Can Mata 的具名牙齿材料代表。正模 MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42 是左上第四前臼齿；NV-2-40 是右上第一臼齿；IPS 46473 则是保存更长牙列的部分下颌。

性状矩阵把这些样本置于大熊猫亚科，牙齿比较则提示其可能有植食倾向。但这并不说明 Kretzoiarctos 与现生大熊猫具有相同生态，也不能证明它是大熊猫的直系祖先或熊猫起源中心。化石直接支持的是一组取样牙齿及依赖分析的系统位置。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype MNCN-CSIC NV-2-42 is a left P4; NV-2-40 is a right M1, and IPS 46473 is a partial mandible with c1–m2 and associated P4.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred material; Phylogenetic analysis; Dental comparisons

uncertaintyItems.statement: Ailuropodine placement and herbivorous tendency derive from a character matrix and dental comparison; neither demonstrates identical giant-panda ecology nor a direct ancestor or secure centre of origin.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred material; Phylogenetic analysis; Dental comparisons

title: How Panthera blytheae entered the pantherine tree
titleZh: 布氏豹如何进入豹亚科系统树？
summary: The adult partial cranium that names *Panthera blytheae* (IVPP V18788.1), with a jaw fragment and partial premaxilla, anchors a fossil sample from Tibet's Zanda Basin. The study placed the locality's record between 5.95 and 4.10 million years ago using magnetic patterns in the rocks. It combined fossil anatomy with molecular data to infer the species' position among pantherines; its proposed snow-leopard affinity and broader Asian history are analytical conclusions. The age range describes the locality sample, not a universal first appearance, and the placement can change with later analyses.
summaryZh: 为 *Panthera blytheae* 命名的正模是成年个体的部分头骨（IVPP V18788.1），另有一块下颌支碎片和一块部分前颌骨，组成来自西藏札达盆地的化石样本。研究根据岩层记录的地磁变化，将该地点的样本年代定在 5.95–4.10 Ma。分析把化石解剖与分子数据结合起来，推断它在豹亚科中的位置；其可能接近雪豹以及更广泛的亚洲演化史都是分析结论。这个年代范围描述的是地点样本，不是豹亚科的全球首现时间；其系统位置也可能随新分析而修订。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V18788.1 is an adult partial cranium; IVPP V18788.2 is a ramus fragment and IVPP V18788.3 a partial premaxilla. The locality sample spans 5.95–4.10 Ma in the original magnetostratigraphic framework.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred material; Magnetostratigraphic ages; Combined phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The original Panthera assignment, snow-leopard affinity and Asian biogeographic scenario are analytical conclusions that later work may revise; the sample is not a universal pantherine FAD.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred material; Magnetostratigraphic ages; Combined phylogenetic analysis

title: Can the inner ear suggest how Hesperocyon hunted?
titleZh: 内耳形状能提示黄昏犬的狩猎方式吗？
summary: Researchers compared micro-CT reconstructions of left bony labyrinths in a 36-specimen sample, including Hesperocyon gregarius, using multivariate shape analyses. The model assigns Hesperocyon to a pounce-hunting category and reports 82.05% overall classification accuracy. That result depends on living-animal categories, body-size scaling, and phylogenetic assumptions; the fossils preserve an inner ear, not a hunt or social behavior.
summaryZh: 研究者对 36 件标本的左侧骨迷路进行微型 CT 复原，并用多变量形态分析比较，其中包括 Hesperocyon gregarius。模型将黄昏犬归入扑击式狩猎类别，报告的总体分类准确率为 82.05%。这一结果依赖现生动物的行为类别、体型缩放和系统发育假设；化石保存的是内耳，不是狩猎过程或社会行为。

evidenceItems.statement: The 36-specimen sample includes Field Museum Hesperocyon gregarius and Aelurodon skulls, segmented as left bony labyrinths and compared by PCA, CVA and MANOVA.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Morphometric sample; Multivariate analyses; Extinct hunting-style estimates

uncertaintyItems.statement: The reported 82.05% classification and pounce assignment are proxy-model results conditioned on living categories, scaling and phylogeny; they do not preserve an actual hunt or social behaviour.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Morphometric sample; Multivariate analyses; Extinct hunting-style estimates

title: Puijila combines terrestrial limbs with aquatic clues
titleZh: 普伊拉兽：陆生肢体与水生线索并存
regions: Haughton Formation, Devon Island, Nunavut, Canada
summary:
Holotype NUFV 405 preserves about 65% of one skeleton from an early Miocene lake deposit in the Haughton Formation of Devon Island, Canada. Its skull, teeth, vertebrae and substantial fore- and hind limbs let researchers compare features associated with land movement and swimming.

Robust limbs and other anatomical traits have been used to infer a semi-aquatic animal and a freshwater setting. Those are functional and environmental interpretations, not witnessed behaviour. The published placement among pinnipedimorphs also does not show that Puijila was a direct ancestor of later seals and sea lions.
summaryZh:
加拿大德文岛哈顿组的早中新世湖泊沉积中，正模 NUFV 405 保存了约 65% 的一具骨架，包括头骨、牙齿、椎骨以及相当完整的前、后肢。研究者据此比较与陆地运动和游泳相关的结构。

粗壮的四肢及其他解剖特征被用于推断半水生生活和淡水环境，但这些属于功能与环境解释，而不是直接观察到的行为。论文将它归入鳍足形类的系统位置，也不说明 Puijila 是后来的海豹、海狮等动物的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype NUFV 405 preserves roughly 65% of one skeleton, including skull, dentition, vertebrae and substantial fore- and hind limbs from an early Miocene lake deposit.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Semi-aquatic locomotion, pinnipedimorph position and an Arctic freshwater transition are morphology, topology and palaeoenvironmental interpretations; Puijila is not demonstrated as a direct pinniped ancestor.

title: What a stem pinniped skeleton can say about swimming
titleZh: 鳍足类干群骨架能告诉我们什么？
regions: Pyramid Hill Sand Member, Jewett Sand, California, USA
summary: The Enaliarctos specimen LACM 4321 preserves a skull and much of the skeleton behind it, allowing researchers to measure limb proportions and joint shapes. They compared those features with living pinnipeds and land-dwelling carnivorans to model how this early pinniped relative might have moved in water and on land. The bones are observations; swimming strokes and terrestrial performance are functional interpretations, not recorded behaviour. The specimen also does not establish direct ancestry or a global first appearance.
summaryZh: 始海豹标本 LACM 4321 保存了颅骨和大部分躯后骨骼，研究者据此测量肢体比例与关节形态，并与现生鳍足类和陆生食肉动物比较，以建立它可能如何在水中及陆地活动的模型。骨骼特征是直接观察，划水方式和陆地活动能力则是功能解释，并非行为记录。这件标本也不能证明直接祖先关系或全球首次出现。

evidenceItems.statement: LACM 4321 preserves a skull and much of the postcranial skeleton, allowing measured limb proportions and joint morphology to be compared with living pinnipeds and terrestrial carnivorans.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Skeletal description; Limb proportions; Locomotor interpretation
Abstract: nearly complete skeleton from California rocks, approximately 23 million years old

uncertaintyItems.statement: Combined fore- and hind-limb propulsion and terrestrial competence are functional inferences from osteology; the specimen is not footage of locomotion, a direct ancestor or a global pinniped first appearance.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Skeletal description; Limb proportions; Locomotor interpretation

title: Steropodon: a tooth-bearing jaw and monotreme affinity
titleZh: Steropodon：带齿下颌与单孔类亲缘关系
regions: Griman Creek Formation, Lightning Ridge, New South Wales, Australia
summary: The evidence for Steropodon begins with one fossil: right dentary fragment AM F66763 from the Early Cretaceous Griman Creek Formation, bearing three tribosphenic molars. Researchers compare those teeth with monotreme and other mammalian molar patterns to test the proposed Mesozoic monotreme affinity. The jaw and teeth are observed; their homology and phylogenetic meaning are inferred. One jaw cannot show a complete body plan, prove direct ancestry, or set a universal first appearance for monotremes.
summaryZh: Steropodon 的证据从一件化石开始：早白垩世格里曼溪组的右齿骨残片 AM F66763，保存三枚兽齿型臼齿。研究者把这些牙齿与单孔类及其他哺乳动物的臼齿模式比较，以检验中生代单孔类亲缘假说。下颌和牙齿是直接观察；其同源性及系统发育意义仍是推断。一段下颌不能呈现完整身体结构、证明直系祖先关系，也不能确定单孔类在全球的首次出现。

evidenceItems.statement: AM F66763 preserves a right dentary fragment and three molars whose morphology was compared with monotreme and tribosphenic conditions.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Dental homology and affinity are interpretations; one jaw cannot establish a direct ancestor, a complete body plan or an immutable global first occurrence.

title: What one platypus genome can compare
titleZh: 一份鸭嘴兽基因组能提供哪些比较
regions: Living female platypus Glennie; genome assembly and chromosome map
summary: The draft genome of one female platypus, Glennie, combined about 26.9 million reads into a 1.84-gigabase assembly at roughly sixfold coverage. Of the sequence, 437 megabases were ordered on 20 chromosomes, and 18,527 protein-coding genes were predicted. Assembly gaps, one-individual sampling and comparative annotation limit the result: it is a genomic sample, not a reconstruction of an ancestral monotreme genome or proof that single genes caused whole-animal traits.
summaryZh:
雌性鸭嘴兽 Glennie 的草图基因组由约 2690 万条测序读段组装而成，大小为 1.84 Gb，覆盖度约六倍。其中 4.37 亿碱基被定位到 20 条染色体上，并预测出 18,527 个蛋白质编码基因。这些数字描述的是一只个体的基因组组装和注释。

组装仍有缺口，样本只有一个个体，比较注释也带有模型限制。它不是单孔类祖先基因组的直接复原，单个基因与某些整体性状之间也不能仅凭这份数据建立因果关系。

evidenceItems.statement: Approximately 26.9 million reads produced a 1.84-gigabase draft at about sixfold coverage, with 437 megabases ordered on 20 chromosomes and 18,527 predicted protein-coding genes.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Sequencing and assembly; Comparative genome analysis; Methods

uncertaintyItems.statement: Assembly gaps, one-individual sampling, annotation and comparative models prevent direct reconstruction of an ancestral genome or single-gene explanations for organismal traits.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Sequencing and assembly; Comparative genome analysis; Methods

title: Eomaia: one skeleton, two positions in mammal trees
titleZh: Eomaia：一具骨架，两种哺乳动物树位置
summary:
Holotype CAGS 01-IG-1a,b from China’s Yixian Formation preserves an articulated skeleton, including the skull, teeth, feet and claws. The original description used these characters in a matrix that placed Eomaia near the base of Eutheria and interpreted its limbs as suited to climbing.

Later combined analyses can place Eomaia outside Theria. Both position and “scansorial” locomotion—adapted for climbing—depend on character coding and comparison, rather than direct observation of ancestry or behaviour. The fossil is an unusually informative individual, not a settled marker for one branch or a witnessed way of life.
summaryZh:
中国义县组的正模 CAGS 01-IG-1a,b 保存了一具关节相连的骨架，包括头骨、牙齿、足和爪。原始描述把这些性状纳入矩阵，将 Eomaia 放在真兽类根部附近，并依据四肢把它解释为适于攀爬。

后续联合分析也可能把 Eomaia 放在兽亚纲之外。它在系统树上的位置，以及“攀爬适应”这一运动解释，都取决于性状编码和比较对象，并非直接观察到的祖先关系或行为。这是一件信息丰富的个体，但它并未为哺乳动物分支位置或生活方式提供定论。

evidenceItems.statement: CAGS 01-IG-1a,b documents the skull, dentition and much of the postcranium; the original matrix and limb comparisons supported a basal eutherian and scansorial interpretation.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Later combined matrices can move Eomaia outside Theria; topology and scansoriality are analytical outputs, not a directly observed ancestor or behaviour.

title: Juramaia and a conditional Jurassic date
titleZh: 侏罗兽与有条件的侏罗纪年代
regions: Attributed Tiaojishan Formation, Daxigou, Jianchang, Liaoning, China
summary: The partial articulated specimen BMNH PM1343B preserves skull, teeth and postcranial bones. Its original study assigned it to the roughly 160-million-year-old Tiaojishan Formation and recovered a basal eutherian position. The specimen came through commercial collection, so provenance, stratigraphic attribution and matrix choice condition that result. An unconstrained tip-dating analysis estimated an Early Cretaceous morphological age signal; that model does not redetermine the rock.
summaryZh:
部分关节连接的标本 BMNH PM1343B 保存了头骨、牙齿和头后骨骼。原始研究把它归入约 1.6 亿年前的髫髻山组，并在系统发育分析中将其恢复在真兽类中的基部位置。但标本经商业采集，产地来源、地层归属以及所用性状矩阵都会影响这一解释。

另一项未约束化石年龄的尖端定年分析，得到偏向早白垩世的形态年龄信号。那是模型估计，并没有重新测定标本所在岩层；两类年代不能混为同一个直接测年结果。

evidenceItems.statement: BMNH PM1343B preserves skull, dentition and postcranium; the original study attributed it to approximately 160-million-year-old strata and recovered a basal eutherian position.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Commercial collection provenance, stratigraphic attribution and matrices condition the result; unconstrained tip dating yields a younger morphological age signal rather than directly redating the rock.

title: Ambolestes and the sampled therian boundary
titleZh: 无惧兽与早期兽类的取样边界
regions: Lujiatun Unit, Yixian Formation, Liaoning, China
summary: A near-complete holotype, STM33-5, preserves the ectotympanic (a middle-ear bone), malleus and hyoid anatomy. A morphological matrix, which compares coded anatomical characters across taxa, placed Ambolestes and Sinodelphys within Eutheria and shifted the oldest sampled metatherians to younger North American fossils. The placental–marsupial split is not visible in this skeleton: the reassignment and resulting ghost lineage depend on the characters and taxa included in that analysis.
summaryZh: 近完整正模 STM33-5 保存了外鼓骨、锤骨和舌骨区解剖。研究者把多类动物的解剖特征逐项编码后放入形态矩阵比较，分析将无惧兽与中华侏罗兽都恢复在真兽类，并把目前所取样最早的后兽类化石记录移到较年轻的北美材料中。骨骼本身并未保存胎盘类与有袋类分开的时刻；重新归类和由此推算的幽灵谱系长度，都取决于分析纳入了哪些类群与特征。

evidenceItems.statement: STM33-5 preserves ectotympanic, malleus and hyoid anatomy; the published matrix recovers Ambolestes and Sinodelphys in Eutheria.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Reassignment and the resulting metatherian ghost lineage depend on sampled characters and taxa; the analysis does not observe the placental–marsupial split.

title: A placental family tree built from fossils and genes
titleZh: 结合化石与基因构建的胎盘类系统树
summary: One study combined 4,541 phenomic characters scored across 86 species with 27 nuclear genes to test placental relationships, timing and ancestral traits. Its post–K–Pg placement for crown placentals is a model reconstruction from fossils, morphology and genes, not an observed ancestor or settled calendar date.
summaryZh: 一项研究将 86 个物种的 4541 项表型组特征与 27 个核基因结合，检验胎盘类关系、年代和祖先性状。模型把胎盘类冠群置于白垩纪—古近纪界线之后，这是基于化石、形态和基因的重建，并非直接观察到的祖先或已定论的日历年代。

evidenceItems.statement: The study scored 4,541 phenomic characters for 86 living and fossil species, supported by more than 12,000 annotated images, and combined them with 27 nuclear genes.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The post-K–Pg chronology and reconstructed phenotype depend on parsimony, fossil ages, ghost lineages and ancestral-state optimization; no ancestor was directly observed.

title: Four major branches in one placental-mammal analysis
titleZh: 一项胎盘动物研究恢复的四大支
summary: One study analysed 16,397 DNA base pairs from 42 placental mammals and two marsupial outgroups, using 19 nuclear and three mitochondrial genes. Bayesian and maximum-likelihood analyses recovered four major placental clades: Afrotheria, Xenarthra, Laurasiatheria and Euarchontoglires, with Afrotheria at the root in that study. The root placement, its estimated age of about 103 million years and the proposed Gondwanan scenario depend on the sample, calibrations and models; later analyses test alternative relationships.
summaryZh: 一项研究分析了 42 种胎盘动物和 2 种有袋类外群的 16,397 个 DNA 碱基，数据包括 19 个核基因和 3 个线粒体基因。贝叶斯与最大似然分析均恢复了非洲兽、异关节、劳亚兽和灵长总目四大支；在该研究中，非洲兽位于根部。根部位置、约 1.03 亿年前的年代估计和冈瓦纳情景都依赖样本、校准与模型，后续分析仍在检验其他关系。

evidenceItems.statement: The 16,397-base-pair matrix combines 19 nuclear and 3 mitochondrial genes; Bayesian and maximum-likelihood analyses recover four major placental clades.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The Afrotheria root, dates and Gondwanan scenario are model-conditioned, later studies test alternatives, and sampled taxa from other packages remain cross-boundary inputs.

title: Eritherium: a Paleocene skull and early proboscidean relationships
titleZh: Eritherium：古新世头骨与长鼻目早期关系
regions: Lower bone bed, phosphate bed IIa, Sidi Chennane, Ouled Abdoun Basin, Morocco
summary: Eritherium azzouzorum is known from a 15-specimen hypodigm from the lower bone bed at Sidi Chennane, Morocco. Holotype MNHN PM69 preserves the rostrum and upper teeth; fourteen additional specimens extend the sampled upper and lower dentition and skull anatomy. Dental and cranial characters place it on the proboscidean stem in the cited matrix. The often-repeated 3–8 kg body-mass estimate comes from dental allometry, and the precise relationship is comparative—not an observed body mass or ancestor.
summaryZh: Eritherium azzouzorum 由摩洛哥 Sidi Chennane 下部骨层的 15 件标本代表。正模 MNHN PM69 保存吻部和上颌牙齿；另 14 件标本补充了上、下齿列及头骨解剖。所引矩阵依据牙齿和颅骨性状将它放在长鼻目干群。常见的 3–8 千克体重范围来自牙齿异速生长估算，精确亲缘位置也属于比较分析结果，并非直接测得的体重或祖先关系。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype MNHN PM69 preserves a rostrum and maxillary dentition; fourteen additional specimens extend the sampled upper and lower teeth and skull anatomy.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Stem placement and estimated 3–8 kilogram body mass derive from a character matrix and dental allometry, not observed ancestry or body mass.

title: Bone density through the Thalassocnus series
titleZh: Thalassocnus 系列中的骨密度变化
summary: Across five successive Thalassocnus species spanning about four million years, bone microstructure changes through a sequence used to test an inferred transition toward more aquatic life. The fossils document skeletal change across the sampled series; habitat and behavior remain interpretations drawn from those changes.
summaryZh: 跨越约四百万年的五种连续 Thalassocnus，骨微结构呈现一系列变化，可用于检验其向更适应水生生活转变的推断。化石记录了所取样序列中的骨骼变化；栖息环境和行为仍是依据这些变化作出的解释。

evidenceItems.statement: CT slices and thin sections show increasing compactness across ribs and limb bones, including named T. littoralis specimens MNHN.F.SAS 2 and MNHN.F.SAS 53.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Aquatic adaptation, hydrostatic control and marine grazing are functional interpretations; species succession is not a directly observed ancestor chain.

title: Teeth, ankles and the size of Mimolagus
titleZh: 牙齿、踝骨与拟兔的体型估计
regions: Lower Irdin Manha Formation, Erlian Basin, Nei Mongol, China
summary: Mimolagus aurorae is represented by holotype upper third molar IVPP V20115 and referred teeth and tarsals from the Middle Eocene. A 4.5-kilogram body-mass estimate and comparisons with small tapiroids are model-based; the fossils do not directly reveal diet or ancestry.
summaryZh: 中始新世的 Mimolagus aurorae 由正模上第三臼齿 IVPP V20115 及归入的牙齿和跗骨代表。约 4.5 千克的体重估计及与小型貘类的比较来自模型；化石没有直接记录食性或祖先关系。

title.en: A dental type and associated ankle bones
title.zh: 牙齿正模与归入的踝骨

text.en: The holotype is a right upper third molar, IVPP V20115. The study also refers other teeth, an astragalus, calcanei and a cuboid to Mimolagus aurorae. These named materials document a large Middle Eocene mimotonid in the sampled localities; the teeth and ankle bones are not all one articulated skeleton.
text.zh: 正模是一枚右上第三臼齿 IVPP V20115。研究还将其他牙齿、距骨、跟骨和骰骨归入 Mimolagus aurorae。这些具名材料记录了取样地点的一种大型中始新世拟兔类；这些牙齿和踝骨并非来自一具关节相连的完整骨架。

title.en: Models are not direct ecology
title.zh: 模型结果不是直接生态观察

text.en: An astragalar regression produced an estimated mass of about 4.5 kg, and functional comparison suggested convergence on a small tapiroid form. Cursoriality and a tapiroid-like niche are interpretations, not observed movement or feeding. The result does not make Mimolagus a direct lagomorph ancestor, and it cannot establish a species-wide menu from these specimens.
text.zh: 距骨回归给出的体重估计约为 4.5 千克，功能比较则提示它趋同于小型貘类形态。善跑能力和类似貘类的生态位都是解释，不是直接观察到的运动或取食行为。这一结果不能把 Mimolagus 变成兔形类的直系祖先，也不能仅凭这些标本确立全种食谱。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype right M3 IVPP V20115 and referred teeth, astragalus, calcanei and cuboid establish the anatomical sample and locality.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Referred material; Body-size model; Discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: A 4.5-kilogram estimate, cursoriality and tapiroid-like niche are regression and ecomorphology inferences; the taxon is not a direct lagomorph ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Referred material; Body-size model; Discussion

title.en: A large mimotonid from the Middle Eocene of China sheds light on the evolution of lagomorphs and their kin
title.zh: A large mimotonid from the Middle Eocene of China sheds light on the evolution of lagomorphs and their kin

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

readerSources.locator: pages: 9394; figure: Figures 1–6; Tables S1–S6; Holotype; Referred material; Body-size model; Discussion

title: Onychonycteris: flight and hearing clues in one skeleton
titleZh: 一具爪蝠骨架如何提供飞行与听觉线索？
regions: Fossil Butte Member, Green River Formation, Wyoming, USA
summary: The nearly complete Onychonycteris finneyi holotype ROM 55351A preserves elongated wings and a relatively small cochlea. Wing proportions are compatible with powered flight, while cochlear size was interpreted as evidence against specialized laryngeal echolocation. Both are functional inferences from anatomy, not observed behavior; one fossil also cannot stand in for every early bat or a direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 爪蝠 Onychonycteris finneyi 正模 ROM 55351A 保存了近乎完整的骨架、较长的翼部和相对较小的耳蜗。翼部比例与动力飞行相符；耳蜗大小则被解释为不支持特化的喉源回声定位。两者都是根据解剖提出的功能推断，而非直接观察到的行为；单件化石也不能代表所有早期蝙蝠或已知的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: ROM 55351A preserves elongated wings and a relatively small cochlea; limb proportions and cochlear size were compared with living and fossil bats.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Cochlear dimensions; Limb proportions; Phylogeny

uncertaintyItems.statement: Powered flight and absence of specialized laryngeal echolocation are functional inferences, not observed behaviour, and one specimen is not a direct ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Cochlear dimensions; Limb proportions; Phylogeny

title: A seven-gene test of bat relationships
titleZh: 七基因检验蝙蝠的系统关系
summary: An 8,230-base-pair alignment of four nuclear and three mitochondrial genes places sampled rhinolophoid microbats with megabats rather than with other microbats. Repeated gains or losses of laryngeal echolocation are historical inferences from that topology, not a directly observed origin; limited loci and taxa leave alternatives open.
summaryZh: 由 4 个核基因和 3 个线粒体基因组成、长 8,230 个碱基的比对，将取样的菊头蝠总科小蝙蝠与大蝙蝠归在一起，而非与其他小蝙蝠成支。喉源回声定位的重复获得或丢失是从该拓扑推导的历史解释，并非直接观察到的起源；基因和类群取样有限，仍容许其他解释。

evidenceItems.statement: Four nuclear and three mitochondrial genes contributed 8,230 aligned base pairs; analyses group sampled rhinolophoids with megabats rather than other microbats.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Molecular dataset; Phylogenetic analyses; Trait scenarios

uncertaintyItems.statement: Multiple origins or losses of laryngeal echolocation are alternative historical reconstructions; the topology does not directly observe the first flight or sonar event.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Molecular dataset; Phylogenetic analyses; Trait scenarios

title: Two matrices, two early dinosaur trees
titleZh: 两套矩阵，两种早期恐龙树
summary: A 74-taxon, 457-character analysis grouped theropods with ornithischians as Ornithoscelida. A published reanalysis that rescored characters and added taxa recovered the traditional ornithischian–saurischian split, showing how the result depends on matrix construction.
summaryZh: 一项含 74 个类群、457 项性状的分析将兽脚类与鸟臀类组成鸟跖类。另一项已发表研究重编码性状并增加类群后，恢复了传统的鸟臀类—蜥臀类分支，显示拓扑取决于矩阵构建。

title.en: What the first matrix recovered
title.zh: 第一套矩阵恢复的关系

text.en: The 2017 analysis coded 457 morphological characters for 74 taxa and recovered Theropoda together with Ornithischia as Ornithoscelida. This was a branching hypothesis inferred from the chosen fossil sample and character scores. It was not a direct observation of which dinosaur gave rise to another.
text.zh: 2017 年的分析为 74 个类群编码了 457 项形态性状，并将兽脚类与鸟臀类恢复为鸟跖类。这是根据所选化石样本与性状评分推导出的分支假说，并非直接观察到某种恐龙产生了另一种恐龙。

title.en: Why a second analysis matters
title.zh: 为什么要看第二项分析

text.en: A reanalysis rescored characters and added taxa, then recovered the traditional split between Ornithischia and Saurischia. These are competing results from explicit matrices, and coding, outgroups and taxon sampling affect the short deep branches. The atlas interval of 233–228 Ma is a display context for early dinosaur fossils, not an age dated by either tree.
text.zh: 重分析重编码了性状并增加类群，随后恢复鸟臀类与蜥臀类的传统分支。两者是来自明确矩阵的竞争结果；性状编码、外群和类群取样都会影响较短的深层分支。图谱显示的 233–228 Ma 是早期恐龙化石的场景区间，并非任何一棵树测得的年代。

evidenceItems.statement: The cited 457-character analysis recovers Theropoda plus Ornithischia as Ornithoscelida, whereas the published rescoring and taxon-addition test recovers the traditional topology; these are competing matrix results, not directly observed ancestry or a settled definition of Dinosauria.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–4; Supplementary Information: character list and matrix

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 233–228 Ma atlas interval is a display context for early dinosaur fossils, not an age inferred by either morphology matrix.

title: Buriolestes teeth and a reconstructed ancestral diet
titleZh: 布氏盗龙的牙齿与祖先食性重建
summary: Holotype ULBRA-PVT280 preserves a slender early sauropodomorph skeleton with recurved, serrated teeth. Researchers mapped feeding characters across sampled dinosaurs and placed faunivory near the sauropodomorph root. That ancestral-state result depends on the taxa, character coding and tree used; it is not a meal preserved in this individual or a linear record of the transition to herbivory, and the specimen is not established as a direct ancestor of later sauropods.
summaryZh:
正模标本 ULBRA-PVT280 保存了纤细的早期蜥脚形类骨架和向后弯、带锯齿的牙齿。研究者把食性性状编码到所采样的恐龙类群中，再将祖先状态重建映射到演化树；结果把动物性食物放在蜥脚形类根部附近。

这里的“根部附近”是模型在特定类群、性状编码和树形下得到的结果，不是这件标本胃里的一餐，也不是从肉食到植食的单线记录。该化石也没有被确认为后来的蜥脚类恐龙的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype ULBRA-PVT280 preserves recurved, serrated teeth and a gracile skeleton in a Late Triassic assemblage; the cited matrix maps faunivory near the sauropodomorph root, but neither the diet reconstruction nor the specimen establishes a direct ancestor of herbivorous sauropods.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; Character-state and diet reconstruction

uncertaintyItems.statement: Formation correlation bounds the age; the dietary transition is a mapped hypothesis across sampled taxa, not a linear sequence observed in one lineage.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Systematic palaeontology; Character-state and diet reconstruction

title: What the Eocursor holotype shows about early ornithischians
titleZh: 曙奔龙正模与早期鸟臀类的关系
summary: Holotype SAM-PK-K8025 preserves a partial skull, vertebrae and limb bones from South Africa’s Lower Elliot Formation. A matrix of anatomical characters places Eocursor among early ornithischians, but that placement is an analytical result, not direct evidence that this individual was an ancestor or the group’s first appearance. The broad age interval follows formation-level correlations rather than a direct date on the specimen.
summaryZh: 正模 SAM-PK-K8025 保存了部分头骨、椎骨和肢骨，产自南非下埃利奥特组。形态特征矩阵将 Eocursor 放在早期鸟臀类之中，但这是分析结果，不表示该个体是祖先或该类群的全球首次出现。较宽的年代区间依据组级地层对比，而不是对这件标本直接测年。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype SAM-PK-K8025 preserves a partial skull, vertebrae and limb elements from the Lower Elliot Formation; its early ornithischian placement is a morphology-matrix result and does not make the specimen a direct ancestor or a global first appearance.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The broad display interval follows formation-level correlation and must not be read as a direct specimen date or a global ornithischian FAD.

title: Mussaurus models test how stance changed during growth
titleZh: 鼠龙的三维模型如何检验成长中的姿态变化？
summary: Three-dimensional models combined hatchling material, the yearling specimen PVL 4587, and adult Mussaurus specimens. In the models, the estimated centre of mass shifts forward with growth, supporting a bipedal-to-quadrupedal stance change. Because the reconstruction combines different individuals and depends on body-volume and segmentation choices, it is a model of posture, not a preserved gait or a rule for all sauropodomorphs.
summaryZh: 研究把孵化幼体材料、一龄标本 PVL 4587 和成年鼠龙标本组合成三维模型。模型显示，随成长估计质心前移，并支持从二足到四足的姿态变化。复原结合了不同个体，也取决于身体体积假设和图像分割，因此它是姿态模型，不是化石保存的步态，也不能推广到所有蜥脚形类。

evidenceItems.statement: Digital models built from the hatchling, yearling PVL 4587 and adult Mussaurus sample move the estimated centre of mass forward and support a bipedal-to-quadrupedal ontogenetic stance shift; the stance is a model result assembled from several individuals, not a preserved gait or evolutionary stage.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Three-dimensional modelling and centre of mass; Results

uncertaintyItems.statement: The fossils constrain anatomy; centre of mass and stance are sensitivity-tested reconstructions and cannot be generalized to every sauropodomorph.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Three-dimensional modelling and centre of mass; Results

title: How large was Ledumahadi?
titleZh: 巨雷龙有多大？
regions: Elliot Formation, Free State, South Africa
summary: The partial postcranial holotype BP/1/7120 preserves limb bones used for histology and circumference-based scaling. The study identifies an adult and estimates a mass of about 12 tonnes, with habitual quadrupedality despite flexed, non-columnar limbs; both mass and posture are model-based conclusions.
summaryZh: 不完整的正模颅后骨架 BP/1/7120 保存了用于组织学和骨围尺度估算的肢骨。研究判断其为成年个体，估计体重约 12 吨，并认为它习惯四足行走，尽管四肢弯曲而非柱状；体重和姿态判断均依赖模型。

title.en: The holotype and its measurements
title.zh: 正模与测量资料

text.en: BP/1/7120 is a partial postcranial skeleton. Limb-bone histology—the microscopic record of bone tissue and growth marks—was used to assess maturity, while bone circumference fed a comparative mass estimate of about 12 tonnes. The specimen is the concrete anchor; the number is an output of scaling against other animals.
text.zh: BP/1/7120 是一件不完整的颅后骨架。肢骨组织学（骨组织与生长痕迹的显微记录）用于判断成熟度，骨围则用于建立比较体重估计，结果约为 12 吨。标本是直接依据，体重数字则是与其他动物比较后得到的尺度模型输出。

title.en: A quadrupedal model with limits
title.zh: 四足行走模型及其边界

text.en: The authors inferred habitual quadrupedality even though the limbs were flexed rather than column-like. That conclusion comes from comparative limb metrics, not a preserved footprint sequence or observed gait. The displayed Early Jurassic interval is formation-bounded and does not set a universal threshold for sauropod gigantism or identify Ledumahadi as an ancestor.
text.zh: 尽管肢骨弯曲而非柱状，作者仍推断其习惯四足行走。这一结论来自比较肢骨指标，不是保存的连续足迹或直接观察到的步态。页面显示的早侏罗世区间限于地层组，不定义蜥脚类巨型化的普遍门槛，也不把巨雷龙认定为祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype BP/1/7120 is a partial postcranial skeleton whose limb histology indicates an adult and whose circumference-based model estimates about 12 tonnes with habitual quadrupedality despite flexed, non-columnar limbs; mass and posture are comparative model outputs.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Osteohistology; Body mass; Quadrupedality analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: The specimen is incomplete and the earliest-Jurassic interval is formation-bounded; it is not a universal threshold or ancestor for sauropod gigantism.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype; Osteohistology; Body mass; Quadrupedality analyses

title: How the Scelidosaurus lectotype constrains its armour
titleZh: 选模标本如何约束腿龙甲片的排列
summary: The lectotype—the specimen designated as the name-bearing reference—NHMUK R1111 preserves the skull, jaws, much of the skeleton and associated osteoderms, or bony plates in the skin. Where plates remain associated with the bones, they constrain armour arrangement; missing pieces and preparation history leave gaps. A keratinous covering and the proposed stem-ankylosaur placement are interpretations rather than direct observations.
summaryZh: 选模——指定为承载学名的参考标本——NHMUK R1111 保存头骨、颌骨、大部分骨架及伴生皮内骨，即皮肤中的骨板。仍与骨骼关联的骨板有助于约束甲片排列，但缺失部分和制备历史留下空白。角质覆盖以及将其置于甲龙干群的解释都不是直接观察结果。

evidenceItems.statement: Lectotype NHMUK R1111 preserves skull, jaws, much of the postcranium and associated osteoderms; armour arrangement is directly constrained where association survives, whereas a keratinous covering, biology and stem-ankylosaur placement are comparative interpretations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Lectotype; Dermal skeleton; Biology; Phylogenetic relationships

uncertaintyItems.statement: Missing armour and preparation history prevent a complete in-place map; placement is one analysis rather than an uncontested thyreophoran topology.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Lectotype; Dermal skeleton; Biology; Phylogenetic relationships

title: Yinlong’s holotype and a mosaic of traits
titleZh: Yinlong 正模标本及其镶嵌性状
summary: Holotype IVPP V14530 preserves a nearly complete articulated skeleton with a skull about 18 centimetres long. Its combination of characters helps diagnose Yinlong and an early ceratopsian form; the mosaic does not establish a direct ancestor–descendant link to later ceratopsians.
summaryZh: 正模 IVPP V14530 保存了近乎完整、关节连接的骨架，颅骨长约 18 厘米。其特征组合有助于鉴定 Yinlong 及早期角龙类形态；这种镶嵌组合并不能证明它与后来的角龙类存在直接祖先—后代关系。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype IVPP V14530 preserves a nearly complete articulated skeleton and small skull from the Shishugou Formation; its basal ceratopsian and marginocephalian implications are character-matrix results, not a direct ancestor or global ceratopsian FAD.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The atlas interval is formation-level; topology and character polarity depend on outgroups, coding and the sampled matrix.

title: Edmontosaurus NDGS 2000: skin and preservation
titleZh: NDGS 2000 埃德蒙顿龙：皮肤与保存过程
regions: Hell Creek Formation, North Dakota, USA
summary: NDGS 2000 preserves skin draped over bones, punctures and hook-shaped scores, as well as manus anatomy visible in CT scans. Sediment measurements and these traces let researchers propose a history of scavenging-assisted deflation, drying and burial for this single carcass. The preserved skin and damage are observations; the sequence connecting them is a taphonomic explanation, not a universal recipe for dinosaur “mummies.” The specimen does not by itself reveal original colour or physiology.
summaryZh: NDGS 2000 保存了贴覆骨骼的皮肤、穿刺痕与钩状划痕，CT 扫描还显示了手部解剖。研究者把这些痕迹与沉积物测量结合起来，为这具尸体提出一条由食腐促成泄压、干燥再到埋藏的保存路径。皮肤和损伤是直接观察；把它们连成先后过程属于埋藏学解释，不是恐龙“木乃伊”的通用配方。单件标本也不能单独揭示原始颜色或生理状态。

evidenceItems.statement: NDGS 2000 directly preserves skin draped over bones, punctures, hook scores and CT-visible manus anatomy; scavenging-assisted deflation, desiccation and burial form a taphonomic pathway inferred for this carcass, not a universal recipe for dinosaur skin preservation.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Materials and methods; Biostratinomic alterations; Proposed preservational pathway

uncertaintyItems.statement: The evidence concerns one specimen and one depositional history; skin presence does not establish original colour, physiology or preservation frequency.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Materials and methods; Biostratinomic alterations; Proposed preservational pathway

title: Three Yutyrannus skeletons with filamentous coverings
titleZh: 三件保存丝状体被的羽王龙骨架
summary: Holotype ZCDM V5000 and referred specimens ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001 associate filamentous integument with large tyrannosauroid skeletons. The distribution and structure are observed; insulation, display and complete body coverage are functional reconstructions, and the evidence concerns a non-avian theropod.
summaryZh: 正模 ZCDM V5000 和归入标本 ZCDM V5001、ELDM V1001 将丝状体被与大型暴龙超科骨架关联起来。体被的分布和结构是观察结果；保温、展示功能和全身覆盖范围则属于功能重建，证据针对的是非鸟类兽脚类动物。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype ZCDM V5000 and referred specimens ZCDM V5001 and ELDM V1001 preserve filamentous integument in association with large tyrannosauroid skeletons; feather distribution and structure are observed, but insulation, display and whole-body coverage are functional reconstructions.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred specimens; Integumentary structures; Phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: This is non-avian integument evidence; Avialae, flight performance and living-bird nomenclature remain in the crocodylomorphs-birds package.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype and referred specimens; Integumentary structures; Phylogenetic analysis

title: What a dinosaur's pose above a nest can tell us
titleZh: 恐龙伏在蛋窝上的姿势能说明什么？
summary: At Ukhaa Tolgod in Mongolia, the partial oviraptorid skeleton IGM 100/979 was preserved with its forelimbs spread over a nest of at least fifteen visible eggs and its hindlimbs folded. The arrangement and lack of evident post-mortem transport make brooding or nest attendance a strong interpretation of the association. The fossil preserves a pose and eggs, not the animal's actions, sex or habitual parenting; alternative explanations remain part of the evidence.
summaryZh: 蒙古 Ukhaa Tolgod 的窃蛋龙类部分骨架 IGM 100/979 与一个至少可见十五枚卵的蛋窝一同保存：前肢伸展覆盖在蛋窝上，后肢则折叠。姿势和缺少明显死后搬运痕迹，使孵卵或守巢成为有力解释。但化石记录的是姿势和卵，并未直接记录行为、性别或日常亲代照料；其他解释仍需保留。

evidenceItems.statement: IGM 100/979 preserves folded hindlimbs and forelimbs spread over a nest with at least fifteen visible eggs and no evident post-mortem transport; brooding and parental care are strong behavioural interpretations of the association, not directly observed actions.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen IGM 100/979; Nest geometry; Behavioural alternatives

uncertaintyItems.statement: The original paper explicitly retains alternative explanations and limits testing of parental-system hypotheses in the fossil record.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen IGM 100/979; Nest geometry; Behavioural alternatives

title: Growth marks in tyrannosaur bones, and the limits of a curve
titleZh: 暴龙骨骼生长线与曲线估算的限度
summary: Growth marks in tyrannosaurid bones provide the direct observations in this study's specimen series, which includes FMNH PR 2081. Researchers used estimated ages and body masses to fit growth curves; the reported peak Tyrannosaurus growth rate of about 2.1 kilograms per day is one such estimate, conditional on missing marks and body-mass equations. The specimens span tyrannosaurids from roughly 83 to 66 million years ago, not one population, and the fitted curve is not a universal growth schedule for dinosaurs.
summaryZh: 这项研究直接观察的是一组暴龙科标本骨骼中的生长线，其中包括 FMNH PR 2081；研究者再用估算年龄和体重拟合生长曲线。论文报告的霸王龙峰值生长速率约为每日 2.1 千克，是这类模型估计之一，受缺失生长线和体重方程影响。样本涵盖约 8,300 万至 6,600 万年前的暴龙科，并非一个种群；拟合曲线也不是所有恐龙通用的生长规律。

evidenceItems.statement: Growth marks in a catalogued tyrannosaurid specimen series including FMNH PR 2081 provide histological observations; ages, asymptotic masses and a peak Tyrannosaurus growth rate near 2.1 kilograms per day are fitted estimates conditional on missing marks and body-mass equations.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–3; Supplementary Information and specimen tables
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Histological methods; Growth curves; Life-history comparisons

uncertaintyItems.statement: The 83–66 Ma atlas window spans sampled tyrannosaurids, not one population; the fitted curve is not a universal dinosaur growth schedule.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–3; Supplementary Information and specimen tables
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Histological methods; Growth curves; Life-history comparisons

title: Bite traces and a bone-crushing model for Tyrannosaurus
titleZh: 霸王龙咬痕与骨骼破碎模型
regions: Hell Creek Formation and comparative adult T. rex sample
summary: Bite traces on MOR 799, coprolite SMNH P2609.1 and measurements from seven adult skulls constrain a model of Tyrannosaurus bite force, estimated at 8,526–34,522 N. The force range is modeled; the traces and coprolite are separate evidence and do not identify every prey item or feeding event.
summaryZh: MOR 799 上的咬痕、粪化石 SMNH P2609.1，以及七个成年头骨的测量共同约束了霸王龙咬合力模型，估值为 8526–34,522 牛顿。这个范围来自模型；咬痕和粪化石是不同证据，不能确定每一次捕食对象或进食事件。

evidenceItems.statement: Approximately eighty tooth traces on Triceratops ilium MOR 799 and bone in coprolite SMNH P2609.1 directly document bone interaction and ingestion; bite forces of 8,526–34,522 newtons and tooth pressures are muscle-and-lever model results using BHI 3033 and six other adult skulls.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen examination; Jaw-muscle reconstruction; Bite-force and tooth-pressure models

uncertaintyItems.statement: The models test capability rather than observe a feeding event; MOR 799 and the coprolite do not identify every individual or every feeding context.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen examination; Jaw-muscle reconstruction; Bite-force and tooth-pressure models

title: Did the ancient steranes come from sponges?
titleZh: 古老甾烷来自海绵吗？
regions: South Oman Salt Basin, Sultanate of Oman
summary: In a dated succession from Oman's South Oman Salt Basin, Love et al. measured 24-isopropylcholestanes, a type of sterane molecule, in Cryogenian-to-Cambrian rocks. Detecting the compound is a chemical observation; it does not identify the organism that made it. A later study found that sampled Rhizaria can synthesize the relevant sterol precursors, so the rocks do not uniquely demonstrate that demosponges were present. Rock age, compound identity and biological source are distinct questions.
summaryZh: Love 等人在阿曼南部盐盆地一套经过定年的地层中，测得成冰纪至寒武纪岩石含有 24-异丙基胆甾烷（一类甾烷分子）。检出这种化合物是化学观察，并不能指出制造它的生物。后来的研究发现，已取样的 *Rhizaria* 也能合成相关甾醇前体，因此这些岩石不能单独证明当时已有寻常海绵纲。岩石年代、化合物鉴定和生物来源是彼此不同的问题。

evidenceItems.statement: Love et al. measured covalently bound and extractable C30 steranes in a dated Oman succession; Nettersheim et al. detected relevant precursors across sampled Rhizaria.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: MRM sterane measurements and stratigraphic context
Rhizarian sterol assays and biosynthetic interpretation

uncertaintyItems.statement: Compound presence, depositional age and biological source are separate propositions; alternative extinct producers and diagenetic pathways are not exhaustively excluded.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: MRM sterane measurements and stratigraphic context
Rhizarian sterol assays and biosynthetic interpretation

title: Sponge-like anatomy in a single fossil
titleZh: 单件化石中的海绵样构造
summary: One phosphatized Eocyathispongia specimen preserves a millimetre-scale, multicellular body made of three tubes, with funnel-like and osculum-like openings. Electron microscopy and tomography reveal its cellular geometry, but the sponge-grade interpretation rests on this single specimen, without spicules or an independently repeated canal system.
summaryZh: 一件磷酸盐化的 Eocyathispongia 标本保存了毫米尺度、多细胞、由三条管组成的躯体，并有漏斗状及类似出水孔的开口。电镜和断层成像揭示了其细胞结构；但海绵级解释仅依据这件标本，未见骨针，也没有独立重复发现的水沟系统。

evidenceItems.statement: The holotype is slightly over 1.2 mm wide and 1.1 mm tall and contains hundreds of thousands of phosphatized cells organized into three adjoining hollow tubes.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype microtomography, cellular organization and explicit single-specimen caveat

uncertaintyItems.statement: The authors state that additional specimens are required; funnel and opening homologies do not demonstrate crown-Porifera membership or a global first appearance.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype microtomography, cellular organization and explicit single-specimen caveat

title: Helicolocellus and the hypothesis of an organic sponge skeleton
titleZh: Helicolocellus 的网格能否代表海绵有机骨架
regions: Shibantan Member, Dengying Formation, Hubei, China
summary: The holotype NIGP-176531 and referred fossils preserve a stemmed, goblet-shaped body more than 0.4 metres high, with at least three nested orders of quadrate grids. A morphology matrix places Helicolocellus within crown Porifera, near Hexactinellida, supporting a testable hypothesis of an organic skeleton that did not require mineralized spicules. Grid homology and phylogenetic placement depend on character coding and sampled taxa; these fossils do not directly date every split within the sponge crown group.
summaryZh: 正模 NIGP-176531 及归入该属的其他化石，保存了高逾 0.4 米、带柄的杯状躯体，表面至少有三层嵌套的四边形网格。形态矩阵将 Helicolocellus 放在海绵动物冠群内、接近六放海绵纲；据此提出一种可检验的假说：它可能具有不依赖矿化骨针的有机骨架。网格是否同源、系统位置如何，取决于性状编码和取样类群；这些化石不能直接给海绵冠群内每次分支定年。

evidenceItems.statement: NIGP-176531 and referred material preserve a more than 0.4 m stemmed body with at least three orders of nested quadrate fields.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype NIGP-176531, referred material, reconstruction and Bayesian morphology tree

uncertaintyItems.statement: Grid homology, ancestral skeletal state and phylogenetic placement depend on sampled taxa and character coding; the fossils do not directly date every sponge crown split.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype NIGP-176531, referred material, reconstruction and Bayesian morphology tree

title: Soltanieh spicules and the basal Cambrian sponge record
titleZh: 索尔塔尼耶组骨针与寒武纪底部的海绵记录
summary: Which very early fossils can be identified as sponges with confidence? In the Soltanieh Formation’s Protohertzina anabarica Zone, a review describes siliceous spicules and reassesses twenty proposed Precambrian candidates, rejecting some as abiotic and others as too ambiguous. Under those diagnostic criteria and the record then available, these basal-Cambrian spicules are called the oldest reliable sponge remains; isolated spicules do not establish a crown hexactinellid relationship or rule out an older future find.
summaryZh: 哪些极早期化石能被可靠地鉴定为海绵？一项综述描述了索尔塔尼耶组 Protohertzina anabarica 带中的硅质骨针，并逐一复核二十种被提出的前寒武纪候选材料：有些被判为非生物成因，另一些则过于含糊，无法鉴定。按照该研究的诊断标准和当时已知记录，这些寒武纪基底骨针被称为最古老的可靠海绵遗存；孤立骨针不能确立六放海绵冠群关系，也不能排除未来发现更老的材料。

evidenceItems.statement: The study describes siliceous spicules in the Protohertzina anabarica Zone of the Soltanieh Formation and compares twenty proposed Precambrian sponge candidates.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Diagnostic criteria, Iranian material and candidate reassessment

uncertaintyItems.statement: “Oldest reliable” is conditional on the paper’s diagnostic criteria and then-known record; it is neither a permanent global FAD nor proof of a crown hexactinellid.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Diagnostic criteria, Iranian material and candidate reassessment

title: What one sponge genome can tell us
titleZh: 一份海绵基因组能说明什么
regions: Heron Island reef, Great Barrier Reef, Australia
summary: The draft genome of the living demosponge Amphimedon queenslandica contains many gene families associated with animal signalling, transcription, adhesion and cell cycling, although the adult sponge lacks eumetazoan organs.
summaryZh: 现生寻常海绵 Amphimedon queenslandica 的基因组草图包含许多与动物信号传导、转录、细胞黏附和细胞周期有关的基因家族，尽管成体没有真后生动物式器官。

title.en: A molecular toolkit in a simple body
title.zh: 简单体制中的分子工具

text.en: The published draft assembly and gene annotations report developmental-signalling, transcription-factor, adhesion and cell-cycle families in Amphimedon. Comparisons with sampled non-metazoan outgroups identify repertoires present in this sponge and not detected in those comparison samples. The result separates the presence of molecular machinery from the later assembly of organs and cell types.
text.zh: 已发表的基因组草图组装与基因注释报告 Amphimedon 含有发育信号传导、转录因子、黏附和细胞周期相关基因家族。与取样的非后生动物外群比较后，研究识别出在这只海绵中存在、而在比较样本中未检出的基因组合。结果说明分子机制的存在与器官、细胞类型后来如何形成是两个不同问题。

title.en: One living lineage is not an ancestor
title.zh: 一个现生支系不等于祖先

text.en: Amphimedon queenslandica is one living demosponge, and its genome is a draft assembly interpreted through comparative annotation. Gene presence, absence and family size can inform evolutionary hypotheses, but they cannot reconstruct a literal Precambrian animal or represent every member of Porifera. The study concerns the sampled genome and comparison set.
text.zh: Amphimedon queenslandica 是一个现生寻常海绵物种，其基因组还是通过比较注释解读的草图组装。基因的有无及家族大小可以支持演化假说，却不能复原一只字面意义上的前寒武纪动物，也不能代表整个海绵动物门。研究结论限于这份基因组和所选比较样本。

evidenceItems.statement: The published assembly and annotation identify metazoan developmental-signalling and adhesion repertoires absent from sampled non-metazoan outgroups.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Draft assembly, gene-family inventories and comparative enrichment analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Amphimedon is one derived living demosponge; presence, absence and family expansion cannot reconstruct a literal Precambrian ancestor or all Porifera.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Draft assembly, gene-family inventories and comparative enrichment analyses

title.en: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity
title.zh: The Amphimedon queenslandica genome and the evolution of animal complexity

scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

title: Why genome-scale studies disagree about the animal root
titleZh: 为什么基因组研究对动物根部有不同结论？
summary: Two genome-scale studies asked which living animal lineage branches nearest the rest: sponges or comb jellies. An analysis of 1,719 genes from 97 species supported sponges in that position under site-heterogeneous models; a separate study adding 27 comb-jelly transcriptomes recovered comb jellies instead. Each result has support within its own dataset and model, but the disagreement shows that sampling and evolutionary assumptions affect the inferred root. Neither analysis directly observes the first animal.
summaryZh: 两项基因组研究询问：在现生动物中，哪一支最接近其余动物的共同分支——海绵动物还是栉水母？一项分析了 97 个物种的 1,719 个基因，并在位点异质模型下支持海绵动物位于该位置；另一项新增 27 份栉水母转录组后恢复了栉水母。两种结果各自在其数据和模型内获得支持，但分歧说明取样与演化模型会影响根部位置；研究并没有直接观察到最早的动物。

evidenceItems.statement: Simion et al. assembled 1,719 genes from 97 species; Whelan et al. added 27 ctenophore transcriptomes and tested multiple filtering schemes.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 27 new ctenophore transcriptomes, filtering and alternative root result

uncertaintyItems.statement: Bootstrap or posterior support measures fit within a chosen dataset and model; they do not turn either root into a direct observation of the first animal.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 27 new ctenophore transcriptomes, filtering and alternative root result

title: Auroralumina: what two branching tubes can tell us
titleZh: Auroralumina 的分枝管留下了哪些线索？
summary:
On a bedding plane from Charnwood Forest, specimen BGS GSM 105875 preserves two branching tubes within a rigid, many-sided organic skeleton, with dense tentacle-like impressions. The dated succession places this Ediacaran fossil at about 562–557 million years ago. A morphology analysis used the preserved combination to test its position among cnidarians.

That placement depends on how the tentacles, periderm-like covering and single fossil surface are interpreted. The specimen does not record a measured feeding event, a direct ancestor, or a permanent global first appearance for cnidarians.
summaryZh:
查恩伍德森林一块层面上的标本 BGS GSM 105875，保存了两根分枝管、刚性的多面有机骨架，以及密集的触手状印痕。对火山地层的定年把这件埃迪卡拉纪化石置于约 5.62 亿至 5.57 亿年前。形态分析据此检验它在刺胞动物中的位置。

这种位置取决于研究者如何解释触手状结构、类似围鞘的覆盖物，以及单一化石表面所显示的形态。标本没有记录一次实际摄食事件，也不能证明直系祖先关系或刺胞动物全球首现。

evidenceItems.statement: BGS GSM 105875 records densely packed tentacles extending from two bifurcating tubes enclosed by a rigid polyhedral organic skeleton.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen BGS GSM 105875, stratigraphy and morphology matrix

uncertaintyItems.statement: Tentacles, periderm and matrix position are interpretations of a single surface; the fossil is not a measured feeding event, direct ancestor or permanent global FAD.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen BGS GSM 105875, stratigraphy and morphology matrix

title: What are the repeated lines on Haootia?
titleZh: Haootia 身上的重复线条是什么？
regions: Fermeuse Formation, Bonavista Peninsula, Newfoundland, Canada
summary: The holotype of *Haootia quadriformis* from Newfoundland's Fermeuse Formation preserves a four-part body pattern and repeated, aligned impressions around a central region and stalk-like structure. The 2014 paper interpreted the lines as muscle bundles; a 2015 reassessment disputed their orientation and comparison, and a 2024 redescription proposed a crown-Staurozoa relationship. The fossil preserves an impression, not tissue histology, so whether the lines are muscle and how closely *Haootia* belongs to Staurozoa remain contested.
summaryZh: 纽芬兰费穆斯组的 *Haootia quadriformis* 正模保存了四向排列的身体印痕；中央区域和柄状结构周围可见多条平行重复的线。2014 年论文将其解释为肌束，2015 年的重新解读质疑线条方向及比较依据，2024 年的重描述则提出它可能与十字水母冠群相关。化石保存的是印痕，并未保存组织切片，因此线条是否代表肌肉、*Haootia* 与十字水母的关系有多近，仍有争论。

evidenceItems.statement: The holotype preserves a fourfold arrangement of branches and closely aligned linear impressions around a central region and stalk-like structure.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Plastotype OUM ÁT.424/p and original muscular-cnidarian reconstruction
Reassessment of muscle orientation and staurozoan comparison

uncertaintyItems.statement: Preservation does not expose histology; published authors differ on muscular correspondence and how strongly the fossil can be assigned to Staurozoa.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Plastotype OUM ÁT.424/p and original muscular-cnidarian reconstruction
Reassessment of muscle orientation and staurozoan comparison

title: How new Xianguangia fossils reshape a body-plan debate
titleZh: 新增化石如何改变 Xianguangia 的身体构型争论
summary: A study of 85 new specimens plus type material treats Xianguangia, Chengjiangopenna and Galeaplumosus as one form, preserving a holdfast, internal cavities and pinnule-bearing appendages. One analysis reconstructs a suspension-feeding stem-cnidarian body plan; another places Dinomischidae on the ctenophore stem, while alternative coding yields a polytomy. The larger sample sharpens comparison, but anatomy and placement remain disputed.
summaryZh: 一项研究将 85 件新标本与模式材料合并考察，把 Xianguangia、Chengjiangopenna 和 Galeaplumosus 视为同一形态；材料保存固着结构、内部空腔和带小羽枝的附肢。一种分析复原出悬浮摄食的刺胞动物干群体制；另一种把 Dinomischidae 放在栉水母干群，而替代性状编码会得到多分支结果。更大的样本使比较更充分，但解剖解释和系统位置仍有争议。

evidenceItems.statement: The combined material preserves a holdfast, internal cavities and pinnule-bearing appendages; specimens once named Chengjiangopenna and Galeaplumosus are treated as parts or synonyms.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 85 new specimens, synonymy, reconstruction and phylogenetic analysis
Figure 4 and Supplementary Figure S1; main Bayesian stem-ctenophore result and alternative-coding sensitivity analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Phylogenetic result changes with anatomical coding; suspension feeding is a functional inference and neither analysis establishes direct ancestry.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 85 new specimens, synonymy, reconstruction and phylogenetic analysis
Figure 4 and Supplementary Figure S1; main Bayesian stem-ctenophore result and alternative-coding sensitivity analyses

title: A swimming medusa in the Cambrian fossil record
titleZh: 化石记录中的寒武纪游泳水母
regions: Raymond Quarry, Burgess Shale, British Columbia, Canada
summary: Compressed Burgess Shale fossils preserve a macroscopic bell and tentacles attributed to a middle-Cambrian medusa. The assemblage supports the presence of swimming medusae at that time; it does not reveal the group’s ancestor or preserve every part of a living jellyfish.
summaryZh: 布尔吉斯页岩的压扁化石保存了大型钟形体和触手，被归为中寒武世水母。该化石组合支持当时已有游泳水母；它没有揭示这一类群的祖先，也没有保存现生水母的全部结构。

evidenceItems.statement: The described sample includes bell-shaped bodies up to roughly 20 cm with a circumferential margin, dense tentacles and radial internal features.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Raymond Quarry specimens, diagnosis and medusozoan comparisons

uncertaintyItems.statement: Compression changes three-dimensional shape; affinity does not identify a direct ancestor, the first medusa of every lineage or measured locomotor speed.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Raymond Quarry specimens, diagnosis and medusozoan comparisons

title: A 41-taxon test of cnidarian relationships
titleZh: 用 41 个类群检验刺胞动物的亲缘关系
regions: Global living-taxon transcriptome and genome samples
summary: The matrix combines 15 new transcriptomes with 26 public genomes or transcriptomes to compare living cnidarian branches. It supports several named groups, but Hexacorallia is weakly supported because Ceriantharia’s position is equivocal. These results describe sampled living taxa; they do not date fossils or settle the placement of extinct forms.
summaryZh: 这套矩阵把 15 个新测转录组与 26 个公开基因组或转录组结合起来，比较现生刺胞动物分支。分析支持若干已命名类群，但角海葵目的位置不确定，使六放珊瑚亚纲的支持较弱。结果只针对所取样的现生类群，不能为化石定年，也不能裁定灭绝类群的位置。

evidenceItems.statement: Fifteen new transcriptomes were combined with twenty-six public genomes or transcriptomes; raw data and analysis assets were deposited.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–4; Supplementary Figures S1–S12; BioProject PRJNA263637
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 41-taxon matrices, partition/model tests and node support

uncertaintyItems.statement: A living-taxon topology does not date fossil specimens, settle extinct placements or make the navigation ontology a complete phylogeny.

referenceLinks.figure: Figures 1–4; Supplementary Figures S1–S12; BioProject PRJNA263637
referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 41-taxon matrices, partition/model tests and node support

title: Tiny parasites in the cnidarian tree
titleZh: 刺胞动物树上的微型寄生者
regions: Laboratory genome and transcriptome samples from parasitic cnidarians
summary: A 77-taxon, 51,940-amino-acid analysis places sampled Myxozoa within Cnidaria as sister to Polypodium and links their miniature parasitic bodies with extreme genome and gene-content reduction. This is a comparative result from sampled species, not a complete reconstruction of every myxozoan ancestor.
summaryZh: 一项包含 77 个类群、51,940 个氨基酸位点的分析，将所取样黏体动物置于刺胞动物内，并恢复为 Polypodium 的姐妹群；研究还把微型寄生体制与基因组及基因内容的极端缩减联系起来。这是取样比较结果，不是对所有黏体动物祖先的完整复原。

title.en: A surprising place on the animal tree
title.zh: 动物树上的意外位置

text.en: The study combined four new myxozoan assemblies with Kudoa, Myxobolus and Polypodium data in a 77-taxon amino-acid matrix. The sampled myxozoans fall within Cnidaria, as sister to Polypodium. Genome-size estimates and gene-category comparisons associate their microscopic parasitic body plans with extensive genomic reduction.
text.zh: 研究把四份新黏体动物基因组组装与 Kudoa、Myxobolus 和 Polypodium 数据结合，构建了含 77 个类群的氨基酸矩阵。所取样黏体动物位于刺胞动物内部，并与 Polypodium 互为姐妹群。基因组大小估算及基因类别比较显示，其微型寄生体制与大幅度基因组缩减相关。

title.en: Reduction is reconstructed comparatively
title.zh: 缩减是比较重建的结果

text.en: The study infers gene loss and parasite adaptation by comparing living samples and annotations. Polar capsules and cnidarian nematocysts are treated as homologous structures, but this does not make their life histories identical. The result supports placement and reduction in the sampled lineages; it does not document every step in an ancient transition.
text.zh: 研究通过比较现生样本和基因注释来推断基因丢失与寄生适应。研究把黏体动物的极囊与刺胞动物的刺丝囊视为同源结构，但这不表示它们的生活史相同。结果支持所取样支系的系统位置与基因组缩减，却没有记录远古转变的每一个步骤。

evidenceItems.statement: Four new myxozoan assemblies, Kudoa and Myxobolus data and Polypodium were compared in a 77-taxon amino-acid matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 77-taxon phylogeny, genome-size estimates and gene-category comparisons

uncertaintyItems.statement: Gene loss and parasite adaptation are reconstructed from extant samples; polar capsules and nematocysts are homologous interpretations, not identical life histories.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: 77-taxon phylogeny, genome-size estimates and gene-category comparisons

title.en: Genomic insights into the evolutionary origin of Myxozoa within Cnidaria
title.zh: Genomic insights into the evolutionary origin of Myxozoa within Cnidaria
