title: A molecular-clock estimate for early corals
titleZh: 分子钟估算石珊瑚的早期分化
regions: Global sampled deep- and shallow-water living corals
summary: A four-locus relaxed-clock analysis places deep-water scleractinian splits near 425 Ma, well before the roughly 240 Ma skeletal record. This is a modelled divergence estimate conditioned on sequence and calibration choices, not evidence of a Paleozoic coral skeleton.
summaryZh: 一项基于四个位点的松弛分子钟分析，将深水石珊瑚的分化置于约 425 Ma，远早于约 240 Ma 的骨骼化石记录。这是受序列和校准选择影响的模型估算，并非古生代珊瑚骨骼的化石证据。

evidenceItems.statement: The analysis samples mitochondrial 12S, 16S and COX1 plus nuclear 28S, including Gardineriidae and Micrabaciidae.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Four-locus sampling, relaxed-clock calibration and deep-water lineages

uncertaintyItems.statement: The approximately 425 Ma node is model-derived and does not demonstrate a mineralized Paleozoic scleractinian, rugose ancestry or an exact origination date.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Four-locus sampling, relaxed-clock calibration and deep-water lineages

title: Do Triassic coral skeletons record photosymbiosis?
titleZh: 三叠纪珊瑚骨骼能否显示光合共生？
summary: In Turkish Late Triassic coral skeletons, researchers compared growth-band regularity, carbon and oxygen isotope patterns, and nitrogen isotopes in intracrystalline organic matter with living taxa. Together, these proxies are consistent with photosymbiosis in the sampled fossils, around 212 million years old. The chemistry supports an ecological interpretation; it does not preserve the symbiont or identify an algal partner.
summaryZh: 研究者比较土耳其晚三叠世珊瑚骨骼的生长带规律、碳氧同位素模式，以及晶体内部有机质中的氮同位素，并与现生类群对照。这些间接指标共同支持约 2.12 亿年前所取样化石存在光合共生的解释。化学信号支持的是生态推断；骨骼没有保存共生体本身，也无法识别具体藻类伙伴。

evidenceItems.statement: Growth-band regularity, skeletal δ13C/δ18O covariance and intracrystalline organic-matter δ15N were measured across Turkish fossil taxa and living comparisons.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Skeleton microstructure and C, O and N isotope measurements

uncertaintyItems.statement: Geochemical proxies infer trophic mode; they do not identify a dinoflagellate species, every colony’s ecology or the original origin of coral symbiosis.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Skeleton microstructure and C, O and N isotope measurements

title: A White Sea sample of Kimberella bodies
titleZh: 白海 Kimberella 躯体样本
summary: More than 35 Kimberella fossils from the White Sea show a bilaterally symmetrical benthic body, a broad foot-like region and a non-mineralized dorsal cover. The repeated anatomy invites comparison with molluscs, but the sample preserves no radula and does not establish membership in the molluscan crown group.
summaryZh: 三十五件以上来自白海的 Kimberella 化石呈现两侧对称的底栖躯体、宽阔的足状区域和非矿化背盖。重复出现的构造可与软体动物比较，但样本未保存齿舌，也不能据此确认其属于软体动物冠群。

evidenceItems.statement: Repeated specimens preserve bilateral outline, a broad ventral region and a dorsal cover interpreted as a non-mineralized shell.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Description; reconstruction; discussion of mollusc-like characters

uncertaintyItems.statement: Mollusc-like does not mean crown Mollusca: no radula is preserved and the body regions admit competing homology interpretations.

title: Odontogriphus: repeated tooth rows in a large fossil sample
titleZh: 齿谜虫：大量化石中的连续齿列
summary: How can a soft-bodied animal’s feeding apparatus be reconstructed when no one fossil preserves it all? Across 189 Burgess Shale specimens, Odontogriphus repeatedly shows paired transverse tooth rows on a membrane, with new rows added from behind, alongside a broad foot and structures in the mantle groove. The repeated geometry is observable in the sample; identifying the apparatus as a molluscan radula and placing the animal on the molluscan stem are comparative interpretations, not direct ancestry.
summaryZh: 当没有一件化石保存完整时，怎样复原软躯动物的摄食结构？189 件布尔吉斯页岩标本反复显示，膜上有成对横向齿列，后方还有新齿列替换；同时，样本也保存宽阔的足和外套沟结构。连续齿列的几何关系可直接观察；将其认作软体动物齿舌、并把动物放在软体动物干群，则是比较解释，不是直系祖先证明。

evidenceItems.statement: Paired transverse teeth lie on a membrane and are replaced from behind, providing a reproducible anatomical basis for comparison with a molluscan radula.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Tooth-row geometry is observed; radular homology, ctenidia identity and stem-mollusc position are comparative interpretations rather than direct ancestry.

title: One Orthrozanclus fossil combines a shell, plates and spines
titleZh: 一件 Orthrozanclus 化石兼有前壳、骨片与棘
summary: An articulated Orthrozanclus reburrus body preserves an anterior shell, three zones of overlapping sclerites (small protective plates), and long marginal spines. This combination tests proposed relationships among halwaxiids, molluscs and other lophotrochozoans. The anatomy is observed in one fossil; group placement depends on character comparison and coding, and does not make Orthrozanclus a crown mollusc or direct ancestor.
summaryZh: 一件关节相连的 Orthrozanclus reburrus 化石同时保存前壳、三带相互覆盖的小型保护骨片（sclerites）和长边缘棘。这种组合可用于检验哈瓦西虫类与软体动物及其他冠轮动物的关系假说。解剖观察来自一件化石；类群位置取决于性状比较与编码，因此不能据此把 Orthrozanclus 定为冠群软体动物或直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The anterior shell, imbricating sclerites and peripheral spines occur together rather than being assembled from isolated small shelly fossils.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Description of Orthrozanclus and character coding

uncertaintyItems.statement: Halwaxiida and its placement near Mollusca or other lophotrochozoans depend on homology and matrix scoring; the specimen is not a crown mollusc or direct ancestor.

title: What Pojetaia shell sections show about early bivalves
titleZh: Pojetaia 壳体切片显示了什么
regions: Cambrian Series 2 localities in Siberia and Australia
summary: Sections of Pojetaia and Fordilla shells show a layered inner fabric that the study compares with foliated aragonite in living monoplacophorans. Preservation can alter shell minerals, and structural resemblance alone does not establish shared origin: the study does not identify undisputed Cambrian nacre, or mother-of-pearl.
summaryZh: Pojetaia 和 Fordilla 的贝壳切片显示层状内层结构，研究将其与现生单板纲的片状文石作比较。成岩作用可能改变贝壳矿物，仅凭结构相似不能证明两者同源；该研究没有确认无争议的寒武纪珍珠层。

evidenceItems.statement: Pojetaia and Fordilla sections show a laminar inner fabric compared with foliated aragonite in living monoplacophorans.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Diagenesis and structural analogy limit mineral and homology claims; the paper explicitly withholds undisputed Cambrian nacre.

title: Can Nectocaris be a cephalopod without a shell?
titleZh: 没有硬壳的 Nectocaris 会是头足类吗？
summary: Ninety newly prepared Burgess Shale specimens of Nectocaris preserve paired eyes, two tentacles, side fins and a ventral funnel-like structure. These soft parts prompted a cephalopod interpretation, but the fossils do not preserve several structures that would diagnose that placement: a chambered shell, its connecting siphuncle, a beak or a radula. The proposed relationship therefore remains contested rather than a secure record of crown cephalopods.
summaryZh: 布尔吉斯页岩中 90 件新制备的 Nectocaris 标本保存了成对眼、两条触手、侧鳍和腹侧漏斗状结构。这些软组织促成了头足类解释，但化石没有保存几种可诊断这一归属的结构：具腔室的壳、连接壳腔的体管、喙或齿舌。因此，这种亲缘关系仍有争议，不能视为冠群头足类的确定记录。

evidenceItems.statement: The expanded sample repeatedly preserves paired camera-like eyes, lateral fins, an axial cavity and a ventral funnel-like structure.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The cephalopod interpretation lacks a preserved siphuncle, chambered shell, beak or radula and remains a contested topology rather than a secure crown fossil.

title: Genome-scale sampling and the molluscan tree
titleZh: 基因组取样揭示的软体动物关系
regions: Transcriptome and genome sample across living Mollusca
summary: Genomic matrices place chitons (Polyplacophora) and the shell-less aplacophorans together as Aculifera, and recover gastropods with bivalves. Monoplacophorans were not sampled, and analyses did not statistically resolve every competing arrangement among the other shelled molluscs.
summaryZh: 基因组矩阵将多板纲（石鳖）与无板纲（无壳类）归为有棘类，并恢复出腹足纲与双壳纲的关系。研究没有取样单板纲；其他有壳类之间的若干竞争拓扑也未获统计学区分。

evidenceItems.statement: Sampled chitons group with a monophyletic Aplacophora, while gastropods and bivalves form a supported clade in the reported analyses.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Monoplacophora was unsampled and several conchiferan alternatives were not rejected; support belongs to the published matrices and models.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxon sampling and approximately unbiased tests

title: Molluscan phylogenomics: Monoplacophora with Cephalopoda
titleZh: 软体动物系统基因组研究：单板纲与头足纲的亲缘位置
regions: Fifteen new transcriptomes plus published living-mollusc data
summary: Smith et al. added transcriptomes for 15 species to a matrix representing all major living molluscan groups. Their principal analyses placed Monoplacophora with Cephalopoda, challenging the Serialia grouping. Other matrices and studies recover different deep conchiferan relationships, so this is a result of that dataset rather than a settled molluscan tree.
summaryZh: Smith 等人为分析矩阵新增 15 个物种的转录组，并取样所有主要现生软体动物类群。其主要分析将单板纲与头足纲恢复为姐妹群，挑战了将单板纲与多板纲合称为 Serialia 的拓扑。其他矩阵与研究对 Conchifera 深层关系的结果不同，因此这只是该数据集得到的结果，并非已经定论的软体动物系统树。

evidenceItems.statement: The principal analyses recover Monoplacophora with Cephalopoda and reject a monoplacophoran–chiton Serialia grouping in this dataset.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Deep conchiferan nodes vary among matrices and contemporary studies; the published corrigendum means corrected supplementary figures are the controlling visual record.

title: Nodal signalling and opposite shell coiling in two snails
titleZh: 两种腹足动物的 Nodal 信号与相反壳旋向
regions: Laboratory embryos of Lottia gigantea and Biomphalaria glabrata
summary: Why do these two snails coil their shells in opposite directions? In embryos of the dextral limpet Lottia gigantea and the sinistral snail Biomphalaria glabrata, nodal and Pitx expression appears on opposite sides, matching each species’ adult chirality. Inhibiting the Nodal pathway disrupts Pitx expression and shell coiling in the tested animals. This experiment connects a developmental signal to handedness in two living gastropods; it does not directly explain torsion, fossil coiling or every molluscan asymmetry.
summaryZh: 这两种蜗牛为何朝相反方向旋壳？在右旋的巨帽贝 Lottia gigantea 和左旋的光滑双脐螺 Biomphalaria glabrata 胚胎中，nodal 与 Pitx 在相反侧表达，方向与成体手性相应。抑制 Nodal 通路后，实验个体的 Pitx 表达和壳旋卷都会受扰。这项实验把发育信号与两种现生腹足动物的左右性联系起来，但没有直接解释扭转、化石壳旋或所有软体动物的不对称机制。

evidenceItems.statement: nodal and Pitx are expressed on opposite embryonic sides in dextral Lottia and sinistral Biomphalaria, and inhibitor treatment disrupts Pitx and coiling.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The experiment tests chirality in two living gastropods; it does not directly reconstruct torsion, fossil shell coiling or every molluscan asymmetry mechanism.

title: What octopus gene expansions can—and cannot—explain
titleZh: 章鱼基因家族扩张能说明什么，又不能说明什么
regions: Single male Octopus bimaculoides genome and twelve tissue transcriptomes
summary:
The reference genome came from one male Octopus bimaculoides; RNA transcriptomes sampled twelve tissues. The assembly covered more than 97% of expressed protein-coding genes and revealed expansions in protocadherin and C2H2 zinc-finger families, extensive genome rearrangement and tissue-biased gene expression.

These comparisons identify genomic features associated with octopus biology, but they do not show that any one expansion caused arms, suckers, eyes or neural complexity. The study found no evidence for the proposed whole-genome duplication, while noting that duplication followed by extensive gene loss was not ruled out. One genome and its tissue samples cannot stand for every octopus.
summaryZh:
参考基因组来自一只雄性加州双斑蛸；RNA 转录组则取自 12 种组织。组装涵盖了超过 97% 的已表达蛋白编码基因，并显示原钙黏蛋白和 C2H2 锌指基因家族扩张、广泛的基因组重排，以及组织偏向的基因表达。

这些比较揭示了与章鱼生物学相关的基因组特征，却不能证明某一种基因家族扩张导致了腕、吸盘、眼睛或神经复杂性。研究没有发现所提出的全基因组复制证据，但也没有排除复制后大量基因丢失的可能。一只章鱼的基因组和组织样本不能代表所有章鱼。

evidenceItems.statement: The assembly covers more than 97% of expressed protein-coding genes and supports protocadherin and C2H2 expansions, extensive rearrangement and tissue-biased cephalopod-specific genes.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Assembly; gene families; genome linkage; transcriptomes

uncertaintyItems.statement: Comparative association does not prove that any one expansion caused arms, suckers, eyes or neural complexity, and the study found no whole-genome duplication.

title: Micrina: rebuilding an animal from isolated plates
titleZh: 从 Micrina 的孤立骨片重建双瓣体制
regions: Early Cambrian Arrowie Basin, South Australia
summary: Micrina is known from isolated sclerites—small hard skeletal plates—not an articulated whole animal. Sellate plates preserve paired muscle scars; protrusions on mitral plates have been interpreted as muscle platforms. Bringing those observations together yields a testable reconstruction of a nearly bilaterally symmetrical, attached animal with two valves. The plate-to-valve homology and a position on the brachiopod stem remain hypotheses; the fossil record does not preserve the proposed articulation directly.
summaryZh: Micrina 留下的是彼此分离的骨片，而非关节相连的完整个体。sellate 骨片上可见成对肌痕；mitral 骨片的突起则被解释为肌肉附着平台。研究把这些观察组合起来，提出一种可检验的复原：近两侧对称、固着生活的双瓣动物。骨片与壳瓣是否同源，以及它是否属于腕足动物干群，仍是假说；化石并未直接保存复原中的关节连接。

evidenceItems.statement: Sellate sclerites preserve paired muscle scars, whereas mitral apophyses are interpreted as muscle platforms in a near-bilateral bivalved reconstruction.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: p. 726, Figure 2, sellate paired muscle scars and mitral apophyses; pp. 726–727, Figure 3, physical reconstruction

uncertaintyItems.statement: The sclerites were isolated in the fossil record; articulation, valve homology and a stem-brachiopod position are reconstructions, not a preserved whole animal.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: pp. 726–727, Figure 3, reconstruction and phylogenetic model

title: Kutorgina: soft tissues preserved with the shell valves
titleZh: 顾脱贝：与壳瓣一同保存的软组织
summary: Kutorgina chengjiangensis shows that an early shell-bearing brachiopod preserved more than its valves. Chengjiang fossils retain paired calcareous shells with an early spirolophe-stage lophophore, oesophagus, stomach, intestine, terminal anus and pedicle. These are fossilized anatomical structures; comparisons about how the animal fed or what they imply about brachiopod ancestry are interpretations. The combination does not make Kutorgina a direct ancestor of living brachiopods.
summaryZh: Kutorgina chengjiangensis 显示，早期具壳腕足动物留下的证据不止壳瓣。澄江化石把成对钙质壳与早期螺旋腕阶段的触手冠、食道、胃、肠、末端肛门和肉茎一同保存下来。这些是化石直接记录的解剖结构；关于它如何摄食、以及这些结构对腕足动物祖先意味着什么，仍属于比较解释。这样的特征组合也不表示顾脱贝是现生腕足动物的直系祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: The material preserves an early spirolophe-stage lophophore, oesophagus, stomach, intestine, terminal anus and pedicle within paired valves.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Soft anatomy is directly fossilized, but functional comparisons and ancestral-state claims do not turn Kutorgina into a direct ancestor of living articulated brachiopods.

title: What Lingula’s genome reveals about shell building
titleZh: Lingula 基因组揭示的贝壳建造线索
regions: Kasari Bay, Amami Island, Japan; laboratory multi-omics sample
summary: A draft genome, developmental transcriptomes and shell proteome for Lingula provide molecular evidence for studying phosphate biomineralization and lophotrochozoan relationships. Shared or lineage-specific components help frame those comparisons; they do not show that different shells formed identically or resolve ancestry on their own.
summaryZh: Lingula 的基因组草图、发育转录组和贝壳蛋白质组，为研究磷酸盐生物矿化及冠轮动物关系提供分子证据。共享或谱系特有的成分有助于提出比较问题；它们不能证明不同贝壳以完全相同的方式形成，也不能单独确定祖先关系。

evidenceItems.statement: The 425-Mb assembly, staged RNA data and shell proteome identify expanded chitin-synthase families, shared regulatory components and lineage-specific matrix proteins.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Genome; phylogenomics; shell matrix and biomineralization

uncertaintyItems.statement: Shared genes do not make brachiopod shell identical to molluscan shell or vertebrate bone; lineage-specific combinations support independent biomineralization histories.

title: A mosaic reconstruction of Yuganotheca
titleZh: Yuganotheca 的性状镶嵌复原
summary: The study draws on 710 referred Yuganotheca elegans specimens to reconstruct paired agglutinated valves, a horseshoe-shaped lophophore, a two-part tube and a long pedicle. This anatomy is assembled across the sample; no single fossil is said to preserve the entire combination. The mosaic invites comparison near the brachiopod–phoronid stem region, but exact placement and the homology of valves and attachment structures remain unresolved.
summaryZh:
研究综合了 710 件归入 Yuganotheca elegans 的标本，重建出一组组合结构：成对的团块胶结壳瓣、马蹄形触手冠、分成两部分的管状附着结构，以及一根长柄。这里的触手冠（lophophore）指由触手构成的冠状结构；整套组合是跨标本重建，并非某一件化石完整保存了所有部分。

这组镶嵌形态适合与腕足动物—帚虫动物干群附近的假说作比较，但不能据此确定精确位置。壳瓣、管状结构和附着结构之间的同源关系仍未解决。

evidenceItems.statement: Across referred specimens, the reconstruction combines a lophophoral chamber between paired agglutinated valves with a collar, conical tube and long pedicle with inferred coelomic space; no individual fossil is asserted to preserve every feature.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Materials and Methods, Material; Description, paired valves, lophophore, tube and pedicle; Figures 1–3

uncertaintyItems.statement: The mosaic supports a location near the brachiopod–phoronid stem region but does not resolve whether particular valves, tubes or attachment structures are directly homologous.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Phylogenetic analysis and evolutionary implications, Figure 6

title: Did trilobites have a long hidden history?
titleZh: 三叶虫在广泛化石记录前有多长的隐匿历史？
regions: Global lower Cambrian occurrence and morphology sample
summary:
Trilobites appear widely in the early Cambrian body-fossil record. Holmes and Budd reassessed a morphological character matrix for early artiopodans and compared parsimony and Bayesian analyses to ask how much earlier trilobite origins might lie than those fossils.

In the sampled analyses, the inferred origin falls relatively close to the oldest widespread trilobite body fossils, leaving a shorter “cryptic” interval than some accounts propose. This is a topology-and-clock result, not a fossil date or proof that trilobites were absent earlier. Character coding, tree shape, time priors and the incompleteness of the record all affect the estimate.
summaryZh:
三叶虫在早寒武世的身体化石记录中广泛出现。Holmes 与 Budd 重新评估早期节肢动物形态性状矩阵，并比较简约法和贝叶斯分析，以估计三叶虫起源可能比这些化石早多少。

在所采样的分析中，推断的起源时间与最早广泛出现的三叶虫身体化石相距较近，因此隐匿区间比一些解释所设想的更短。这是拓扑和时间模型的结果，不是化石直接定年，也不能证明更早时期没有三叶虫。性状编码、系统树形状、时间先验和化石记录的不完整都会影响估计。

evidenceItems.statement: Parsimony and Bayesian analyses of sampled early artiopodans recover a short interval between inferred trilobite origin and the oldest widespread body fossils.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Phylogenetic analyses; Divergence-time and palaeobiogeographic tests

uncertaintyItems.statement: Tree shape, clock priors, character coding and survivorship bias condition the result; a modelled origin is not a fossil occurrence or a direct ancestor.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Phylogenetic analyses; Divergence-time and palaeobiogeographic tests

title: Three-dimensional trilobites reveal hidden mouth anatomy
titleZh: 三维保存的三叶虫显露了哪些口部结构？
summary: Micro-CT reconstructions of ash-entombed Tatelt Formation trilobites, including Protolenus and Gigoutella, resolve four pairs of appendages behind the antennae, a labrum, mouth structures, and digestive tissues. These rare three-dimensional fossils let researchers examine anatomy obscured in flattened specimens. Feeding mechanics and body-part homologies remain comparative interpretations; the sample does not establish behavior or anatomy for every trilobite.
summaryZh: 对 Tatelt 组火山灰包裹的三叶虫（包括 Protolenus 与 Gigoutella）进行显微 CT 复原后，可辨认出触角之后四对头部附肢、上唇、口部结构和消化组织。这类少见的三维化石让研究者观察到压扁标本难以分辨的解剖。取食力学和身体部位同源关系仍是比较解释，这组材料不能代表所有三叶虫的行为或解剖。

evidenceItems.statement: X-ray microtomography resolves antennae, four post-antennal head-limb pairs, a labrum, a slit-like mouth and digestive tissues in articulated specimens.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The inferred feeding apparatus and homologies compare a rare local preservational window; they do not establish behaviour, ancestry or anatomy for every trilobite.

title: Did trilobite upper limbs act as gills?
titleZh: 三叶虫的上肢支是否用于呼吸？
regions: Burgess Shale and Beecher’s Trilobite Bed specimen samples
summary: Electron and X-ray imaging of Triarthrus eatoni filaments records a narrow centre with expanded margins; Olenoides serratus preserves a partial body-wall attachment. These forms resemble respiratory branches in living arthropods, supporting a gill-function hypothesis for the trilobite upper limb branch. Fossils do not measure gas exchange or haemolymph flow, and comparisons across two taxa do not settle limb-branch homology.
summaryZh: 电子显微与 X 射线成像记录 Triarthrus eatoni 鳃丝状结构的狭窄中央区和膨大边缘；Olenoides serratus 则保存部分体壁连接。这些形态与现生节肢动物的呼吸支相似，支持三叶虫肢体上支具有鳃功能的假说。化石没有测量气体交换或血淋巴流动，而两种动物之间的比较也不能裁定肢支的同源关系。

evidenceItems.statement: Triarthrus filaments have a narrow central region and inflated margins, while Olenoides preserves a partial body-wall attachment comparable to lamellate respiratory branches.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Triarthrus imaging; Olenoides articulation; Functional comparison

uncertaintyItems.statement: Gill function, haemolymph flow and limb-branch homology are functional interpretations from morphology across two taxa and times, not measured gas exchange.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Triarthrus imaging; Olenoides articulation; Functional comparison

title: A meal preserved inside one trilobite
titleZh: 一只三叶虫体内保存的一顿食物
regions: Šárka Formation, Prague Basin, Czech Republic
summary: Synchrotron X-ray microtomography maps shelly remains through the gut of Bohemolichas incola specimen 8 from the Šárka Formation. The contents are direct evidence from one fossil; feeding rate, food choice and gut chemistry are interpretations of that single preserved meal.
summaryZh: 同步辐射 X 射线显微断层成像，在 Šárka 组 Bohemolichas incola 第 8 号标本的肠道中定位了带壳遗骸。内容物是单件化石的直接证据；取食速度、食物选择和肠道化学环境则是对这一顿保存食物的解释。

title.en: What the scan shows
title.zh: 扫描图像记录了什么

text.en: The researchers used synchrotron microtomography—X-ray imaging reconstructed as fine internal slices—to map ostracod valves, hyolith material and stylophoran plates inside specimen 8. The reported voxel size is 11.35 micrometres. The named shelly remains are observations in this individual trilobite, not a survey of its usual diet.
text.zh: 研究人员使用同步辐射显微断层成像，即把 X 射线图像重建为精细内部切片，绘制第 8 号标本体内的介形类壳瓣、软舌螺材料和海林檎板片。论文报告的体素大小为 11.35 微米。这些带壳遗骸是单只三叶虫体内的观察，并非对其惯常食谱的调查。

title.en: A fossil meal has limits
title.zh: 一顿化石食物的解释边界

text.en: The paper discusses rapid, indiscriminate feeding and a neutral-to-alkaline gut, but these are physiological interpretations built from one shelly meal. Soft foods would not necessarily be preserved, and a single specimen cannot reveal population-level variation. The fossil records what remained and where it lay; it does not preserve feeding behaviour as it happened.
text.zh: 论文讨论了快速、非选择性摄食以及中性至碱性的肠道环境，但这些都是根据一顿带壳食物作出的生理解释。软食物未必能保存下来，单件标本也不能揭示种群层面的差异。化石记录的是残留物及其位置，并未直接保存正在发生的进食行为。

evidenceItems.statement: Synchrotron microtomography maps ostracod valves, hyolith material and stylophoran plates through inventory specimen 8 at 11.35-micrometre voxel size.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen inventory no. 8; Gut-content mapping; Palaeophysiological interpretation

uncertaintyItems.statement: Rapid indiscriminate feeding and a neutral-to-alkaline gut are inferences from one biased shelly meal; soft food and population variation are not preserved.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Specimen inventory no. 8; Gut-content mapping; Palaeophysiological interpretation

title.en: Uniquely preserved gut contents illuminate trilobite palaeophysiology
title.zh: Uniquely preserved gut contents illuminate trilobite palaeophysiology

scope.en: The observations and interpretive limits recorded in this event.
scope.zh: 本事件中记录的观察与解释范围。

readerSources.locator: pages: 545–551; figure: Figures 1–4; Extended Data; Specimen inventory no. 8; Gut-content mapping; Palaeophysiological interpretation

title: What soft parts reveal about Burgess Shale agnostids
titleZh: 布尔吉斯页岩球接子类的软组织证据
regions: Walcott Quarry and Marble Canyon, Burgess Shale, Canada
summary: Adult fossils of Peronopsis and Ptychagnostus from the Burgess Shale preserve soft appendages as well as the body posture called enrolment, in which the animal curled up. Researchers scored these features in an arthropod character matrix; their analysis places agnostinids as close relatives of polymeroid trilobites. That placement depends on which taxa and anatomical features are compared. A swimming-near-the-seafloor way of life is an ecological interpretation, not something the fossils directly show.
summaryZh: 布尔吉斯页岩的 Peronopsis 和 Ptychagnostus 成体化石保存了软质附肢，也保留了称为“蜷曲”的身体姿势。研究者把这些特征纳入节肢动物性状矩阵；分析结果将球接子类置于多节三叶虫的近缘位置。这个位置取决于比较了哪些类群和解剖特征。它们是否在海底附近游泳属于生态解释，化石本身不能直接显示这种生活方式。

evidenceItems.statement: Adult Peronopsis and Ptychagnostus preserve biramous appendages and enrolment anatomy scored in an explicit arthropod character matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Adult specimens; Appendage reconstruction; Phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The recovered sister relationship to polymeroid trilobites depends on sampled characters and taxa; crustacean-like limbs and life habit remain homoplastic or ecological interpretations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Adult specimens; Appendage reconstruction; Phylogenetic analysis

title: Urokodia’s appendages and its proposed chelicerate position
titleZh: Urokodia 的附肢与拟议的螯肢类位置
summary: Micro-CT reconstructions of Chengjiang Urokodia aequalis show pincer-like short great appendages, overlapping exite flaps and a head with seven segments. The study interprets this combination as a possible bridge toward chelicerae and book gills and places Urokodia high on the chelicerate stem. Appendage homology and that position depend on reconstruction and phylogenetic scoring, so they remain hypotheses rather than a settled ancestor sequence.
summaryZh:
对澄江 Urokodia aequalis 的微型 CT 重建显示，短的大附肢末端呈钳状，外肢片彼此重叠，头部由七个体节组成。研究者将这组形态解释为通向螯肢和书鳃的一种可能过渡组合，并把它放在螯肢动物干群较高的位置。

这里的“干群位置”来自形态重建和系统发育性状评分；附肢同源关系与树上位置会受到不同解释影响。它们仍是假说，不能当成已经确定的直线祖先序列。

evidenceItems.statement: Urokodia preserves pincer-like short great appendages, overlapping exite flaps and a seven-segmented head in three dimensions.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Microtomographic reconstruction; Appendage homology; Phylogenetic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Appendage homology and earliest-branching upper stem placement come from reconstruction and phylogenetic scoring and can change with competing character interpretations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Microtomographic reconstruction; Appendage homology; Phylogenetic analyses

title: A segmented chelicera in a Cambrian fossil
titleZh: 寒武纪化石中的三节螯肢
summary: The Cambrian holotype of *Megachelicerax cousteaui* from Utah preserves a large, three-segmented chelicera—the first pair of appendages near the mouth—five pairs of limbs behind it, and rear-body appendages with thin plate-like lamellae. These are observations from one specimen. Predation is a functional interpretation, and the proposed position linking habeliids with synziphosurines comes from a scored phylogenetic matrix; neither follows from the anatomy alone.
summaryZh: 美国犹他州寒武纪地层中的 *Megachelicerax cousteaui* 正模，保存了巨大的三节螯肢——靠近口部的第一对附肢；其后还有五对肢体，后体附肢带有薄片状结构。这些是单件标本上的直接观察。捕食行为属于功能解释；把它放在 Habeliidae 与 Synziphosurina 之间的关系位置，则来自性状编码后的系统发育矩阵，两者都不能仅凭外形直接确定。

evidenceItems.statement: KUMIP 314091a,b preserves massive chelicerae, five post-cheliceral prosomal limb pairs and lamella-bearing opisthosomal appendages.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype KUMIP 314091; External morphology; Phylogenetic analyses

uncertaintyItems.statement: Predatory ecology and a bridge between habeliids and synziphosurines are functional and topology results from one specimen and a scored matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Holotype KUMIP 314091; External morphology; Phylogenetic analyses

title: Mollisonia’s nerves and limbs tell competing stories
titleZh: Mollisonia 的神经与附肢给出不一致的线索
summary:
Carbonaceous films in Burgess Shale specimens MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093 have been interpreted as nervous tissue. They preserve optic nerves, a segmental ventral nerve cord and a possible compact cephalic synganglion—a fused nerve centre in the head. These structures offer an unusual view of Mollisonia’s internal anatomy.

The evolutionary signal is not uniform: nervous-system characters and appendage characters support competing placements, while the front of the body is incompletely preserved. The study therefore leaves both ancestral organization and Mollisonia’s position among stem chelicerates contested. A fossil nerve pattern informs a tree analysis; it does not settle the tree by itself.
summaryZh:
布尔吉斯页岩标本 MCZ 1811 和 USNM 305093 上的碳质薄膜被解释为神经组织。它们保存了视神经、分节的腹神经索，以及可能较紧凑的头部融合神经节。神经节是头部的神经中枢；这类化石为 Mollisonia 的内部解剖提供了少见窗口。

不同性状并没有给出一致的演化信号：神经系统和附肢性状支持相互竞争的位置，而身体前部又保存不完整。因此，祖先神经组织和 Mollisonia 在螯肢类干群中的位置仍有争议。化石神经结构可以为系统树分析提供信息，却不能单独决定系统树。

evidenceItems.statement: MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093 preserve optic nerves, a possible compact cephalic synganglion and a segmental ventral nerve cord.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093; Elemental mapping; Alternative topologies

uncertaintyItems.statement: Incomplete anterior preservation and conflict between nervous-system and appendage characters permit competing placements and mosaic-evolution scenarios.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: MCZ 1811 and USNM 305093; Elemental mapping; Alternative topologies

title: A giant claw, and the assumptions behind its body-length estimate
titleZh: 巨型螯肢背后的体长估算假设
summary: At Willwerath, a fossil of Jaekelopterus rhenaniae preserves 36.4 cm of the fixed branch of a chelicera—the front appendage used for feeding in this group of eurypterids. Its complete length was estimated at 45.5 cm. The much-cited body length of about 2.5 m is a separate extrapolation from proportions in related pterygotids, not a measurement from a complete skeleton; possible differences in claw-to-body proportions add uncertainty.
summaryZh: 德国 Willwerath 出土的 Jaekelopterus rhenaniae 化石保存了螯肢固定支的 36.4 厘米；螯肢是这类翼肢鲎用于取食的前部附肢，完整长度估算为 45.5 厘米。常被引用的约 2.5 米体长是另一项根据近缘翼肢鲎身体比例推算的结果，并非完整骨架的实测值；螯肢与身体比例可能不同，也会增加不确定性。

evidenceItems.statement: The free ramus and associated cuticle directly establish a giant pterygotid chelicera from the Early Devonian Willwerath sample.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The approximately 2.5-metre body length assumes comparable chelicera-to-body proportions and limited positive allometry; it is not a complete skeleton measurement.

title: A revised morphology matrix for horseshoe crabs
titleZh: 鲎形类形态矩阵带来的分类修订
summary: An expanded matrix of fossil and living xiphosurans, with rescored euchelicerates, places traditional synziphosurines across several euchelicerate stems rather than in one simple lineage. The topology depends on character coding, fossil completeness and taxon sampling.
summaryZh: 一项扩大后的形态矩阵纳入了化石与现生鲎形类，并重新评分真螯肢类。它将传统“合剑尾类”分散到真螯肢类的多个干群位置，而非组成一条简单谱系；该拓扑受性状编码、化石完整度和分类单元取样影响。

title.en: More fossils and revised character scores
title.zh: 更多化石与重新评分的性状

text.en: The analysis compares living and fossil xiphosurans—horseshoe crabs and their fossil relatives—and rescored euchelicerate taxa in an expanded morphological character matrix. The matrix is the evidence used to test how these fossils fit among chelicerate lineages.
text.zh: 这项分析在扩大的形态性状矩阵中比较现生与化石鲎形类（鲎及其化石近亲），并重新评估真螯肢类的性状分值。研究用这套矩阵检验这些化石在螯肢动物谱系中的位置。

title.en: A classification result that remains testable
title.zh: 仍可检验的分类结果

text.en: The resulting tree separates traditional synziphosurines among several euchelicerate stem groups, challenging their treatment as one natural group. Many fossils preserve incomplete anatomy, and missing observations or different character coding can shift short internal branches. The result revises a phylogenetic hypothesis; it does not demonstrate evolutionary stasis or one shared habitat history.
text.zh: 新树将传统合剑尾类分置于多个真螯肢类干群，挑战了把它们视为一个自然类群的处理方式。许多化石解剖结构不完整，缺失观察或不同的性状编码都可能改变较短的内部枝系。这项结果修订的是系统发育假说，并未证明形态长期不变或共享同一种栖地史。

evidenceItems.statement: The analysis samples fossil and living xiphosurans and rescored euchelicerates across an expanded character matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Character matrix; Phylogenetic results; Revised systematics

uncertaintyItems.statement: Polyphyly of traditional synziphosurines and internal Xiphosura relationships are topology results sensitive to coding, missing anatomy and taxon sampling.

title: Parioscorpio: how a scorpion claim was reconsidered
titleZh: 重新描述如何改变了 Parioscorpio 的蝎类假说？
regions: Brandon Bridge Formation, Waukesha, Wisconsin, USA
summary: In 2020, Wendruff and colleagues interpreted Parioscorpio specimens UWGM 2162 and 2163 as scorpions and compared internal structures with a pulmonary-cardiovascular system. A 2021 redescription rejected the scorpion identification and left the animal’s precise arthropod affinity unresolved. The earlier paper remains important as a historical hypothesis, but these fossils do not establish scorpion anatomy, terrestrial physiology, or habitat.
summaryZh: Wendruff 等人在 2020 年把 Parioscorpio 标本 UWGM 2162 和 UWGM 2163 解释为蝎类，并将其内部结构与肺—心血管系统比较。2021 年的重新描述否定了蝎类鉴定，动物的具体节肢动物亲缘仍未确定。早期研究作为历史假说仍值得了解，但这些化石不能确立蝎类解剖、陆生生理或栖息地。

evidenceItems.statement: Wendruff et al. (2020) interpreted holotype UWGM 2162 and paratype UWGM 2163 as scorpions and compared their medial structures with pulmonary-cardiovascular anatomy; this records the original interpretation, not an established identification.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: UWGM 2162 and 2163; Internal anatomy; Depositional and terrestrialization discussion

uncertaintyItems.statement: Anderson et al. (2021) rejected the scorpion interpretation and left exact arthropod affinities unresolved. These specimens therefore do not establish scorpion terrestrial physiology or habitat.

title: Why genomic trees disagree on arachnid relationships
titleZh: 基因组树为何对蛛形类关系意见不一
regions: Global living-chelicerate sequence and morphology samples
summary: Three genomic-scale analyses recover different arrangements of arachnids and horseshoe crabs, leading to different reconstructions of how often arachnid relatives moved onto land. The disagreement is sensitive to sampling and analytical models; these trees do not yet settle one history.
summaryZh: 三项基因组尺度分析恢复出不同的蛛形类与鲎的关系，也由此推得不同的蛛形类近缘支系登陆次数。结果会随取样和分析模型而变化；现有系统树尚未确定唯一的演化历史。

evidenceItems.statement: Dense living-taxon datasets and slowly evolving gene subsets recover either monophyletic Arachnida or Xiphosura nested among terrestrial lineages.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Gene choice, compositional heterogeneity, taxon sampling, morphology and model fit change the root; terrestrialization count and timing therefore remain topology-dependent.

title: Tokummia preserves mandibles and segmented limb bases
titleZh: Tokummia 保存的大颚与分节附肢基部
regions: Marble Canyon, Burgess Shale, British Columbia, Canada
summary: The holotype ROM 63823 and paratype ROM 63824 preserve the appendage combinations scored in the published analysis: paired mandibles, maxillipeds and subdivided basipods. A basipod is the basal part of an arthropod limb; the study compared its structures alongside the jaws to test early mandibulate anatomy. The matrix recovers Tokummia katalepsis on the mandibulate stem. That placement is an analytical result, not evidence that Tokummia directly gave rise to crustaceans, insects or myriapods.
summaryZh: 正模 ROM 63823 和副模 ROM 63824 保存了论文分析所评分的附肢组合：成对大颚、颚足，以及分节的基肢（节肢动物附肢基部）。研究把这些结构与颚部特征一起比较，以检验早期有颚类的体制。矩阵将 Tokummia katalepsis 恢复在有颚类干群上；这是分析结果，并不证明 Tokummia 是甲壳类、昆虫或多足类的直接祖先。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype ROM 63823 and paratype ROM 63824 preserve the appendage combinations scored in the published matrix.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Diagnosis; Mandibles and maxillipeds; Phylogenetic results

uncertaintyItems.statement: Stem-mandibulate placement is a matrix result; Tokummia is neither a demonstrated direct ancestor nor a crown crustacean, insect or myriapod.

title: Waptia mouthparts across a large fossil sample
titleZh: 大样本中的 Waptia 口器
summary: The Burgess Shale sample includes more than 1,800 *Waptia fieldensis* specimens. ROMIP 56432 shows mandibles and maxillules (mouth appendages), while ROMIP 64294 preserves opposing mandibles separated within the larger series. Together, the fossils document a bivalved body plan with jaws. Placement among Pancrustacea—the lineage that includes crustaceans and six-legged animals—and a swimming-predator lifestyle are interpretations from anatomy and phylogenetic analysis, not direct observations of behaviour or stomach contents.
summaryZh: 伯吉斯页岩的样本包括 1,800 多件 *Waptia fieldensis* 标本。ROMIP 56432 展示了大颚和小颚等口部附肢；ROMIP 64294 则在较大的标本系列中保存了彼此分离的一对大颚。合起来，这批化石记录了具有双瓣体壳和颚部附肢的身体结构。它与泛甲壳类（包括甲壳动物和六足动物的支系）的亲缘位置，以及会游泳捕食的生态，都是依据解剖和系统发育分析作出的解释，并非直接观察到的行为或胃内容物。

evidenceItems.statement: ROMIP 56432 figures mandibles and maxillules, while ROMIP 64294 exposes disarticulated opposing mandibles within the larger specimen series.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Pancrustacean placement and active swimming predation are topology and functional interpretations, not stomach contents, observed behaviour or a direct ancestor claim.

title: Growth stages preserved in phosphate
titleZh: 磷酸盐化化石保存的生长阶段
regions: Yu'anshan Member, Chiungchussu Formation, Yunnan, China
summary: Phosphatized Yicaris dianensis fossils preserve individuals at several growth stages, including an eight-segment thorax reconstructed from soft-part anatomy. The series shows leaf-shaped outgrowths on the limbs and an organization resembling that of eucrustaceans. These are anatomical observations from the fossils; identifying the outgrowths as epipodites and placing Yicaris within crown Eucrustacea depend on character interpretation. The sample therefore does not provide an exact date for the origin of the crown group.
summaryZh: 磷酸盐化的 Yicaris dianensis 化石保存了多个生长阶段，其中包括依据软组织解剖复原的八节胸部个体。化石显示肢体上的叶状外突，以及类似真甲壳类的附肢组织。这些是化石中的解剖观察；把外突鉴定为上肢、并将滇虫置于真甲壳类冠群，则取决于性状解释。因此，这组样本不能给出冠群起源的精确年代。

evidenceItems.statement: The topotype series preserves multiple developmental stages, including an eight-thoracomere stage reconstructed from phosphatized soft-part anatomy.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Eucrustacean crown placement and epipodite homology depend on character interpretation and must not be converted into an exact crown-origin date.

title: When ostracod relationships change with data
titleZh: 数据如何改变介形类的亲缘关系
regions: Nine new ostracod transcriptomes and combined pancrustacean matrices
summary: Nine new 454 transcriptomes joined morphology, fossils and several sequence datasets in analyses of Pancrustacea. Support for major groupings is conditional: ostracod monophyly and several deep nodes shift when fast genes, outgroups or data partitions change.
summaryZh: 九份新的 454 转录组与形态、化石及多类序列数据共同用于泛甲壳类分析。主要分组的支持具有条件性：更换快速进化基因、外群或数据分区后，介形类单系性及若干深层节点会改变。

title.en: A broad data combination
title.zh: 多类数据的结合

text.en: The analysis added nine new ostracod transcriptomes to morphology, fossils, expressed-sequence tags, genomes, mitochondrial proteins and ribosomal data. A transcriptome is the set of RNA sequences measured from sampled tissue. Combining these sources supports some major pancrustacean groupings in selected analyses.
text.zh: 分析将九份新的介形类转录组加入形态、化石、表达序列标签、基因组、线粒体蛋白和核糖体数据。转录组是从所取样组织测得的 RNA 序列集合。在部分分析中，这些数据组合支持若干主要泛甲壳类分组。

title.en: Read the sensitivity results too
title.zh: 也要看敏感性分析

text.en: Ostracod monophyly and several deeper relationships change when fast-evolving genes, distant outgroups or data partitions are treated differently. These branches are outputs of phylogenetic analyses, not fossil observations. The study therefore presents conditional support and sensitivity rather than one settled tree for every deep pancrustacean node.
text.zh: 对快速进化基因、远缘外群或数据分区采用不同处理时，介形类单系性和若干深层关系会改变。这些分支是系统发育分析结果，不是化石直接观察。因此，研究呈现的是有条件的支持与敏感性，而非所有深层泛甲壳类节点的定论树。

evidenceItems.statement: Nine new 454 transcriptomes were combined with morphology, fossils, ESTs, genomes, mitochondrial proteins and ribosomal data.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Ostracod monophyly and several deep nodes change when fast genes, distant outgroups or data partitions change; no displayed branch is a fossil observation.

title: Remipede sampling tests the insect-side branches of the tree
titleZh: 扩大洞虾类取样后，节肢动物关系怎样变化？
summary: A 2019 phylogenomic study added remipedes to taxon-rich genomic matrices. Across its analyses, Remipedia repeatedly grouped as the sampled sister lineage of Hexapoda within Labiocarida. Several deeper pancrustacean branches, including positions involving copepods and cephalocarids, shifted with method and sampling. The tree is a tested relationship hypothesis, not a ladder of known ancestors.
summaryZh: 2019 年的一项系统基因组研究把洞虾类加入覆盖较多分类单元的矩阵。多个分析反复把洞虾纲恢复为六足动物在 Labiocarida 中的取样姐妹群。桡足类、头虾类等更深层泛甲壳动物分支的位置，则会随方法和取样改变。这是一组经过检验的亲缘假说，不是已知祖先逐级排列的阶梯。

evidenceItems.statement: Expanded remipede sampling repeatedly recovers Remipedia plus Hexapoda while supporting several major pancrustacean clades across methods.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Copepod, cephalocarid and other deep positions remain method- and sampling-sensitive, so the tree is a tested hypothesis rather than a fixed ancestor ladder.

title: Change the sample, change the pancrustacean tree
titleZh: 改变取样，泛甲壳动物系统树也会改变
regions: Ninety transcriptomes and fifteen genomes across Pancrustacea
summary:
One analysis compared two pancrustacean matrices built with the same ortholog-selection procedure: a 98-taxon set and a 105-taxon set containing 90 transcriptomes, 15 genomes and 576 protein-coding genes. Changing the sampled taxa altered relationships among deep branches, even though the gene-selection pipeline was shared.

The result makes a methodological point: a tree can be sensitive to who is included. The study also estimated divergence times using thirteen vetted calibrations, but those dates remain clock-model outputs. Neither the topology nor its dates should be treated as a final, universal crustacean tree.
summaryZh:
一项研究用相同的直系同源基因筛选流程比较两套泛甲壳动物矩阵：一套含 98 个分类单元，另一套含 105 个分类单元，其中包括 90 个转录组、15 个基因组和 576 个蛋白编码基因。即使筛选流程相同，改变纳入的类群也会改变深层分支之间的关系。

这个结果说明系统树可能对取样对象敏感。研究还利用 13 项经过筛选的校准估计分化时间，但这些年代仍是分子钟模型的输出。拓扑和年代都不应被当作最终、普遍适用的甲壳动物系统树。

evidenceItems.statement: The final 105-taxon matrix includes 90 transcriptomes, 15 genomes and 576 protein-coding genes, compared with a 98-taxon alternative assembled through the same pipeline.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Rejected and recovered clades differ among sampled matrices and models; divergence estimates use thirteen vetted calibrations but remain clock outputs.

title: Rhyniella specimens and the springtail furcula
titleZh: Rhyniella 化石与弹器
summary: Four head capsules and about ten later Rhyniella body specimens from the Rhynie chert include a reported intact abdomen and a furcula resembling the springtail jumping organ. The sample supports collembolan affinity, not a global origin date or ecological portrait.
summaryZh: Rhynie 燧石中的四个 Rhyniella 头壳和约十件后来发现的身体标本，包括一件据报道保存完整的腹部及类似弹尾动物跳跃器的弹器。这批材料支持其弹尾类亲缘判断，却不能给六足动物的全球起源定年或复原其生态。

title.en: More than isolated head capsules
title.zh: 材料不只包含孤立头壳

text.en: The early material consists of four head capsules. Roughly ten additional body specimens were described later, including the first reported intact abdomen and a furcula—the forked springtail structure used in jumping—comparable to that of living Collembola.
text.zh: 早期材料由四个头壳组成。后来又描述了约十件身体标本，其中包括据报道首件保存完整的腹部，以及与现生弹尾类相似的弹器——一种分叉结构，可用于跳跃。

title.en: A fossil sample with a limited reach
title.zh: 化石样本能回答的问题有限

text.en: The body and furcula support placing Rhyniella among springtails, or Collembola. This is a claim about the sampled Rhynie-chert fossils. It does not establish when Hexapoda first became terrestrial worldwide, where the group originated, or how ecologically dominant it was.
text.zh: 身体和弹器支持将 Rhyniella 归入弹尾类。这个判断针对所取样的 Rhynie 燧石化石；它不能确定六足动物何时在全球首次登陆、起源于何处，或当时是否占据生态优势。

evidenceItems.statement: Four head capsules and about ten later body specimens include the first reported intact abdomen and a furcula comparable to living springtails.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Head capsules; body specimens; abdomen and furcula

uncertaintyItems.statement: This sampled occurrence supports collembolan affinity but does not by itself date hexapod terrestrialization, global origin or ecological dominance.

title.zh: A new assessment of Rhyniella, the earliest known insect, from the Devonian of Rhynie, Scotland

title: Rhyniognatha: an insect or a myriapod?
titleZh: Rhyniognatha：昆虫，还是多足类？
summary: The fossil called *Rhyniognatha hirsti* comes from Scotland’s Rhynie Chert. NHMUK PI IN 38234 is an isolated head fragment that preserves mouthparts. A 2004 study read its mandibles as those of a dicondylic insect, perhaps related to winged insects; a 2017 three-dimensional reanalysis instead favored a myriapod, possibly a centipede. Because the same incomplete specimen anchors these incompatible readings, its insect identity remains unsettled: it is not secure evidence for an early insect or a dependable calibration for the origin of flight.
summaryZh: 名为 *Rhyniognatha hirsti* 的化石来自苏格兰莱尼燧石。标本 NHMUK PI IN 38234 是一段保存口器的孤立头部。2004 年研究把其下颌解释为双髁类昆虫，并认为可能接近有翅昆虫；2017 年的三维复核则更倾向于多足类，或许是蜈蚣。两种相反解释都依据这件不完整标本，因此它的昆虫身份仍未确定：不能把它当作已确认的早期昆虫，也不能作为飞行起源的可靠校准点。

evidenceItems.statement: NHMUK PI IN 38234 preserves an isolated head fragment whose mandibles were interpreted in 2004 as dicondylic and possibly pterygote-like.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Three-dimensional reanalysis in 2017 found the structures more compatible with a myriapod, possibly a scutigeromorph centipede; insect and flight calibrations are therefore contested.

title: Three arthropod land colonisations in model comparisons
titleZh: 模型如何比较三支节肢动物的登陆路线
summary: Fossil-calibrated analyses compare 57 taxa across 246 genes, with a 30-taxon subset used to test alternative trees. Models of ancestral habitat favor marine rather than freshwater routes for separate land colonisations by hexapods, myriapods and arachnids. The routes and their timing are reconstructions conditioned on the tree and calibrations, not observed migrations.
summaryZh: 化石校准分析比较了 57 个分类单元和 246 个基因，并用一个 30 个分类单元的子集检验不同系统树。祖先栖地模型更支持六足类、多足类和蛛形类分别从海洋而非淡水环境登陆。登陆路线和时间是以系统树、校准和状态编码为条件的重建，并非观察到的迁徙。

evidenceItems.statement: The core dataset contains 57 taxa and 246 genes, with fossil calibrations and a 30-species panarthropod subset used for topology tests.

uncertaintyItems.statement: A favoured marine route and inferred dates are model outputs conditioned on topology, calibrations and ancestral-state coding, not observed migrations.

title: A tiny wing fragment from the Paskov core
titleZh: Paskov 钻芯中的微小翅碎片
regions: Paskov Mine drill core, Upper Silesian Basin, Czech Republic
summary: A roughly 10 mm crushed forewing and counterpart from the lowermost Namurian Paskov drill core preserve cross-veins and branches of major veins. Dated to about 324 Ma, the specimen was assigned to Archaeorthoptera from incomplete venation. It records an early winged insect, but cannot date powered-flight origins or the first appearance of all Pterygota.
summaryZh: 来自 Paskov 钻芯最下部纳缪尔阶的一件约 10 毫米压扁前翅及其反模，保存横脉和主脉分支。标本年代约为 3.24 亿年前，依据不完整翅脉被归入 Archaeorthoptera。它记录了早期有翅昆虫，但不能确定动力飞行的起源或整个有翅类的最早出现。

evidenceItems.statement: The approximately 10 mm crushed forewing fragment preserves cross-veins and branches of ScP, R and other main veins in lowermost Namurian strata.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Archaeorthopteran affinity follows incomplete venation, and one fragment cannot date the acquisition of powered flight or the global Pterygota first appearance.

title: Developmental knockouts test a wing-homology model
titleZh: 发育敲除实验检验翅同源模型
regions: Parhyale hawaiensis CRISPR and comparative insect expression dataset
summary: CRISPR knockouts and gene-expression comparisons in Parhyale hawaiensis and insects test how proximal limb segments correspond with lateral body-wall and wing-related structures. These experiments support a model of serial homology, treating those structures as developmentally corresponding, but they do not preserve the first insect wing or identify one fossil precursor. The result links development in living organisms; it does not by itself reconstruct the ecology or exact historical path of wing origins.
summaryZh: 研究在夏威夷 Parhyale hawaiensis 和昆虫中进行 CRISPR 基因敲除与表达比较，以检验近端足节、身体侧壁和翅相关结构之间的发育对应关系。结果支持系列同源模型，即把这些结构视为在发育上相互对应；但实验没有保存昆虫最早的翅，也没有指出某件化石就是翅的前身。它揭示的是现生生物之间的发育联系，不能单独复原翅起源的生态背景或确切历史路径。

evidenceItems.statement: CRISPR perturbations and expression domains compare proximal leg segments in Parhyale with cricket and other insect body-wall and wing structures.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Developmental correspondence supports a homology model but does not preserve the first wing, its ecology or one uniquely identified fossil precursor.

title: 1KITE: tracing relationships across insect orders
titleZh: 1KITE：用转录组重建昆虫目级关系
summary: The 1KITE study compared transcriptomes from 144 insect species across 1,478 protein-coding genes to estimate relationships among insect orders. It also modelled when branches diverged, but those dates are estimates from a calibrated molecular clock, not observed fossil first appearances; both the tree and its timing depend on taxon sampling, sequence models, fossil assignments and clock priors.
summaryZh: 1KITE 研究比较了 144 种昆虫、共 1,478 个蛋白编码基因的转录组，以估计昆虫各目的亲缘关系；它还用校准分子钟模型估算支系分化时间。这些年代是模型估计，不是化石首次出现的实测时间；树形与年代都受分类单元取样、序列模型、化石归属和时钟先验影响。

evidenceItems.statement: The study samples 144 species, 1,478 protein-coding genes and archived transcriptomes under BioProject PRJNA183205.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Taxon and gene sampling; archived data

uncertaintyItems.statement: Topology and node ages depend on sampling, orthology, sequence models, fossil assignments and clock priors; they are not observed fossil first appearances.

title: Five Pennsylvanian fossils sample early eumetabolan branches
titleZh: 五件宾夕法尼亚世化石记录早期真变态类支系
regions: Moscovian and Gzhelian fossil localities in France and Russia
summary: Five insect fossils dated from the Moscovian to the Gzhelian represent a stem coleopterid, a holometabolous larva, a stem hymenopterid, early Hemiptera and early Psocodea. They broaden the sampled Pennsylvanian record before better-known post-Permian crown radiations. The fossils do not show that these branches originated at the same time or fix the first appearance of any living crown order.
summaryZh:
从莫斯科期到格热尔期的五件昆虫化石，分别代表鞘翅目干群、一件完全变态类昆虫幼虫、膜翅目干群、早期半翅目和啮虫目。它们把宾夕法尼亚纪的已采样记录向前扩展到二叠纪以后更熟悉的冠群辐射之前。

“干群”指位于现生冠群之外、但被研究置于其演化支系上的化石成员。这五件材料并不能证明这些支系同时起源，也不能确定任何现生冠群目的全球首现时间。

evidenceItems.statement: The described sample includes a stem coleopterid, a holometabolous larva, a stem hymenopterid, an early hemipteran and an early psocodean.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The specimens do not demonstrate synchronous origins, exact crown-order first appearances or a single climatic cause for later diversification.

title: A new skull tests Vegavis's place among birds
titleZh: 新头骨检验 Vegavis 在鸟类中的位置
summary: The nearly complete skull AMNH FARB 30899, dated to 69.2–68.4 Ma, provides direct anatomical evidence for Vegavis. A 2025 combined analysis supports placement among crown waterfowl, while earlier studies placed it among stem anatids, stem anseriforms or outside Aves; crown-group membership therefore remains a topology-dependent hypothesis.
summaryZh: 年代为 69.2–68.4 Ma 的近完整头骨 AMNH FARB 30899，为 Vegavis 提供了直接解剖证据。2025 年联合分析支持将其置于冠群水禽内；更早研究则将其置于鸭科干群、雁形目干群或鸟纲之外，因此其冠群成员资格仍取决于系统树拓扑。

evidenceItems.statement: AMNH FARB 30899 preserves a toothless beak, crown-like neuroanatomy and specialized jaw apparatus

uncertaintyItems.statement: Published analyses have recovered stem-anatid, stem-anseriform and outside-Aves alternatives

title: Mosasauroidea and Mosasauridae mark different boundaries
titleZh: 沧龙超科与沧龙科的范围并不相同
regions: Cretaceous mosasauroid records; middle Turonian of north-central Texas
summary: The names encode different phylogenetic boundaries. Mosasauroidea is defined around a broader branch, while Mosasauridae is a node-defined family; they should not be used interchangeably. Dallasaurus provides a separate anatomical example: skeletons preserve plesiopedal, less paddle-specialized limbs even though the original analysis places the taxon within Mosasauridae. That placement and the deeper branching pattern remain sensitive to analytical choices, so the navigation grouping is not a claim that one taxonomy is immutable.
summaryZh: 这两个名称对应不同的系统发育边界。Mosasauroidea（沧龙超科）按较宽的支系定义，Mosasauridae（沧龙科）则按共同祖先节点及其后代界定，不能互换使用。Dallasaurus 的骨架另提供一个解剖例子：它的肢体仍较接近步行型、尚未完全特化为鳍桨，但原分析将其置于沧龙科。该位置和更深层的分支关系会随分析方法变化，因此此处的分类路径不是对唯一固定分类方案的裁定。

evidenceItems.statement: Table 1 defines Mosasauroidea and Mosasauridae separately; the Dallasaurus skeletons preserve plesiopedal limbs in a taxon recovered within Mosasauridae by the original analysis.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Basal mosasauroid relationships and some traditional names are sensitive to analytical strategy; the navigation edge therefore supports discovery and does not assert a single immutable taxonomy.

title: Bobosaurus: an older plesiosaur-line candidate?
titleZh: Bobosaurus：更早出现的蛇颈龙谱系候选？
regions: Rio del Lago Formation, northeastern Italy
summary: The articulated holotype MFSN 27285 comes from the lower Carnian Rio del Lago Formation and combines nothosaurian and plesiosaurian features. Its original study considered alternative placements, including a position nearer Plesiosauria, so it is an older but uncertain candidate, not evidence extending diagnostic Plesiosauria; it is compared with the more securely identified Rhaeticosaurus.
summaryZh: 关节相连的正模 MFSN 27285 出自卡尼期早期的 Rio del Lago 组，兼有幻龙类与蛇颈龙类特征。原研究讨论了替代系统位置，包括更接近蛇颈龙类的可能，因此它是年代更早但归属未定的候选，不能据此扩展诊断明确的蛇颈龙类记录；这里将它与归属更可靠的 Rhaeticosaurus 对照。

evidenceItems.statement: Holotype MFSN 27285 preserves an articulated sauropterygian skeleton from the lower Carnian Rio del Lago Formation with a documented mosaic of nothosaurian and plesiosaurian characters.

uncertaintyItems.statement: The original study considered a pistosaurid position or a closer relationship to Plesiosauria; this older candidate is displayed beside, not substituted for, diagnostic Rhaetian Rhaeticosaurus.

title: What a Devonian shark preserves—and what it cannot date
titleZh: 法门期的 Maghriboselache 留下形态，却不能确定起源年代
regions: Thylacocephalan Layer, southern Maïder and Tafilalt, eastern Anti-Atlas, Morocco
summary:
Several partly articulated Maghriboselache mohamezanei skeletons from Morocco’s Famennian Thylacocephalan Layer preserve three-dimensional braincases, a broad cartilage-enclosed snout, widely separated nasal capsules, large pectoral fins and a high-aspect-ratio tail. One specimen, PIMUZ A/I 5155, contains a roughly 40 mm actinopterygian in its stomach, recording a feeding event.

The sample documents unusual sensory and body-plan anatomy, but most skeletons lack the tail end and some skull regions are compressed. Body length, sex and ecology therefore remain bounded interpretations. This Moroccan record is not a global first appearance, a direct ancestor, or a date for the origin of crown sharks.
summaryZh:
来自摩洛哥法门期噬甲动物层的数件部分关节相连骨架，保存了三维脑颅、软骨包围的宽吻部、相距较远的鼻囊、大型胸鳍和高展弦比尾。标本 PIMUZ A/I 5155 的胃中还保存一条约 40 毫米长的辐鳍鱼，记录了一次摄食事件。

这些样本揭示了特殊的感觉系统和身体结构，但多数骨架缺少尾部末端，部分头骨区域也已压扁。因此，体长、性别和生态仍只能在样本范围内解释。这个摩洛哥记录不是全球首现、直系祖先，也不能确定鲨类冠群的起源年代。

evidenceItems.statement: The holotype AA.MEM.DS.12 and referred specimen PIMUZ A/I 5159 preserve three-dimensional cranial anatomy, while the Thylacocephalan Layer sample also preserves partly articulated body and fin anatomy.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Introduction; Material; Systematic palaeontology; neurocranium description

evidenceItems.statement: In PIMUZ A/I 5155, the stomach contains a more or less articulated small actinopterygian approximately 40 mm long, recording one feeding event.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Description—Soft tissues; paragraph beginning ‘Consequently, the body outline is discernible...’

evidenceItems.statement: The broad rostrum and laterally separated nasal capsules are described as an early sensory specialization, while the time-calibrated placement remains matrix-dependent.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Most skeletons have missing caudal regions and some cranial parts are compressed; body length, sex and ecology therefore remain sample-bounded interpretations.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Material and methods; body form and preservation

uncertaintyItems.statement: The event is a Moroccan specimen record and does not establish direct ancestry, a global FAD/LAD or an uninterrupted holocephalan lineage.

title: Strudiella: one specimen, opposing insect diagnoses
titleZh: Strudiella：同一标本引出相反的昆虫诊断
summary: The Strud specimen was first described as the nearly complete Late Devonian insect Strudiella devonica. A later primary re-investigation rejected the insect identification, treating it as an arthropod whose placement cannot be secured as an insect. The two studies therefore record a real disagreement over the same fossil. The case is useful for reading how diagnoses change, but the batch keeps both interpretations visible rather than using Strudiella as a secure insect calibration.
summaryZh: Strud 标本最初被描述为近完整的晚泥盆世昆虫 Strudiella devonica。随后的一手再研究否定了昆虫鉴定，将它视为归属尚不能确定为昆虫的节肢动物。两项研究因此对同一化石提出了相反解释。这个案例展示分类诊断如何被重新检验；这里保留这种分歧，不把 Strudiella 当作可靠的昆虫年代校准点。

evidenceItems.statement: Garrouste et al. named and interpreted the nearly complete Strud specimen as Strudiella devonica, a terrestrial Late Devonian insect.

uncertaintyItems.statement: Hörnschemeyer et al. rejected the insect identification after re-investigation; the atlas preserves this disagreement rather than using Strudiella as a secure insect calibration.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Re-investigation and conclusion that Strudiella is not an insect

title: A CT view of the Cosmoselachus gill cover
titleZh: CT 揭示的 Cosmoselachus 鳃盖结构
regions: Fayetteville Shale near Cove Creek, Searcy County, Arkansas, United States
summary: X-ray CT reconstruction of the partial holotype AMNH FF 20509 from the Late Mississippian Fayetteville Shale reveals long rays from the hyoid and branchial arches. The rays fuse into a corrugated operculum covering at least two posterior gill arches. The specimen is damaged and incomplete, so it does not preserve a full body or directly show locomotion, population variation or the complete function of the structure.
summaryZh:
研究者用 X 射线 CT 重建了密西西比世晚期费耶特维尔页岩中的不完整正模 AMNH FF 20509。舌弓和鳃弓伸出的长射线汇合成带褶皱的鳃盖，至少覆盖两道后位鳃弓；这让研究者能讨论鲨类干群中此前少见的鳃区结构。

正模已经破损，身体其他部分也没有完整保存。它不能单独说明完整体形、运动方式、种群差异或该结构的全部功能；CT 重建展示的是保存下来的材料及其解释边界。

evidenceItems.statement: AMNH FF 20509 preserves lower jaws with teeth, a partial upper jaw and basicranium, branchial elements, pectoral cartilage and fin material from the Fayetteville Shale.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Abstract; Material; Systematic palaeontology; specimen description

evidenceItems.statement: The study identifies elongate rays extending from the hyoid and branchial arches and fused into an operculum covering at least two posterior branchial arches.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: CT reconstruction; branchial anatomy; phylogenetic analysis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The holotype is partial and has experienced damage and pyrite decay; body size, complete locomotion and population variation are unavailable.
The phylogenetic placement is a sampled analysis and the event is not a global symmoriiform or Chondrichthyes endpoint, direct ancestor or complete species range.

title: A patterned wing and a leaf-mimicry hypothesis
titleZh: 翅脉图案与拟叶假说
regions: Yixian Formation, Jehol biota, Inner Mongolia, China
summary: The Early Cretaceous stick insect Cretophasmomima melanogramma preserves dark veins across its wings. Its describing study compared the pattern with a leaf-shaped plant organ from the same interval and proposed possible leaf mimicry; camouflage itself cannot be observed in a fossil.
summaryZh: 早白垩世竹节虫 Cretophasmomima melanogramma 保存了翅上的深色脉纹。描述该物种的研究将图案与同期一种叶状植物器官作比较，并提出可能的拟叶解释；化石本身无法显示隐蔽效果。

evidenceItems.statement: The primary description documents the wing pattern and its comparison with Membranifolia admirabilis in the Jehol setting.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Wing coloration, plant comparison and proposed crypsis

uncertaintyItems.statement: The fossil preserves a pattern and a proposed model, not observed predator avoidance, feeding behaviour or measured crypsis performance.

referenceLinks.quoteLocator: Cautious functional interpretation of the wing pattern
